macros.name: __FILE__
macros.description: Expands to a string holding the path of the script file being compiled.
macros.remarks: Substituted by the compiler itself; no .gsh defines it. Inside an inserted file it names the insert, not the including script. Like the other built-ins, it is not substituted when written inside the body of another #define, so a wrapper such as #define TRACE __FILE__ leaves the name unexpanded.

macros.name: __FUNCTION__
macros.description: Expands to a string naming the enclosing function, qualified as namespace::function.
macros.example: assert( isactor || IsVehicle( self ), __FUNCTION__ + " only supports actors and vehicles." );
macros.remarks: When the file declares no #namespace, the namespace falls back to the file stem. The stock scripts use it exactly once, in spawner_shared.gsc. Not substituted when written inside the body of another #define.

macros.name: __LINE__
macros.description: Expands to the 1-based line number of the line it is written on.
macros.remarks: Expands to an integer, not a string. Not substituted when written inside the body of another #define.

macros.name: __TIME_UPDATE__
macros.description: Recomputes the timing locals used by the FOR_TIME timed loop, updating the elapsed time, the fraction of the total duration that has passed and the time remaining. It is expanded internally by FOR_TIME and FOR_TIME_LOOP rather than written by hand.

definitions.expansion: __time_stamp__ = GetTime(); if ( __time_stamp__ > __time_stamp_prev__ ) { __time__ = ( __time_stamp__ - __time_stamp_start__ ) / 1000; __time_frac__ = LerpFloat( 0, 1, Float( __time__ ) / Float( __time_length__ ) ); __time_left__ = Max( __time_length__ - __time__, 0 ); __time_stamp_prev__ = __time_stamp__; }

macros.remarks: Reads the server time with GetTime() and assigns the locals __time__, __time_frac__, __time_left__ and __time_stamp_prev__, so it only compiles inside a FOR_TIME block that declared them.

macros.name: ADD_POINT_SCORE
macros.description: Adds a named score contribution to a position query point struct, recording the individual contribution under its name for debugging.

parameters.name: pointStruct
parameters.description: The point struct being scored, whose score field is incremented.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the scoring rule, used as the debug key.

parameters.name: point_score
parameters.description: Score value to add.

definitions.expansion: /# if ( !isdefined( pointStruct._scoreDebug ) ) { pointStruct._scoreDebug = []; } pointStruct._scoreDebug[ name ] = point_score; #/ pointStruct.score += point_score;

macros.remarks: The per name debug record is wrapped in a developer block ( /# #/ ) and only exists in developer builds, but the score field is always updated.

macros.remarks: Expands to statements, not an expression, and assigns to the first argument, so it must be passed a variable. Uses MAKE_ARRAY internally.

macros.name: ARRIVAL_COVER_SPLIT_NOTETRACK
macros.description: Notetrack name marking the point in an arrival animation where the cover arrival splits off.

macros.name: ARRIVAL_STANCE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the stance an AI should be in when it arrives at its goal.

macros.name: ARRIVAL_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding how the actor should arrive at its goal.
macros.remarks: Its values are ARRIVE_AT_GOAL and DONT_ARRIVE_AT_GOAL.

macros.name: ARRIVE_AT_COVER_ASM_STATE
macros.description: Name of the animation state machine state played when an AI arrives at cover.
macros.remarks: A source comment marks this hardcoded state name as a temporary measure.

macros.name: ARRIVE_AT_GOAL
macros.description: Arrival type value meaning the actor should play an arrival at its goal.
macros.remarks: Value for the ARRIVAL_TYPE blackboard attribute, opposite DONT_ARRIVE_AT_GOAL.

macros.name: ART_REVIEW
macros.description: Expands to the value of the art_review dvar, defaulting to 0, used to enable art review behaviour in script.
macros.remarks: The expansion reads a dvar every time the macro is used, so it is a function call and not a compile time constant.

macros.name: ARTIFACT_DIM
macros.description: Value written to the random perk machine's artifact glow setting to dim the floating artifact. The companion ARTIFACT_GLOW value (0) lights it up.
macros.remarks: Drives ScriptVector0.x on the machine model, where 1.00 is off and 0.00 is on.

macros.name: ARTIFACT_GLOW
macros.description: Random perk machine artifact state value that turns the artifact glow on.
macros.remarks: Written to ScriptVector0.x on the artifact model. The sense is inverted, 0 glows and ARTIFACT_DIM (1) turns the glow off.

macros.name: ASM_ALIAS_ATTRIBUTE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name that holds the animation alias selected for the current state.

macros.name: ASM_DEATH_NOTIFY
macros.description: Notify string the animation state machine watches for to stop running an entity's states on death.

macros.name: ASM_MARGWA_BODYFALL_NOTETRACK

macros.name: ASM_MARGWA_PAIN_MELEE_NOTETRACK

macros.name: ASM_MARGWA_SMASH_ATTACK_NOTETRACK

macros.name: ASM_MECHZ_GRENADE_NOTETRACK

macros.name: ASM_MECHZ_MELEE_NOTETRACK

macros.name: ASM_MOCOMP_NAME
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding the motion composite currently assigned to the entity.

macros.name: ASM_MOCOMP_START
macros.description: Key under which a motion composite's init function is stored in its registration.

macros.name: ASM_MOCOMP_TERMINATE
macros.description: Key under which a motion composite's terminate function is stored in its registration.

macros.name: ASM_MOCOMP_UPDATE
macros.description: Key under which a motion composite's update function is stored in its registration.

macros.name: ASM_NOTETRACK_HANDLER_STOP_NOTIFY
macros.description: Notify string that stops an entity's notetrack handling thread.

macros.name: ASM_REGISTER_BLACKBOARD_NOTETRACK_HANDLER
macros.description: Registers a notetrack that, when it fires, writes a fixed value into a blackboard attribute.

parameters.name: notetrackName
parameters.description: Notetrack string to listen for.

parameters.name: blackboardAttributeName
parameters.description: Blackboard attribute to set when the notetrack fires.

parameters.name: blackBoardValue
parameters.description: Value to write into that blackboard attribute.

macros.remarks: Expands to a call to AnimationStateNetwork::RegisterBlackboardNotetrackHandler. Useful for notetracks whose only job is to update the blackboard, avoiding a handler function.

macros.name: ASM_REGISTER_MOCOMP
macros.description: Registers a motion composite (mocomp) and its init, update and terminate handlers with the animation state network.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the motion composite, matching the mocomp named in the animation state network.

parameters.name: initFunction
parameters.description: Function pointer called when the mocomp starts.

parameters.name: updateFunction
parameters.description: Function pointer called each update while the mocomp runs.

parameters.name: terminateFunction
parameters.description: Function pointer called when the mocomp ends.

macros.remarks: Expands to a call to AnimationStateNetwork::RegisterAnimationMocomp.

macros.name: ASM_REGISTER_NOTETRACK_HANDLER
macros.description: Registers a script function to run whenever the named animation notetrack fires.

parameters.name: notetrackname
parameters.description: Notetrack string to listen for.

parameters.name: handlerfunction
parameters.description: Function pointer called when the notetrack fires.

macros.remarks: Expands to a call to AnimationStateNetwork::RegisterNotetrackHandlerFunction.

macros.name: ASM_SKELETON_MELEE_NOTETRACK
macros.description: Animation notetrack that fires the skeleton archetype's melee damage.

macros.name: ASM_STATE_COMPLETE
macros.description: Animation state machine status meaning the current state has finished.

macros.name: ASM_STATE_INACTIVE
macros.description: Animation state machine status meaning no state is currently running.

macros.name: ASM_STATE_INVALID_INDEX
macros.description: Index returned when an animation state machine state cannot be found.

macros.name: ASM_STATE_RUNNING
macros.description: Animation state machine status meaning the current state is still playing.

macros.name: ASM_STATE_TERMINATED
macros.description: Animation state machine status meaning the current state was terminated before completing.

macros.name: ASM_STATE_TRANSITION_COMPLETE
macros.description: Animation state machine status meaning a transition into a state has finished.

macros.name: ASM_THRASHER_MELEE_NOTETRACK

macros.name: ASM_ZOMBIE_CRUSH_NOTETRACK
macros.description: Animation notetrack name that fires when a zombie is crushed.

macros.name: ASM_ZOMBIE_DOG_MELEE_NOTETRACK
macros.description: Animation notetrack that fires the hellhound archetype's melee damage.

macros.name: ASM_ZOMBIE_MELEE_NOTETRACK
macros.description: Animation notetrack name that fires the zombie's melee attack damage.
macros.remarks: ASM_ZOMBIE_DOG_MELEE_NOTETRACK is the equivalent for zombie dogs.

macros.name: ASSAULT_ENDGAME_1

macros.name: ASSAULT_ENDGAME_2
macros.description: Player body animation played by the assault rifle on the second place endgame podium.

macros.name: ASSAULT_ENDGAME_3

macros.name: ASSAULT_ENDGAME_ARRAY

macros.remarks: Indexed by the top player index in scripts/shared/end_game_taunts.csc through WEAPON_GROUP_TOP_3_ANIMS.

macros.name: ASSAULT_LOBBY
macros.description: Player body animation that showcases the assault rifle in the lobby and create-a-class frontend.

macros.name: AST_AWARENESS

macros.name: AST_AWARENESS_PREVIOUS
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name for an actor's awareness state on the previous update.
macros.remarks: Compared against AST_AWARENESS to detect awareness transitions.

macros.name: AST_REGISTER_API
macros.description: Registers a script function as an animation selector table evaluator under the given name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the animation selector table evaluator, as referenced by the table.

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: Function pointer that evaluates the selector.

macros.remarks: Expands to a call to AnimationSelectorTable::RegisterAnimationSelectorTableEvaluator, so the animation selector table system must be loaded first.

macros.name: ATTACHMENT_TABLE_COL_BOT_PROB
macros.description: Attachment table column holding the relative probability that a bot picks the attachment.
macros.example: prob += Int( TableLookupColumnForRow( csv_filename, row, ATTACHMENT_TABLE_COL_BOT_PROB ) );
macros.remarks: Column index into the attachment table used by the bot loadout code, alongside the STATS_TABLE_COL_ indices in the same header.

macros.name: ATTACHMENT_TABLE_COL_GROUP
macros.description: Column index of an attachment's group in the attachment table.
macros.remarks: One of the ATTACHMENT_TABLE_COL_* column indices, which index the attachment table rather than the main stats table.

macros.name: ATTACHMENT_TABLE_COL_NAME
macros.description: Column index of an attachment's name in the attachment table.
macros.remarks: One of the ATTACHMENT_TABLE_COL_* column indices, which index the attachment table rather than the main stats table.

macros.name: ATTACHMENT_TABLE_COL_NUMBERING
macros.description: Attachment table column holding the attachment's unique index.
macros.remarks: Column index into the attachment table used by the bot loadout code, alongside the STATS_TABLE_COL_ indices in the same header.

macros.name: ATTACHMENT_TABLE_COL_TYPE
macros.description: Attachment table column holding the attachment's type.
macros.remarks: Column index into the attachment table used by the bot loadout code, alongside the STATS_TABLE_COL_ indices in the same header.

macros.name: BACK_ANGLE_THRESHOLD
macros.description: Maximum angle in degrees between the two AI for a synchronized melee to count as an attack from behind.
macros.remarks: Paired with FRONT_ANGLE_THRESHOLD.

macros.name: BACK_TYPE
macros.description: Synchronized melee type for an assassination from behind the victim.
macros.remarks: One of the melee type indices FRONT_WRESTLE_TYPE, FRONT_FLIP_TYPE, BACK_TYPE, RIGHT_TYPE and LEFT_TYPE.

macros.name: BANKING_UPDATE_ENABLED
macros.description: Content switch that enables the newer banking and weapon locker behaviour in older Zombies maps.

macros.name: BB_REGISTER_ATTRIBUTE
macros.description: Registers a blackboard attribute on self with a default value and an optional getter function.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Attribute name, normally one of the blackboard attribute macros.

parameters.name: defaultValue
parameters.description: Value the attribute holds until it is set, or undefined.

parameters.name: getter
parameters.description: Function pointer that computes the attribute on demand, or undefined.

macros.remarks: Operates on self, so it must be called on the actor. The expansion calls Blackboard::RegisterBlackBoardAttribute and contains an empty IsActor block.

macros.name: BGB_ACTIVATIONS_REMAINING_CF_NAME
macros.description: Client field name that replicates the number of activations left on the active gum.
macros.remarks: Registered and read as a client field, so the same name is used on the GSC and CSC sides.

macros.name: BGB_ALWAYS_RUN_ADD_TO_PLAYER_SCORE_OVERRIDE
macros.description: Whether the BubbleGum Buff override for adding to player score always runs, even when no gum overrides it.

macros.name: BGB_ALWAYS_RUN_LOST_PERK_OVERRIDE
macros.description: Whether the BubbleGum Buff override for losing a perk always runs, even when no gum overrides it.

macros.name: BGB_BLOW_BUBBLE_CF_NAME
macros.description: Client field name that tells the client to play the bubble blowing effect on a player using a bubblegum bonus.

macros.name: BGB_BLOW_BUBBLE_FX
macros.description: Effect asset played on the player when a bubblegum bonus makes them blow a bubble.

macros.name: BGB_BLOW_BUBBLE_FX_NAME
macros.description: Effect lookup name used to register and play the bubblegum bubble blowing effect.

macros.name: BGB_CURRENT_CF_NAME

macros.remarks: Registered and read as a client field, so the same name is used on the GSC and CSC sides.

macros.name: BGB_DISPLAY_CF_NAME
macros.description: Client field name that replicates the gum shown on the player's HUD.
macros.remarks: Registered and read as a client field, so the same name is used on the GSC and CSC sides.

macros.name: BGB_INVALID_USE_CF_NAME
macros.description: Client field name that replicates an attempt to use a gum that cannot be activated right now.
macros.remarks: Registered and read as a client field, so the same name is used on the GSC and CSC sides.

macros.name: BGB_LIMIT_TYPE_ACTIVATED
macros.description: BubbleGum Buff limit type for a gum that lasts a fixed number of activations.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_LIMIT_TYPE_* strings that say how a gum's uses are counted down.

macros.name: BGB_LIMIT_TYPE_EVENT
macros.description: BubbleGum Buff limit type for a gum that lasts a number of in-game events.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_LIMIT_TYPE_* strings that say how a gum's uses are counted down.

macros.name: BGB_LIMIT_TYPE_ROUNDS
macros.description: BubbleGum Buff limit type for a gum that lasts a number of rounds.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_LIMIT_TYPE_* strings that say how a gum's uses are counted down.

macros.name: BGB_LIMIT_TYPE_TIME
macros.description: BubbleGum Buff limit type for a gum that lasts a duration in time.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_LIMIT_TYPE_* strings that say how a gum's uses are counted down.

macros.name: BGB_ONE_SHOT_USE_CF_NAME
macros.description: Client field name that replicates a single-use gum being consumed.
macros.remarks: Registered and read as a client field, so the same name is used on the GSC and CSC sides.

macros.name: BGB_RARITY_CLASSIC_INDEX
macros.description: Rarity index for classic BubbleGum Buffs.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_RARITY_*_INDEX values; each has a matching BGB_RARITY_*_TAG art tag.

macros.name: BGB_RARITY_CLASSIC_TAG
macros.description: Art tag naming the gum appearance used for classic BubbleGum Buffs.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_RARITY_*_TAG names; each pairs with a BGB_RARITY_*_INDEX value.

macros.name: BGB_RARITY_MEGA_INDEX
macros.description: Rarity index for mega BubbleGum Buffs.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_RARITY_*_INDEX values; each has a matching BGB_RARITY_*_TAG art tag.

macros.name: BGB_RARITY_MEGA_TAG
macros.description: Art tag naming the gum appearance used for mega BubbleGum Buffs.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_RARITY_*_TAG names; each pairs with a BGB_RARITY_*_INDEX value.

macros.name: BGB_RARITY_RARE_INDEX
macros.description: Rarity index for rare BubbleGum Buffs.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_RARITY_*_INDEX values; each has a matching BGB_RARITY_*_TAG art tag.

macros.name: BGB_RARITY_RARE_TAG
macros.description: Art tag naming the gum appearance used for rare BubbleGum Buffs.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_RARITY_*_TAG names; each pairs with a BGB_RARITY_*_INDEX value.

macros.name: BGB_RARITY_ULTRA_RARE_INDEX
macros.description: Rarity index for ultra rare BubbleGum Buffs.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_RARITY_*_INDEX values; each has a matching BGB_RARITY_*_TAG art tag.

macros.name: BGB_RARITY_ULTRA_RARE_TAG
macros.description: Art tag naming the gum appearance used for ultra rare BubbleGum Buffs.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_RARITY_*_TAG names; each pairs with a BGB_RARITY_*_INDEX value.

macros.name: BGB_RARITY_WHIMSICAL_INDEX
macros.description: Rarity index for whimsical BubbleGum Buffs.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_RARITY_*_INDEX values; each has a matching BGB_RARITY_*_TAG art tag.

macros.name: BGB_RARITY_WHIMSICAL_TAG
macros.description: Art tag naming the gum appearance used for whimsical BubbleGum Buffs.
macros.remarks: One of the BGB_RARITY_*_TAG names; each pairs with a BGB_RARITY_*_INDEX value.

macros.name: BGB_RESERVED_NAME
macros.description: Reserved BubbleGum Buff name meaning the player has no gum equipped.
macros.remarks: BGB stands for BubbleGum Buffs.

macros.name: BGB_SKIP_DEMO_BOOKMARK
macros.description: Whether BubbleGum Buff activations skip writing a demo bookmark.

macros.name: BGB_TIMER_CF_NAME
macros.description: Client field name that replicates the remaining time on the active gum.
macros.remarks: Registered and read as a client field, so the same name is used on the GSC and CSC sides.

macros.name: BGB_TIMER_MANUAL_LERP_PERIOD
macros.description: Period in milliseconds used when manually stepping a BubbleGum Buff timer.

macros.name: BGB_TIMER_MANUAL_LERP_THRESHOLD
macros.description: Fractional change in a BubbleGum Buff timer beyond which the HUD timer is stepped manually instead of interpolated.

macros.name: BHTN_ACTION_START
macros.description: Key naming the start callback of a behavior tree action.
macros.remarks: One of BHTN_ACTION_START, BHTN_ACTION_UPDATE and BHTN_ACTION_TERMINATE.

macros.name: BHTN_ACTION_TERMINATE
macros.description: Key naming the terminate callback of a behavior tree action.
macros.remarks: One of BHTN_ACTION_START, BHTN_ACTION_UPDATE and BHTN_ACTION_TERMINATE.

macros.name: BHTN_ACTION_UPDATE
macros.description: Key naming the update callback of a behavior tree action.
macros.remarks: One of BHTN_ACTION_START, BHTN_ACTION_UPDATE and BHTN_ACTION_TERMINATE.

macros.name: BHTN_FAILURE
macros.description: Behavior tree node status meaning the node failed.
macros.remarks: One of the BHTN status codes; their order matters, with BHTN_RUNNING highest.

macros.name: BHTN_INVALID
macros.description: Behavior tree node status meaning no valid status.
macros.remarks: One of the BHTN status codes; their order matters, with BHTN_RUNNING highest.

macros.name: BHTN_RUNNING
macros.description: Behavior tree node status meaning the node is still running.
macros.remarks: Highest of the BHTN status codes, which the tree relies on when comparing statuses.

macros.name: BHTN_SUCCESS
macros.description: Behavior tree node status meaning the node succeeded.
macros.remarks: One of the BHTN status codes; their order matters, with BHTN_RUNNING highest.

macros.name: BHTN_TERMINATE
macros.description: Behavior tree node status requesting that the node terminate.
macros.remarks: One of the BHTN status codes; their order matters, with BHTN_RUNNING highest.

macros.name: BHTN_TERMINATED
macros.description: Behavior tree node status meaning the node has finished terminating.
macros.remarks: One of the BHTN status codes; their order matters, with BHTN_RUNNING highest.

macros.name: BHTN_UPDATE_FREQUENCY
macros.description: Interval, in seconds, between behavior tree updates.

macros.name: BINK_DOUBLE_SIZE
macros.description: Bink video size mode that draws the video at twice its native size.
macros.remarks: One of BINK_NORMAL_SIZE, BINK_DOUBLE_SIZE and BINK_FULLSCREEN.

macros.name: BINK_FULLSCREEN
macros.description: Bink video size mode that stretches the video to fill the screen.
macros.remarks: One of BINK_NORMAL_SIZE, BINK_DOUBLE_SIZE and BINK_FULLSCREEN.

macros.name: BINK_IN_MEMORY
macros.description: Bink video playback argument used with the movie playback functions. Passing it requests that the video is loaded fully into memory.
macros.remarks: A readability alias for true, as are BINK_IS_LOOPING, BINK_START_PAUSED and BINK_SYNC_AUDIO.

macros.name: BINK_IS_LOOPING
macros.description: Bink video playback argument used with the movie playback functions. Passing it requests that the video loops.
macros.remarks: A readability alias for true, as are BINK_IN_MEMORY, BINK_START_PAUSED and BINK_SYNC_AUDIO.

macros.name: BINK_NORMAL_SIZE
macros.description: Bink video size mode that draws the video at its native size.
macros.remarks: One of BINK_NORMAL_SIZE, BINK_DOUBLE_SIZE and BINK_FULLSCREEN.

macros.name: BINK_START_PAUSED
macros.description: Bink video playback argument used with the movie playback functions. Passing it starts the video paused on its first frame.
macros.remarks: A readability alias for true, as are BINK_IS_LOOPING, BINK_IN_MEMORY and BINK_SYNC_AUDIO.

macros.name: BINK_SYNC_AUDIO
macros.description: Bink video playback argument used with the movie playback functions. Passing it keeps the video synchronised to its audio track.
macros.remarks: A readability alias for true, as are BINK_IS_LOOPING, BINK_IN_MEMORY and BINK_START_PAUSED.

macros.description: Button index a bot presses to throw a frag or lethal grenade.
macros.remarks: The bot button script bot_buttons.gsc defines its own BOT_BUTTON_FRAG as 14 for the BotPressButton calls, so the header value of 1 is not the one those calls use.

macros.name: BOT_CAN_SEE_FEET
macros.description: Visibility bit set when a bot can see its target's feet.
macros.remarks: One bit of the visibility mask, with BOT_CAN_SEE_HEAD and BOT_CAN_SEE_TORSO; BOT_CAN_SEE_NOTHING is the empty mask.

macros.name: BOT_CAN_SEE_HEAD
macros.description: Visibility bit set when a bot can see its target's head.
macros.remarks: One bit of the visibility mask, with BOT_CAN_SEE_TORSO and BOT_CAN_SEE_FEET; BOT_CAN_SEE_NOTHING is the empty mask.

macros.name: BOT_CAN_SEE_NOTHING
macros.description: Visibility mask meaning a bot can see none of its target's body parts.
macros.remarks: Zero value of the bit field built from BOT_CAN_SEE_HEAD, BOT_CAN_SEE_TORSO and BOT_CAN_SEE_FEET.

macros.name: BOT_CAN_SEE_TORSO
macros.description: Visibility bit set when a bot can see its target's torso.
macros.remarks: One bit of the visibility mask, with BOT_CAN_SEE_HEAD and BOT_CAN_SEE_FEET; BOT_CAN_SEE_NOTHING is the empty mask.

macros.name: BOT_DEFAULT_GOAL_RADIUS
macros.description: Default radius in world units a bot must reach to count as having arrived at its goal.

macros.name: BOT_FOV_EASY
macros.description: Cosine of the field of view an easy bot can see targets within, 65 degrees.
macros.remarks: Stored as a dot product threshold rather than an angle, so it is compared against the dot of the bot's forward vector and the direction to the target. Larger values mean a narrower cone, so the FU setting is the widest.

macros.name: BOT_FOV_FU
macros.description: Cosine of the field of view a bot on the hardest difficulty can see targets within, 160 degrees.
macros.remarks: Stored as a dot product threshold rather than an angle, and negative because the cone is wider than 90 degrees. This is the widest of the BOT_FOV_ settings.

macros.name: BOT_FOV_HARD
macros.description: Cosine of the field of view a hard bot can see targets within, 100 degrees.
macros.remarks: Stored as a dot product threshold rather than an angle, and negative because the cone is wider than 90 degrees.

macros.name: BOT_FOV_MEDIUM
macros.description: Cosine of the field of view a medium bot can see targets within, 85 degrees.
macros.remarks: Stored as a dot product threshold rather than an angle. Larger values mean a narrower cone, so the FU setting is the widest.

macros.name: BOT_MELEE_RANGE_SQ_EASY
macros.description: Squared distance in units within which a bot will melee its target at the easy bot difficulty.
macros.remarks: One of the BOT_ per difficulty constants (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, FU) selected by the bot's difficulty tier; FU is the hardest tier. The same file is shipped as both scripts/mp/bots/_bot.gsh and scripts/shared/bots/_bot.gsh. The expansion is an unparenthesised product, so it should not be written directly inside a larger expression without parentheses.

macros.name: BOT_MELEE_RANGE_SQ_FU
macros.description: Squared distance in units within which a bot will melee its target at the hardest (FU) bot difficulty.
macros.remarks: One of the BOT_ per difficulty constants (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, FU) selected by the bot's difficulty tier; FU is the hardest tier. The same file is shipped as both scripts/mp/bots/_bot.gsh and scripts/shared/bots/_bot.gsh. The expansion is an unparenthesised product, so it should not be written directly inside a larger expression without parentheses.

macros.name: BOT_MELEE_RANGE_SQ_HARD
macros.description: Squared distance in units within which a bot will melee its target at the hard bot difficulty.
macros.remarks: One of the BOT_ per difficulty constants (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, FU) selected by the bot's difficulty tier; FU is the hardest tier. The same file is shipped as both scripts/mp/bots/_bot.gsh and scripts/shared/bots/_bot.gsh. Matches the medium and FU values. The expansion is an unparenthesised product, so it should not be written directly inside a larger expression without parentheses.

macros.name: BOT_MELEE_RANGE_SQ_MEDIUM
macros.description: Squared distance in units within which a bot will melee its target at the medium bot difficulty.
macros.remarks: One of the BOT_ per difficulty constants (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, FU) selected by the bot's difficulty tier; FU is the hardest tier. The same file is shipped as both scripts/mp/bots/_bot.gsh and scripts/shared/bots/_bot.gsh. The expansion is an unparenthesised product, so it should not be written directly inside a larger expression without parentheses.

macros.name: BOT_PREDICTION_FRAMES
macros.description: Number of server frames ahead a bot predicts its target's movement when aiming.

macros.name: BOT_SNIPER_FIRE_DELAY_EASY
macros.description: Delay in seconds a bot waits before firing a sniper rifle at the easy bot difficulty.
macros.remarks: One of the BOT_ per difficulty constants (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, FU) selected by the bot's difficulty tier; FU is the hardest tier. The same file is shipped as both scripts/mp/bots/_bot.gsh and scripts/shared/bots/_bot.gsh.

macros.name: BOT_SNIPER_FIRE_DELAY_FU
macros.description: Delay in seconds a bot waits before firing a sniper rifle at the hardest (FU) bot difficulty.
macros.remarks: One of the BOT_ per difficulty constants (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, FU) selected by the bot's difficulty tier; FU is the hardest tier. The same file is shipped as both scripts/mp/bots/_bot.gsh and scripts/shared/bots/_bot.gsh.

macros.name: BOT_SNIPER_FIRE_DELAY_HARD
macros.description: Delay in seconds a bot waits before firing a sniper rifle at the hard bot difficulty.
macros.remarks: One of the BOT_ per difficulty constants (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, FU) selected by the bot's difficulty tier; FU is the hardest tier. The same file is shipped as both scripts/mp/bots/_bot.gsh and scripts/shared/bots/_bot.gsh.

macros.name: BOT_SNIPER_FIRE_DELAY_MEDIUM
macros.description: Delay in seconds a bot waits before firing a sniper rifle at the medium bot difficulty.
macros.remarks: One of the BOT_ per difficulty constants (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, FU) selected by the bot's difficulty tier; FU is the hardest tier. The same file is shipped as both scripts/mp/bots/_bot.gsh and scripts/shared/bots/_bot.gsh.

macros.name: BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_EASY
macros.description: Time in seconds between think updates for an easy bot.
macros.remarks: Harder difficulties think more often; see BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_MEDIUM, BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_HARD and BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_FU.

macros.name: BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_FU
macros.description: Interval in seconds between bot think updates at the hardest (FU) bot difficulty.
macros.remarks: One of the BOT_ per difficulty constants (EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, FU) selected by the bot's difficulty tier; FU is the hardest tier. The same file is shipped as both scripts/mp/bots/_bot.gsh and scripts/shared/bots/_bot.gsh.

macros.name: BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_HARD
macros.description: Time in seconds between think updates for a hard bot.
macros.remarks: Harder difficulties think more often; see BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_EASY, BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_MEDIUM and BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_FU.

macros.name: BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_MEDIUM
macros.description: Time in seconds between think updates for a medium bot.
macros.remarks: Harder difficulties think more often; see BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_EASY, BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_HARD and BOT_THINK_INTERVAL_SECS_FU.

macros.name: BOUNCINGBETTY_DEPLOYING
macros.description: State value for a bouncing betty style device (trip mine or spider mine). This state means the device is deploying into its armed position.
macros.remarks: One of BOUNCINGBETTY_INIT, BOUNCINGBETTY_DEPLOYING and BOUNCINGBETTY_DETONATING.

macros.name: BOUNCINGBETTY_DETONATING
macros.description: State value for a bouncing betty style device (trip mine or spider mine). This state means the device has been triggered and is exploding.
macros.remarks: One of BOUNCINGBETTY_INIT, BOUNCINGBETTY_DEPLOYING and BOUNCINGBETTY_DETONATING.

macros.name: BOUNCINGBETTY_INIT
macros.description: State value for a bouncing betty style device (trip mine or spider mine). This is the initial state before the device deploys.
macros.remarks: One of BOUNCINGBETTY_INIT, BOUNCINGBETTY_DEPLOYING and BOUNCINGBETTY_DETONATING.

macros.name: BOXING_ENDGAME_1
macros.description: Animation name for the boxing gloves end of game idle of the first place player.

macros.name: BOXING_ENDGAME_2
macros.description: Animation name for the boxing gloves end of game idle of the second place player.

macros.name: BOXING_ENDGAME_3
macros.description: Animation name for the boxing gloves end of game idle of the third place player.

macros.name: BOXING_ENDGAME_ARRAY
macros.description: Array of the boxing gloves end of game idle animations, indexed by placement.
macros.remarks: Evaluating this macro calls array(), so it builds a new array each time it is written.

macros.name: BRAWLER_ENDGAME_1
macros.description: Player body animation played by the brawler melee loadout on the first place endgame podium.

macros.name: BRAWLER_ENDGAME_2
macros.description: Player body animation played by the brawler melee loadout on the second place endgame podium.

macros.name: BRAWLER_ENDGAME_3
macros.description: Player body animation played by the brawler melee loadout on the third place endgame podium.

macros.name: BRAWLER_ENDGAME_ARRAY
macros.description: Array of the three brawler melee loadout endgame podium idle animations, in first, second and third place order.
macros.remarks: Indexed by the top player index in scripts/shared/end_game_taunts.csc through WEAPON_GROUP_TOP_3_ANIMS.

macros.name: BRAWLER_LOBBY
macros.description: Player body animation that showcases the brawler melee loadout in the lobby and create-a-class frontend.

macros.name: BROWN
macros.description: The colour brown as a normalised RGB vector.
macros.remarks: Defined through RGB, so the 0 to 255 components are divided down to the 0 to 1 range.

macros.name: BSM_DEFAULT
macros.description: Default behavior state machine status, the same as BSM_INVALID.
macros.remarks: Mirrors StateMachineStatus in behavior_state_machine_db.h.

macros.name: BSM_FAILURE
macros.description: Behavior state machine status meaning the state failed.
macros.remarks: Mirrors StateMachineStatus in behavior_state_machine_db.h and matches BHTN_FAILURE.

macros.name: BSM_INVALID
macros.description: Behavior state machine status meaning no valid status.
macros.remarks: Mirrors StateMachineStatus in behavior_state_machine_db.h. BSM_DEFAULT aliases this value.

macros.name: BSM_REGISTER_API
macros.description: Registers a script function as a behavior state machine script API entry under the given name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name the state machine uses to reference the API.

parameters.name: scriptFunction
parameters.description: Function pointer to call when the API is evaluated.

macros.remarks: Expands identically to BSM_REGISTER_CONDITION.

macros.name: BSM_REGISTER_CONDITION
macros.description: Registers a script function as a behavior state machine condition under the given name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name the state machine uses to reference the condition.

parameters.name: scriptFunction
parameters.description: Function pointer evaluated for the condition.

macros.remarks: Expands identically to BSM_REGISTER_API.

macros.name: BSM_RUNNING
macros.description: Behavior state machine status meaning the state is still running.
macros.remarks: Mirrors StateMachineStatus in behavior_state_machine_db.h and matches BHTN_RUNNING.

macros.name: BSM_STATE_FUNC_START
macros.description: Key naming the start function of a behavior state machine state.
macros.remarks: One of BSM_STATE_FUNC_START, BSM_STATE_FUNC_UPDATE and BSM_STATE_FUNC_TERMINATE.

macros.name: BSM_STATE_FUNC_TERMINATE
macros.description: Key naming the terminate function of a behavior state machine state.
macros.remarks: One of BSM_STATE_FUNC_START, BSM_STATE_FUNC_UPDATE and BSM_STATE_FUNC_TERMINATE.

macros.name: BSM_STATE_FUNC_UPDATE
macros.description: Key naming the update function of a behavior state machine state.
macros.remarks: One of BSM_STATE_FUNC_START, BSM_STATE_FUNC_UPDATE and BSM_STATE_FUNC_TERMINATE.

macros.name: BSM_SUCCESS
macros.description: Behavior state machine status meaning the state succeeded.
macros.remarks: Mirrors StateMachineStatus in behavior_state_machine_db.h and matches BHTN_SUCCESS.

macros.name: BSM_UNUSED1
macros.description: Unused behavior state machine status value, reserved so the status codes line up with the behavior tree ones.
macros.remarks: Matches BHTN_TERMINATE numerically. Mirrors StateMachineStatus in behavior_state_machine_db.h.

macros.name: BSM_UNUSED2
macros.description: Unused behavior state machine status value, reserved so the status codes line up with the behavior tree ones.
macros.remarks: Matches BHTN_TERMINATED numerically. Mirrors StateMachineStatus in behavior_state_machine_db.h.

macros.name: BT_REGISTER_ACTION
macros.description: Registers a behavior tree action with its start, update and terminate callbacks.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the action node in the behavior tree.

parameters.name: initFunction
parameters.description: Function pointer called when the action starts, or undefined.

parameters.name: updateFunction
parameters.description: Function pointer called each action update, or undefined.

parameters.name: terminateFunction
parameters.description: Function pointer called when the action terminates, or undefined.

macros.name: BT_REGISTER_ACTION_SIMPLE
macros.description: Registers a behavior tree action that has no script callbacks, so the tree can reference the node by name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the action node in the behavior tree.

macros.remarks: Passes undefined for all three callbacks of BT_REGISTER_ACTION.

macros.name: BT_REGISTER_API
macros.description: Registers a script function as a behavior tree script API entry under the given name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name the behavior tree uses to reference the API.

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: Function pointer to call when the API is evaluated.

macros.name: BUILDABLE_SLOT_DEFAULT
macros.description: The default buildable slot index used when a buildable does not specify one.

macros.name: BURN_BODY
macros.description: Burn state value that plays the full body fire effect on a living AI.
macros.remarks: One of the values written to the AI fire effect clientfield, alongside BURN_CLEAR, BURN_CORPSE and BURN_SMOLDER.

macros.name: BURN_CLEAR
macros.description: Burn state value that clears the AI fire effect.
macros.remarks: One of the values written to the AI fire effect clientfield, alongside BURN_BODY, BURN_CORPSE and BURN_SMOLDER.

macros.name: BURN_CORPSE
macros.description: Burn state value that plays the burning effect on an AI corpse.
macros.remarks: One of the values written to the AI fire effect clientfield, alongside BURN_CLEAR, BURN_BODY and BURN_SMOLDER.

macros.name: BURN_SMOLDER
macros.description: Burn state value that plays the smoldering effect left after a fire has burned out.
macros.remarks: One of the values written to the AI fire effect clientfield, alongside BURN_CLEAR, BURN_BODY and BURN_CORPSE.

macros.name: BUTTON_ADS
macros.description: Button index used when scripts query or bind a specific action button. This is the aim down sights button.
macros.remarks: One of the button indices BUTTON_USE through BUTTON_LEFT.

macros.name: BUTTON_ATTACK
macros.description: Button index used when scripts query or bind a specific action button. This is the fire button.
macros.remarks: One of the button indices BUTTON_USE through BUTTON_LEFT.

macros.name: BUTTON_DOWN
macros.description: Button index used when scripts query or bind a specific action button. This is the down button.
macros.remarks: Marked dev only in shared.gsh, so it is not expected to be used by shipping script.

macros.name: BUTTON_LEFT
macros.description: Button index used when scripts query or bind a specific action button. This is the left button.
macros.remarks: One of the button indices BUTTON_USE through BUTTON_LEFT.

macros.name: BUTTON_RIGHT
macros.description: Button index used when scripts query or bind a specific action button. This is the right button.
macros.remarks: One of the button indices BUTTON_USE through BUTTON_LEFT.

macros.name: BUTTON_STANCE
macros.description: Button index used when scripts query or bind a specific action button. This is the stance (crouch and prone) button.
macros.remarks: One of the button indices BUTTON_USE through BUTTON_LEFT.

macros.name: BUTTON_UP
macros.description: Button index used when scripts query or bind a specific action button. This is the up button.
macros.remarks: Marked dev only in shared.gsh, so it is not expected to be used by shipping script.

macros.name: BUTTON_USE
macros.description: Button index used when scripts query or bind a specific action button. This is the use button.
macros.remarks: One of the button indices BUTTON_USE through BUTTON_LEFT.

macros.name: CF_CALLBACK_ZERO_ON_NEW_ENT
macros.description: Clientfield registration flag that makes the field's callback fire with a value of zero when the field is attached to a new entity.
macros.remarks: Passed as the last argument of clientfield::register, often negated as !CF_CALLBACK_ZERO_ON_NEW_ENT.

macros.name: CF_HOST_ONLY
macros.description: Clientfield registration flag meaning the field is only sent to the listen server host. Most registrations pass !CF_HOST_ONLY to send the field to every client.
macros.remarks: Passed as the host-only argument of clientfield::register, usually negated.

macros.name: CF_OCTOBOMB_EXPLODE_FX
macros.description: Client field value selecting the Octobomb explosion effect.
macros.remarks: One of the CF_OCTOBOMB_* client field values written to the Octobomb effect client field.

macros.name: CF_OCTOBOMB_FX
macros.description: Client field value selecting the standard Octobomb effect.
macros.remarks: One of the CF_OCTOBOMB_* client field values written to the Octobomb effect client field.

macros.name: CF_OCTOBOMB_UG_FX
macros.description: Client field value selecting the upgraded Octobomb effect.
macros.remarks: One of the CF_OCTOBOMB_* client field values written to the Octobomb effect client field.

macros.name: CF_TOGGLE_LIGHTS_FORCE_ALLIES
macros.description: Value of the "toggle_lights" client field that forces the allies lighting state.
macros.remarks: One of the CF_TOGGLE_LIGHTS_* client field values (0 to 3).

macros.name: CF_TOGGLE_LIGHTS_FORCE_AXIS
macros.description: Value of the "toggle_lights" client field that forces the axis lighting state.
macros.remarks: One of the CF_TOGGLE_LIGHTS_* client field values (0 to 3).

macros.name: CF_TOGGLE_LIGHTS_OFF
macros.description: Value of the "toggle_lights" client field that turns the lights off.
macros.remarks: One of the CF_TOGGLE_LIGHTS_* client field values (0 to 3).

macros.name: CF_TOGGLE_LIGHTS_ON
macros.description: Value of the "toggle_lights" client field that turns the lights on.
macros.remarks: One of the CF_TOGGLE_LIGHTS_* client field values (0 to 3).

macros.name: CF_WIDOWS_WINE_WRAP
macros.description: Name of the clientfield that drives the Widow's Wine wrapping effect on an enemy.

macros.name: CHAINSAW_ENDGAME_2

macros.name: CHAINSAW_ENDGAME_3
macros.description: Player body animation played by the chainsaw on the third place endgame podium.
macros.remarks: Stock defines this as the first place idle animation, which appears to be a copy and paste slip in the header.

macros.name: CHAINSAW_ENDGAME_ARRAY
macros.description: Array of the three chainsaw endgame podium idle animations, in first, second and third place order.
macros.remarks: Indexed by the top player index in scripts/shared/end_game_taunts.csc through WEAPON_GROUP_TOP_3_ANIMS.

macros.name: CHAINSAW_LOBBY
macros.description: Player body animation that showcases the chainsaw in the lobby and create-a-class frontend.

macros.name: CHAR_CLEAR
macros.description: Char state value that removes any burn charring from the AI material.
macros.remarks: One of the AI charring levels, alongside CHAR_RAMP and CHAR_FULL.

macros.name: CHAR_FULL
macros.description: Char state value that applies full charring to the AI material.
macros.remarks: One of the AI charring levels, alongside CHAR_CLEAR and CHAR_RAMP.

macros.name: CHAR_RAMP
macros.description: Char state value that ramps the AI charring in over time.
macros.remarks: One of the AI charring levels, alongside CHAR_CLEAR and CHAR_FULL.

macros.name: CHARGE_RANGE_SQ_VS_PLAYER
macros.description: Squared distance within which an actor will charge a player to melee.
macros.remarks: Also used as MELEE_RANGE_MAX_SQ, the outer limit for attempting a melee.

macros.name: CHEMICALGEL_SPLAT_DURATION_MAX
macros.description: Maximum time in seconds that a chemical gel splat from the hive gun lingers.

macros.name: CLAMP
macros.description: Clamps a variable in place so that it is no less than a minimum and no greater than a maximum.

parameters.name: __var
parameters.description: The variable to clamp; it is assigned in place.

parameters.name: __min
parameters.description: The lower bound.

parameters.name: __max
parameters.description: The upper bound.

macros.remarks: Expands to statements rather than an expression, so the first argument must be an assignable variable. See also CLAMP_MIN and CLAMP_MAX.

macros.name: CLAMP_MAX
macros.description: Clamps a variable in place so that it does not exceed a maximum.

parameters.name: __var
parameters.description: The variable to clamp; it is assigned in place.

parameters.name: __max
parameters.description: The upper bound.

macros.remarks: Expands to statements rather than an expression, so the first argument must be an assignable variable.

macros.name: CLAMP_MIN
macros.description: Clamps a variable in place so that it does not fall below a minimum.

parameters.name: __var
parameters.description: The variable to clamp; it is assigned in place.

parameters.name: __min
parameters.description: The lower bound.

macros.remarks: Expands to statements rather than an expression, so the first argument must be an assignable variable.

macros.name: CLIENTFIELD_BUILDABLE_PIECE_ELECTRIC_TRAP_BATTERY

macros.name: CLIENTFIELD_BUILDABLE_PIECE_ELECTRIC_TRAP_COIL
macros.description: Buildable piece clientfield value identifying the electric trap coil.

macros.name: COVER_EXPOSED
macros.description: Cover type value for an exposed node, which gives the AI a position but no protection.

macros.name: COVER_FRONT_DIRECTION
macros.description: Cover direction value meaning the AI is working from the front of its cover.

macros.name: COVER_GUARD
macros.description: Cover type value for a guard node, where the AI holds position and watches.
macros.remarks: Unlike the other cover type values this expands to the capitalised node type name used by the engine.

macros.name: COVER_LEAN_MODE
macros.description: Cover mode value meaning the AI is leaning out of its cover.

macros.name: COVER_LEFT
macros.description: Cover type value for a cover node the AI leans left out of.

macros.name: COVER_LEFT_DIRECTION
macros.description: Cover direction value meaning the AI is working from the left side of its cover.

macros.name: COVER_LEFT_OFFSET
macros.description: Local offset from a left cover node used as the eye position for enemy visibility checks.

macros.name: COVER_LEFT_YAW_OFFSET
macros.description: Yaw offset, in degrees, applied to an actor standing at a left cover node.
macros.remarks: Paired with COVER_RIGHT_YAW_OFFSET and COVER_PILLAR_YAW_OFFSET.

macros.name: COVER_MODE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for how the AI is currently using its cover, for example leaning or shooting over it.
macros.remarks: Values are the COVER_*_MODE strings defined in the same header, plus COVER_MODE_NONE. The previous value is kept in PREVIOUS_COVER_MODE.

macros.name: COVER_MODE_LEAN
macros.description: Cover mode string for leaning out of cover to shoot.
macros.remarks: Counterpart of COVER_MODE_OVER.

macros.name: COVER_MODE_NONE
macros.description: Cover mode value meaning the AI is not doing anything with its cover.

macros.name: COVER_MODE_OVER
macros.description: Cover mode string for shooting over cover.
macros.remarks: Counterpart of COVER_MODE_LEAN.

macros.name: COVER_NONE
macros.description: Cover type value meaning the AI is not at a cover node.

macros.name: COVER_OVER_MODE
macros.description: Cover mode value meaning the AI is shooting over the top of its cover.

macros.name: COVER_PATH
macros.description: Cover type value for a plain path node, which offers no cover.
macros.remarks: Unlike the other cover type values this expands to the capitalised node type name used by the engine.

macros.name: COVER_PILLAR
macros.description: Cover type value for a pillar cover node, which the AI can lean out of either side of.

macros.name: COVER_PILLAR_LEFT_OFFSET
macros.description: Local offset used as the eye position when an actor leans left at a pillar cover node.

macros.name: COVER_PILLAR_RIGHT_OFFSET
macros.description: Local offset used as the eye position when an actor leans right at a pillar cover node.

macros.name: COVER_PILLAR_YAW_OFFSET
macros.description: Yaw offset, in degrees, applied to an actor standing at a pillar cover node.
macros.remarks: Paired with COVER_LEFT_YAW_OFFSET and COVER_RIGHT_YAW_OFFSET.

macros.name: COVER_RIGHT
macros.description: Cover type value for a cover node the AI leans right out of.

macros.name: COVER_RIGHT_DIRECTION
macros.description: Cover direction value meaning the AI is working from the right side of its cover.

macros.name: COVER_RIGHT_OFFSET
macros.description: Local offset from a right cover node used as the eye position for enemy visibility checks.

macros.name: COVER_RIGHT_YAW_OFFSET
macros.description: Yaw offset, in degrees, applied to an actor standing at a right cover node.
macros.remarks: Paired with COVER_LEFT_YAW_OFFSET and COVER_PILLAR_YAW_OFFSET.

macros.name: COVER_SCAN_MODE
macros.description: Cover mode value meaning the AI is scanning from its cover.

macros.name: COVER_SHOOT_MIN_TIME
macros.description: Minimum time, in milliseconds, an actor spends shooting from cover.

macros.name: COVER_SHOOT_TAKEDOWN_TIME
macros.description: Time, in milliseconds, an actor keeps shooting from cover while trying to take down its target.

macros.name: COVER_STAND
macros.description: Cover type value for a standing cover node.

macros.name: COVER_STAND_OFFSET
macros.description: Local offset from a stand cover node used as the eye position for enemy visibility checks.

macros.name: COVER_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the type of cover the AI is currently using.
macros.remarks: Values are the COVER_* strings defined in the same header, such as COVER_CROUCH, COVER_STAND and COVER_PILLAR.

macros.name: COVER_TYPE_CONCEALED
macros.description: Cover concealment value meaning the AI is concealed in its cover.

macros.name: COVER_TYPE_UNCONCEALED
macros.description: Cover concealment value meaning the AI is not concealed in its cover.

macros.name: COVER_VANTAGE_MODE
macros.description: Cover mode value meaning the AI is using its cover as a vantage point.

macros.name: CQB_ENDGAME_1
macros.description: Player body animation played by the close quarters (shotgun) weapon group on the first place endgame podium.

macros.name: CQB_ENDGAME_2
macros.description: Player body animation played by the close quarters (shotgun) weapon group on the second place endgame podium.

macros.name: CQB_ENDGAME_3
macros.description: Player body animation played by the close quarters (shotgun) weapon group on the third place endgame podium.

macros.name: CQB_ENDGAME_ARRAY
macros.description: Array of the three close quarters (shotgun) weapon group endgame podium idle animations, in first, second and third place order.
macros.remarks: Indexed by the top player index in scripts/shared/end_game_taunts.csc through WEAPON_GROUP_TOP_3_ANIMS.

macros.name: CQB_LOBBY
macros.description: Player body animation that showcases the close quarters (shotgun) weapon group in the lobby and create-a-class frontend.

macros.name: CRAFTABLE_INVALID_CHOICE
macros.description: Sentinel meaning no craftable has been chosen at a crafting table.

macros.name: CRAFTABLE_IS_SHARED
macros.description: Flag value marking a craftable piece as part of the shared team inventory.

macros.name: CRAFTABLE_NEED_ALL_PIECES
macros.description: Flag value requiring a player to hold every piece before the craftable can be built.

macros.name: CRAFTABLE_OBTAINED
macros.description: Flag value marking a craftable piece as already obtained, used when tracking shared pieces.
macros.remarks: The stock header comments this as being used for shared pieces.

macros.name: CURRENT_LOCATION_COVER_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the type of cover at the AI's current position, whether or not it is using it.

macros.name: CUSTOM_BUILD_THINK
macros.description: Buildable persistence mode that routes the built piece to a custom think routine.
macros.remarks: Set the routine with bpstub_set_custom_think_callback rather than adding new persistence values. Part of the group with UNBUILD, ONE_USE_AND_FLY, PERSISTENT and ONE_TIME_BUILD.

macros.name: CUSTOMIZATION_INVALID_PAINTJOB_INDEX
macros.description: Paintjob index that means no valid paintjob is selected.
macros.remarks: Must match CustomizationPaintjobInvalidID in Lua_CoD_EnumDefinitions.h.

macros.name: CUSTOMIZATION_INVALID_PAINTJOB_SLOT
macros.description: Paintjob slot that means no valid paintjob slot is selected.
macros.remarks: Must match CustomizationPaintjobInvalidID in Lua_CoD_EnumDefinitions.h.

macros.name: CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_CONVEX_HULL
macros.description: Silhouette cutting detail level that uses a convex hull of the model.
macros.remarks: One of the silhouette cutting detail levels (CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_OBB, CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_CONVEX_HULL, CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_EXPENSIVE_FULL); the values mirror an engine enum.

macros.name: CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_EXPENSIVE_FULL
macros.description: Silhouette cutting detail level that uses full geometry, the most expensive option.
macros.remarks: One of the silhouette cutting detail levels (CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_OBB, CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_CONVEX_HULL, CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_EXPENSIVE_FULL); the values mirror an engine enum.

macros.name: CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_OBB
macros.description: Silhouette cutting detail level that uses an oriented bounding box, the cheapest option.
macros.remarks: One of the silhouette cutting detail levels (CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_OBB, CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_CONVEX_HULL, CUTTING_DETAIL_LEVEL_EXPENSIVE_FULL); the values mirror an engine enum.

macros.name: CYAN
macros.description: The colour cyan as a normalised RGB vector.

macros.name: CYBERCOM_ABILITIES_PER_WHEEL
macros.description: Number of CyberCore ability slots shown on one selection wheel.

macros.name: CYBERCOM_STATS_END_INDEX
macros.description: Last stats table item index used by CyberCore (Cybercom) abilities.
macros.remarks: Paired with CYBERCOM_STATS_START_INDEX to iterate the Cybercom range of the stats table.

macros.name: CYBERCOM_STATS_START_INDEX
macros.description: First stats table item index used by CyberCore (Cybercom) abilities.
macros.remarks: Paired with CYBERCOM_STATS_END_INDEX to iterate the Cybercom range of the stats table.

macros.name: DAMAGE_DIRECTION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the direction the AI's last damage came from, relative to its facing.
macros.remarks: Values are DAMAGE_DIRECTION_FRONT, DAMAGE_DIRECTION_LEFT, DAMAGE_DIRECTION_BACK and DAMAGE_DIRECTION_RIGHT.

macros.name: DAMAGE_DIRECTION_BACK
macros.description: Damage direction value meaning the actor was hit from behind.
macros.remarks: One of the DAMAGE_DIRECTION_* values (front, left, back, right).

macros.name: DAMAGE_DIRECTION_FRONT
macros.description: Damage direction value meaning the actor was hit from the front.
macros.remarks: One of the DAMAGE_DIRECTION_* values (front, left, back, right).

macros.name: DAMAGE_DIRECTION_LEFT
macros.description: Damage direction value meaning the actor was hit from the left.
macros.remarks: One of the DAMAGE_DIRECTION_* values (front, left, back, right).

macros.name: DAMAGE_DIRECTION_RIGHT
macros.description: Damage direction value meaning the actor was hit from the right.
macros.remarks: One of the DAMAGE_DIRECTION_* values (front, left, back, right).

macros.name: DAMAGE_HEAVY
macros.description: Blackboard damage weight value marking a hit as heavy damage.
macros.remarks: Paired with DAMAGE_LIGHT; the classification uses HEAVY_DAMAGE_RATIO.

macros.name: DAMAGE_LIGHT
macros.description: Blackboard damage weight value marking a hit as light damage.
macros.remarks: Paired with DAMAGE_HEAVY.

macros.name: DAMAGE_LOCATION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the body hit location of the damage the AI last took, used to pick pain reactions.
macros.remarks: Values are the HITLOC_* strings defined in the same header.

macros.name: DAMAGE_MOD
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the means of death of the damage the AI last took.

macros.name: DAMAGE_TAKEN
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for how severe the damage the AI last took was.
macros.remarks: Values are DAMAGE_HEAVY and DAMAGE_LIGHT, chosen by comparing the damage against HEAVY_DAMAGE_RATIO of the AI's health.

macros.name: DAMAGE_WEAPON
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the weapon that last damaged the AI.

macros.name: DAMAGE_WEAPON_CLASS
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the weapon class of the weapon that last damaged the AI.

macros.name: DART_DURATION
macros.description: Lifetime of the dart remote drone killstreak, in milliseconds.

macros.name: DART_EXPLOSION_CAM_DISTANCE
macros.description: Distance the death camera is pulled back from the dart's explosion.

macros.name: DART_EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_MAX
macros.description: Maximum damage dealt by the dart's explosion at its centre.

macros.name: DART_EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_MIN
macros.description: Minimum damage dealt by the dart's explosion at the edge of its blast.

macros.name: DART_HACKER_TOOL_DURATION
macros.description: Time in milliseconds the hacker gadget must be held to hack a dart.

macros.name: DART_HACKER_TOOL_RADIUS
macros.description: Radius within which the hacker gadget can target a deployed dart.

macros.name: DART_HIDE_COMPASS_ON_REMOTE_CONTROL
macros.description: Whether the compass (minimap) is hidden while the player remote controls the dart.
macros.remarks: One of a group of HIDE_COMPASS_ON_REMOTE_CONTROL switches, one per remote controlled killstreak.

macros.name: DART_MAX_HEIGHT_OFFSET
macros.description: Height above the map's qrdrone_height node at which the dart is considered out of range and shuts down.

macros.name: DART_MAX_SHOT_COUNT
macros.description: Number of shots the dart drone may fire before it is spent.

macros.name: DART_VEHICLE_NAME
macros.description: Vehicle archetype name of the Dart killstreak's drone.

macros.name: DART_VISIONSET_ALIAS
macros.description: Visionset alias applied while the player controls the dart.

macros.name: DART_WATCH_TIME
macros.description: Time in seconds the owner watches the dart's death before the killstreak hands control back.

macros.name: DEADSHOT_MACHINE_ACTIVE_MODEL
macros.description: The model used for the Deadshot Daiquiri vending machine once it is powered and usable.

macros.name: DEADSHOT_MACHINE_DISABLED_MODEL
macros.description: The model used for the Deadshot Daiquiri vending machine while it is unpowered or disabled.

macros.name: DEADSHOT_MACHINE_LIGHT_FX
macros.description: The name of the light effect played on the Deadshot Daiquiri vending machine.

macros.name: DEADSHOT_PERK_BOTTLE_WEAPON
macros.description: The weapon name of the Deadshot Daiquiri perk bottle the player drinks when buying the perk.

macros.name: DEADSHOT_PERK_COST
macros.description: The point cost of buying Deadshot Daiquiri from its vending machine.

macros.name: DEADSHOT_RADIANT_MACHINE_NAME
macros.description: The Radiant targetname that identifies the Deadshot Daiquiri vending machine in a level.

macros.name: DEADSHOT_SHADER
macros.description: The HUD shader drawn on the perk icon while the player has Deadshot Daiquiri.

macros.name: DEFAULT
macros.description: Assigns a fallback value to a variable when it is undefined, leaving it untouched otherwise. It is the standard way stock scripts fill in optional function parameters.

parameters.name: __var
parameters.description: The variable to fill in; it is assigned only when undefined.

parameters.name: __default
parameters.description: The value to assign when the variable is undefined.

macros.remarks: Expands to a statement, not an expression. Use VAL when a value is needed inside a larger expression.

macros.name: DEFAULT2
macros.description: Assigns a fallback to a variable when it is undefined, preferring the first fallback and using the second only if the first is itself undefined.

parameters.name: __var
parameters.description: The variable to fill in; it is assigned only when undefined.

parameters.name: __default1
parameters.description: The preferred fallback value.

parameters.name: __default2
parameters.description: The fallback used when the preferred one is undefined.

macros.remarks: Expands to a statement, not an expression. See DEFAULT for the single fallback form.

macros.name: DEFAULT_ARRIVAL_YAW
macros.description: Facing yaw used on arrival when no arrival yaw has been specified.

macros.name: DEFAULT_CONNECTION_SCORE
macros.description: Score given to a state machine connection when none is supplied.
macros.remarks: Used with CONNECTION_TYPE_UTILITY connections.

macros.name: DEFAULT_DESIRED_ARRIVAL_DISTANCE
macros.description: Desired stopping distance from the goal used when none has been specified.

macros.name: DEFAULT_MOVEMENT_STANCE
macros.description: Stance used for movement when no movement stance has been chosen, standing.
macros.remarks: Expands to the same value as STANCE_STAND.

macros.name: DEFAULT_STANCE
macros.description: Stance an archetype starts in when no stance has been set, standing.
macros.remarks: Expands to the same value as STANCE_STAND.

macros.name: DEFAULT_WEAPON
macros.description: Weapon class name an archetype falls back to when no weapon has been assigned, the rifle class.

macros.name: DELAY_MACHINE_TIMEOUT
macros.description: Seconds the random perk machine stays active before it times out.

macros.name: DELAY_POST_PORTAL_EFFECT
macros.description: Seconds to wait after the random perk machine's portal effect ends before the lingering electricity ends.

macros.name: DELAY_PRE_PORTAL_EFFECT
macros.description: Seconds to wait after the random perk machine's electrical activation effect starts before the portal effect begins.

macros.name: DELAY_UNTIL_BOTTLE_IN_PLACE
macros.description: Seconds between the perk bottle visually spawning and it becoming available for the player to grab.

macros.name: DELAY_UNTIL_BOTTLE_SPAWN
macros.description: Seconds between triggering the random perk machine and the perk bottle appearing.

macros.name: DELETE
macros.description: Tears down a script object by notifying "death" so its threads end, then clearing the variable that held it.

parameters.name: __obj
parameters.description: The variable holding the script object to release.

macros.remarks: Expands to two statements. It only clears the variable it was given, so other references to the object stay defined. For entities use DELETE_IF_DEFINED instead.

macros.name: DELETE_AGGRESSIVE
macros.description: Auto delete flag telling util::auto_delete to remove the entity under the same conditions as DELETE_BOTH but on a quicker check.
macros.remarks: One of the DELETE_* bit flags (1, 2, 4, 8, 16) used with util::auto_delete.

macros.name: DELETE_BEHIND
macros.description: Auto delete flag telling util::auto_delete to remove the entity when the entity is behind the player.
macros.remarks: One of the DELETE_* bit flags (1, 2, 4, 8, 16) used with util::auto_delete.

macros.name: DELETE_BLOCKED
macros.description: Auto delete flag telling util::auto_delete to remove the entity when the entity is blocked from the player's sight.
macros.remarks: One of the DELETE_* bit flags (1, 2, 4, 8, 16) used with util::auto_delete.

macros.name: DELETE_BOTH
macros.description: Auto delete flag telling util::auto_delete to remove the entity when the entity is either behind the player or blocked from sight.
macros.remarks: One of the DELETE_* bit flags (1, 2, 4, 8, 16) used with util::auto_delete.

macros.name: DELETE_IF_DEFINED
macros.description: Deletes an entity if it is still defined, avoiding an error on an already removed entity.

parameters.name: __ent
parameters.description: The entity to delete.

macros.remarks: Expands to a statement, not an expression, and does not clear the variable it was passed.

macros.name: DELETE_SAFE
macros.description: Auto delete flag telling util::auto_delete to remove the entity only when the entity is both behind the player and blocked from sight.
macros.remarks: One of the DELETE_* bit flags (1, 2, 4, 8, 16) used with util::auto_delete.

macros.name: DELETE_TRIGGER
macros.description: Passed to a buildable or craftable trigger think call to delete the trigger once the item is built.
macros.example: zm_craftables::craftable_trigger_think( "riotshield_zm_craftable_trigger", level.craftable_shield_equipment, level.craftable_shield_weapon, level.craftable_shield_grab, DELETE_TRIGGER, PERSISTENT );
macros.remarks: Defined identically in the buildables and craftables headers; the opposite value is KEEP_TRIGGER.

macros.name: DEMPSEY_CHAR_INDEX
macros.description: Character index used for Dempsey when selecting vox aliases.
macros.remarks: The *_CHAR_INDEX_R variants order Takeo and Richtofen differently for response lines.

macros.name: DEMPSEY_CHAR_INDEX_R
macros.description: Character index used for Dempsey when selecting response vox aliases.
macros.remarks: Takeo and Richtofen are swapped relative to the plain *_CHAR_INDEX values, so the response tables are indexed with these instead.

macros.name: DESIRED_STANCE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding the stance the actor wants to move to.

macros.name: DESTRUCT_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the client field that replicates a destructible character's destruction state to clients.

macros.name: DESTRUCT_CLIENTFIELD_BITS
macros.description: Bit width of the destructible character state client field.
macros.remarks: Twenty bits cover the twenty destructible pieces, plus one toggle bit that tells the client whether spawning gib models should happen (used to pre-damage characters as they spawn in).

macros.name: DESTRUCT_CLIENTFIELD_TYPE
macros.description: Client field type used when registering the destructible character state field.

macros.name: DESTRUCT_MAX_PIECES
macros.description: Maximum number of destructible pieces a destructible character definition may declare.
macros.remarks: Piece numbers start at 1 and stop at this value, which is what IS_VALID_PIECE_NUMBER checks.

macros.name: DESTRUCT_TOGGLE_GIB_MODEL_FLAG
macros.description: Destruction state bit that tells the client whether to spawn gib models for the pieces that were destroyed.
macros.remarks: Bit 0 of the destruction state; clearing it lets a character be pre-damaged on spawn without spawning gib models. SHOULD_SPAWN_DESTRUCT_GIBS tests this bit.

macros.name: DESTRUCT_UNDAMAGED_FLAG
macros.description: Destruction state value meaning no piece has been destroyed.

macros.name: DESTRUCTIBLE_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the client field that tells the client to play a destructible's explosion.
macros.remarks: Registered on the server in _destructible.gsc and on the client in _destructible.csc, so both sides must use this name and DESTRUCTIBLE_CLIENTFIELD_NUM_BITS.

macros.name: DESTRUCTIBLE_CLIENTFIELD_NUM_BITS
macros.description: Bit width of the destructible explosion client field, which limits the explosion radius it can carry.
macros.remarks: The top bit is used as a sign or flag bit by the send and receive code, so the usable radius is smaller than the full range.

macros.name: DETECTED_LOOP_ALIAS
macros.description: Sound alias looped on a target that has been detected by the vision pulse gadget.

macros.name: DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX
macros.description: Effect alias registered on the client for the direwolf eye glow.
macros.remarks: Loaded from the effect file named by DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_FILE.

macros.name: DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_BITS
macros.description: Bit width used when registering the direwolf eye glow clientfield.
macros.remarks: Passed alongside DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_CLIENTFIELD and DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_TYPE.

macros.name: DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Clientfield name controlling the direwolf eye glow effect.
macros.remarks: Registered with DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_BITS bits and DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_TYPE type.

macros.name: DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_FILE
macros.description: Path of the effect asset used for the direwolf eye glow.
macros.remarks: Registered under the alias DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX.

macros.name: DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the direwolf eye glow effect is played on.

macros.name: DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_TYPE
macros.description: Value type used when registering the direwolf eye glow clientfield.
macros.remarks: Passed alongside DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_CLIENTFIELD and DIREWOLF_EYE_GLOW_FX_BITS.

macros.name: DO_IF_DEFINED
macros.description: Calls a function pointer if it is defined, and does nothing otherwise.

parameters.name: __func
parameters.description: The function pointer to call.

macros.remarks: Expands to a statement, not an expression. The call is unscoped, so it does not run on self. See THREAD_IF_DEFINED for the threaded form.

macros.name: DONT_ARRIVE_AT_GOAL
macros.description: Arrival type value meaning the actor should not play an arrival at its goal.
macros.remarks: Value for the ARRIVAL_TYPE blackboard attribute, opposite ARRIVE_AT_GOAL.

macros.name: DOUBLETAP2_MACHINE_ACTIVE_MODEL
macros.description: The model used for the Double Tap Root Beer 2.0 vending machine once it is powered and usable.

macros.name: DOUBLETAP2_MACHINE_DISABLED_MODEL
macros.description: The model used for the Double Tap Root Beer 2.0 vending machine while it is unpowered or disabled.

macros.name: DOUBLETAP2_MACHINE_LIGHT_FX
macros.description: The name of the light effect played on the Double Tap Root Beer 2.0 vending machine.

macros.name: DOUBLETAP2_PERK_BOTTLE_WEAPON
macros.description: The weapon name of the Double Tap Root Beer 2.0 perk bottle the player drinks when buying the perk.

macros.name: DOUBLETAP2_PERK_COST
macros.description: The point cost of buying Double Tap Root Beer 2.0 from its vending machine.

macros.name: DOUBLETAP2_RADIANT_MACHINE_NAME
macros.description: The Radiant targetname that identifies the Double Tap Root Beer 2.0 vending machine in a level.

macros.name: DOUBLETAP2_SHADER
macros.description: The HUD shader drawn on the perk icon while the player has Double Tap Root Beer 2.0.

macros.name: DPAD_DOWN
macros.description: Direction index for the down d-pad direction.
macros.remarks: One of the DPAD_* direction indices used by zombies dpad driven menus and gestures.

macros.name: DPAD_LEFT
macros.description: Direction index for the left d-pad direction.
macros.remarks: One of the DPAD_* direction indices used by zombies dpad driven menus and gestures.

macros.name: DPAD_RIGHT
macros.description: Direction index for the right d-pad direction.
macros.remarks: One of the DPAD_* direction indices used by zombies dpad driven menus and gestures.

macros.name: DPAD_UP
macros.description: Direction index for the up d-pad direction.
macros.remarks: One of the DPAD_* direction indices used by zombies dpad driven menus and gestures.

macros.name: DR_CULL_ALWAYS
macros.description: Duplicate render cull setting that lets the entity be culled normally.
macros.remarks: Mirrors an engine enum; the header is marked DO NOT EDIT.

macros.name: DR_CULL_NEVER
macros.description: Duplicate render cull setting that stops the entity from being culled out of the duplicate render pass.
macros.remarks: Mirrors an engine enum; the header is marked DO NOT EDIT.

macros.name: DR_METHOD_CUSTOM_MATERIAL
macros.description: Duplicate render method that draws the entity with a custom material.
macros.remarks: Mirrors an engine enum; the header is marked DO NOT EDIT.

macros.name: DR_METHOD_DEFAULT_MATERIAL
macros.description: Duplicate render method that draws the entity with the default duplicate render material.
macros.remarks: Mirrors an engine enum; the header is marked DO NOT EDIT.

macros.name: DR_METHOD_ENEMY_MATERIAL
macros.description: Duplicate render method that draws the entity with the enemy highlight material.
macros.remarks: Mirrors an engine enum; the header is marked DO NOT EDIT.

macros.name: DR_METHOD_OFF
macros.description: Duplicate render method meaning no duplicate rendering is applied.
macros.remarks: Mirrors an engine enum; the header is marked DO NOT EDIT.

macros.name: DR_METHOD_THERMAL_MATERIAL
macros.description: Duplicate render method that draws the entity with the thermal material.
macros.remarks: Mirrors an engine enum; the header is marked DO NOT EDIT.

macros.name: DR_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER
macros.description: Duplicate render type that renders into the frame buffer.

macros.name: FOR_TIME
macros.description: Opens a loop that runs for a fixed duration, setting up the timing locals read inside the body (__time__, __time_frac__ and __time_left__). The block must be closed with FOR_TIME_LOOP, which performs the wait and the loop control.

parameters.name: ___time_length___
parameters.description: How long the loop should run, in seconds.

parameters.name: ___do_last_step___
parameters.description: Whether to run one extra iteration after the time has elapsed.

macros.remarks: The expansion leaves an open brace, so FOR_TIME and FOR_TIME_LOOP must always be used as a matched pair. It declares several reserved locals, so those names must not be reused in the enclosing function.

macros.name: FOR_TIME_LOOP
macros.description: Closes a FOR_TIME block, waiting up to the given step length, refreshing the timing locals and ending the loop once the duration has elapsed.

parameters.name: __time_step__
parameters.description: The maximum wait between iterations, in seconds; the final step is shortened to fit the remaining time.

definitions.expansion: __TIME_UPDATE__ __time_this_step__ = Min( __time_step__, __time_left__ ); if ( __time_this_step__ > 0 ) { wait __time_this_step__; __TIME_UPDATE__ } if ( __time_left__ > 0 ) { continue; } if ( __do_last_step__ ) { __do_last_step__ = false; continue; } break; }

macros.remarks: Contains a wait, so it may only be used in a threaded context. Must be preceded by a matching FOR_TIME, whose open brace it closes.
