macros.name: GET_DESTRUCT_BUNDLE
macros.description: Returns the destructiblecharacterdef script bundle named by an entity's destructibledef field.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity whose destructibledef names the bundle.

macros.remarks: Expands to a function call, so it does real work each time it is written. Check HAS_DESTRUCT_DEF first.

macros.name: GET_DESTRUCT_BUNDLES
macros.description: Returns every destructiblecharacterdef script bundle loaded in the level.
macros.remarks: An object-like macro whose expansion is a function call, so writing the bare name performs a lookup.

macros.name: GET_DESTRUCT_FLAG
macros.description: Returns the destruction state bit for a given destructible piece number.

parameters.name: destruct_piece_number
parameters.description: 1-based index of the destructible piece.

macros.remarks: Piece numbers are 1-based, so bit 0 stays free for DESTRUCT_TOGGLE_GIB_MODEL_FLAG.

macros.name: GET_DESTRUCT_FLAGS
macros.description: Returns the bits that changed between an old and a current destruction state.

parameters.name: old_destruct_state
parameters.description: Previous destruction state bitfield.

parameters.name: current_destruct_state
parameters.description: New destruction state bitfield.

macros.remarks: An exclusive or, so it reports bits that were cleared as well as bits that were set.

macros.name: GET_FX_BUNDLE
macros.description: Returns the fxcharacterdef script bundle with the given name.

parameters.name: bundleName
parameters.description: Name of the fxcharacterdef script bundle to fetch.

macros.remarks: Expands to a function call, so each use performs a bundle lookup.

macros.name: GET_FX_CHARACTER_BUNDLES
macros.description: Returns every fxcharacterdef script bundle loaded in the level.
macros.remarks: An object-like macro whose expansion is a function call, so writing the bare name performs a lookup.

macros.name: GET_GIB_BUNDLE
macros.description: Returns the gibcharacterdef script bundle with the given name.

parameters.name: _gib_def
parameters.description: Name of the gibcharacterdef script bundle to fetch.

macros.remarks: Expands to a function call, so each use performs a bundle lookup. Usable from both client and server scripts.

macros.name: GET_GIB_BUNDLES
macros.description: Returns every gibcharacterdef script bundle loaded in the level.
macros.remarks: An object-like macro whose expansion is a function call, so writing the bare name performs a lookup.

macros.name: GET_GIB_DATA
macros.description: Reads a gib field from an entity, preferring the entity's gib_data struct and falling back to the field on the entity itself.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity carrying the gib data.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Bare field name to read, written without quotes.

macros.remarks: The field argument is pasted directly after a dot, so it must be written as an identifier, not a string.

macros.name: GET_GIB_DIR_BITS
macros.description: Returns the gib direction bits packed into a player's gib state.

parameters.name: gib_state
parameters.description: Packed player gib state.

macros.remarks: Meaningful only on player gib states, which are registered with GIB_CLIENTFIELD_BITS_PLAYER.

macros.name: GET_GIB_FLAG
macros.description: Returns the gib bits that changed between an old and a current gib state.

parameters.name: old_gib_state
parameters.description: Previous gib state bitfield.

parameters.name: current_gib_state
parameters.description: New gib state bitfield.

macros.remarks: An exclusive or, so it reports bits that were cleared as well as bits that were set.

macros.name: GET_GIB_SCALE_BITS
macros.description: Returns the gib scale bits packed into a player's gib state.

parameters.name: gib_state
parameters.description: Packed player gib state.

macros.remarks: Meaningful only on player gib states, which are registered with GIB_CLIENTFIELD_BITS_PLAYER.

macros.name: GET_MELEE_BUNDLES
macros.description: Expands to a call that returns the "aiassassination" script bundles describing the AI versus AI synced melee animations.
macros.remarks: The expansion is a function call, so each use runs struct::get_script_bundles at that point rather than reading a cached value.

macros.name: GET_PITCH
macros.description: Returns the world pitch angle from an entity's origin towards a world position.

parameters.name: __self
parameters.description: The entity to measure from, using its origin (and angles where relevant).

parameters.name: __org
parameters.description: The world position to measure towards.

macros.name: GET_YAW
macros.description: Returns the world yaw angle from an entity's origin towards a world position.

parameters.name: __self
parameters.description: The entity to measure from, using its origin (and angles where relevant).

parameters.name: __org
parameters.description: The world position to measure towards.

macros.example: yawToEnemy = AngleClamp180( entity.angles[ 1 ] - GET_YAW( entity, entity.enemy.origin ) );
macros.remarks: Evaluates VectorToAngles on the difference vector, so the arguments are expanded more than once. The result is absolute, not relative to the entity's facing.

macros.name: GET_YAW2D
macros.description: Returns the yaw from an entity's origin towards a world position, ignoring height by flattening both points to the XY plane.

parameters.name: __self
parameters.description: The entity to measure from, using its origin (and angles where relevant).

parameters.name: __org
parameters.description: The world position to measure towards.

macros.remarks: Use this instead of GET_YAW when a height difference would otherwise skew the yaw.

macros.name: GET_YAW_TO_ORIGIN180
macros.description: Returns the yaw from an entity's current facing to a world position, clamped to the range -180 to 180.

parameters.name: __self
parameters.description: The entity to measure from, using its origin (and angles where relevant).

parameters.name: __org
parameters.description: The world position to measure towards.

macros.remarks: Equivalent to AngleClamp180 of the entity's yaw minus GET_YAW.

macros.name: GETUP_BACK
macros.description: Value of the GETUP_DIRECTION blackboard attribute meaning the AI is on its back.

macros.name: GETUP_BELLY
macros.description: Value of the GETUP_DIRECTION blackboard attribute meaning the AI is face down.

macros.name: GETUP_DIRECTION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding which way up an AI is lying, which selects the getup animation.

macros.name: GIB_ANNIHILATE_FLAG
macros.description: Gib state bit marking the character as annihilated, meaning the whole body is removed rather than individual limbs.
macros.remarks: One of the single-bit gib flags packed into the gib_state client field; the whole set occupies GIB_FLAG_BITS bits.

macros.name: GIB_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the client field that replicates a character's gib state to clients.

macros.name: GIB_CLIENTFIELD_BITS_ACTOR
macros.description: Bit width of the gib state client field when it is registered on actors.
macros.remarks: Actors send the gib flags only. Players use the wider GIB_CLIENTFIELD_BITS_PLAYER, which also carries direction and scale.

macros.name: GIB_CLIENTFIELD_BITS_PLAYER
macros.description: Bit width of the gib state client field when it is registered on players, covering the gib flags plus the packed direction and scale bits.
macros.remarks: Wider than GIB_CLIENTFIELD_BITS_ACTOR because players also replicate the gib direction and scale.

macros.name: GIB_CLIENTFIELD_TYPE
macros.description: Client field type used when registering the gib state field.

macros.name: GIB_DIR_BITS
macros.description: Number of bits used to pack the gib direction, in practice the player's yaw, above the gib flags.
macros.remarks: Only part of the player gib state; actors register the field with GIB_CLIENTFIELD_BITS_ACTOR and carry no direction bits.

macros.name: GIB_FLAG_BITS
macros.description: Number of bits the gib flags occupy at the bottom of the gib state.
macros.remarks: Nine bits cover the individual gib flags from GIB_TOGGLE_GIB_MODEL_FLAG up to GIB_LEGS_LEFT_LEG_FLAG. The gib direction and scale bits are packed above them.

macros.name: GIB_FLAG_STRIPPED
macros.description: Returns just the gib flag bits of a gib state, discarding any packed direction and scale bits above them.

parameters.name: gib_state
parameters.description: Packed gib state to mask.

macros.name: GIB_HAT_MODEL
macros.description: Returns an entity's hat model used when the character's headgear is gibbed off.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity carrying the gib data.

macros.remarks: Wraps GET_GIB_DATA, so it reads the entity's gib_data struct when present and the .hatmodel field on the entity otherwise. Marked server side only in the header.

macros.name: GIB_HEAD_HAT_FLAG
macros.description: Gib state bit marking the character's headgear as gibbed off.
macros.remarks: One of the single-bit gib flags packed into the gib_state client field; the whole set occupies GIB_FLAG_BITS bits.

macros.name: GIB_HEAD_MODEL
macros.description: Returns an entity's head model used when the head is gibbed off.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity carrying the gib data.

macros.remarks: Wraps GET_GIB_DATA, so it reads the entity's gib_data struct when present and the .head field on the entity otherwise. Marked server side only in the header.

macros.name: GIB_LEGS_BOTH_LEGS_FLAG
macros.description: Gib state value with both leg flags set, marking both legs as gibbed off.
macros.remarks: A combination of GIB_LEGS_RIGHT_LEG_FLAG and GIB_LEGS_LEFT_LEG_FLAG rather than a bit of its own.

macros.name: GIB_LEGS_LEFT_LEG_FLAG
macros.description: Gib state bit marking the left leg as gibbed off.
macros.remarks: One of the single-bit gib flags packed into the gib_state client field; the whole set occupies GIB_FLAG_BITS bits.

macros.name: GIB_LEGS_LEFT_LEG_GONE_MODEL
macros.description: Returns an entity's legs model used once the left leg is gone.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity carrying the gib data.

macros.remarks: Wraps GET_GIB_DATA, so it reads the entity's gib_data struct when present and the .legDmg3 field on the entity otherwise. Marked server side only in the header.

macros.name: GIB_LEGS_NO_LEGS_MODEL
macros.description: Returns an entity's legs model used once both legs are gone.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity carrying the gib data.

macros.remarks: Wraps GET_GIB_DATA, so it reads the entity's gib_data struct when present and the .legDmg4 field on the entity otherwise. Marked server side only in the header.

macros.name: GIB_LEGS_RIGHT_LEG_FLAG
macros.description: Gib state bit marking the right leg as gibbed off.
macros.remarks: One of the single-bit gib flags packed into the gib_state client field; the whole set occupies GIB_FLAG_BITS bits.

macros.name: GIB_LEGS_RIGHT_LEG_GONE_MODEL
macros.description: Returns an entity's legs model used once the right leg is gone.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity carrying the gib data.

macros.remarks: Wraps GET_GIB_DATA, so it reads the entity's gib_data struct when present and the .legDmg2 field on the entity otherwise. Marked server side only in the header.

macros.name: GIB_LEGS_UNDAMAGED_MODEL
macros.description: Returns an entity's legs model for undamaged legs.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity carrying the gib data.

macros.remarks: Wraps GET_GIB_DATA, so it reads the entity's gib_data struct when present and the .legDmg1 field on the entity otherwise. Marked server side only in the header.

macros.name: GIB_LOCATION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding the location on the AI that was gibbed, used to select gib reaction animations.

macros.name: GIB_SCALE_BITS
macros.description: Number of bits used to pack the gib scale above the gib flag and direction bits.
macros.remarks: Only part of the player gib state; actors register the field with GIB_CLIENTFIELD_BITS_ACTOR and carry no scale bits.

macros.name: GIB_TORSO_HEAD_FLAG

macros.name: GIB_TORSO_LEFT_ARM_FLAG

macros.remarks: One of the single-bit gib flags packed into the gib_state client field; the whole set occupies GIB_FLAG_BITS bits.

macros.name: GIB_TORSO_LEFT_ARM_GONE_MODEL
macros.description: Returns an entity's torso model used once the left arm is gone.

parameters.name: entity

macros.name: GIB_TORSO_RIGHT_ARM_FLAG
macros.description: Gib state bit marking the right arm as gibbed off.
macros.remarks: One of the single-bit gib flags packed into the gib_state client field; the whole set occupies GIB_FLAG_BITS bits.

macros.name: GIB_TORSO_RIGHT_ARM_GONE_MODEL
macros.description: Returns an entity's torso model used once the right arm is gone.

macros.name: GIB_TORSO_UNDAMAGED_MODEL

macros.name: GIB_UNDAMAGED_FLAG
macros.description: Gib state value meaning the character is completely undamaged.
macros.remarks: One of the single-bit gib flags packed into the gib_state client field; the whole set occupies GIB_FLAG_BITS bits.

macros.name: GIBBED_LIMBS
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding which limbs of a robot AI have been gibbed off.

macros.name: GLAIVE_BLOOD_FX
macros.description: Name of the effect played when a glaive hits a target, looked up in the level effect table.
macros.remarks: Used by the glaive behaviour in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsc.

macros.name: GLAIVE_CHANGE_POSITION_TOATTACK_TARGET_DELAY
macros.description: Delay in seconds before the Glaive changes position to attack its target.
macros.remarks: Tuning constant for the Glaive vehicle in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsh.

macros.name: GLAIVE_FOLLOW_DIST
macros.description: Distance in inches a glaive tries to keep from the target it is following.
macros.remarks: Used by the glaive behaviour in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsc.

macros.name: GLAIVE_FOLLOWING_TARGET_RANGE
macros.description: Maximum range in units at which the Glaive will keep following its target.
macros.remarks: Tuning constant for the Glaive vehicle in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsh.

macros.name: GLAIVE_FOV_ANGLE
macros.description: Field of view half angle in degrees used to test whether the Glaive is in front of its owner.
macros.example: if ( !util::within_fov( self.owner.origin, self.owner.angles, self.origin, cos( GLAIVE_FOV_ANGLE ) ) )
macros.remarks: Tuning constant for the Glaive vehicle in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsh.

macros.name: GLAIVE_IGNORE_ENT_COOLDOWN
macros.description: Time in seconds a glaive ignores an entity after failing to reach or damage it.
macros.remarks: Used by the glaive behaviour in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsc.

macros.name: GLAIVE_MARGWA_AIM_TAG
macros.description: Model tag on the Margwa that a glaive aims at when attacking it.
macros.remarks: Used by the glaive behaviour in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsc.

macros.name: GLAIVE_MAX_TIME_AT_SAME_POSITION
macros.description: Time in seconds the Glaive may stay at the same position before it picks a new one.
macros.remarks: Tuning constant for the Glaive vehicle in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsh.

macros.name: GLAIVE_MELEE_DIST
macros.description: Maximum distance in inches at which a glaive can melee its target.
macros.remarks: Used by the glaive behaviour in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsc.

macros.name: GLAIVE_MOVE_DIST_HEIGHT
macros.description: Maximum vertical distance in units the Glaive moves when repositioning.
macros.remarks: Tuning constant for the Glaive vehicle in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsh.

macros.name: GLAIVE_MOVE_DIST_MAX
macros.description: Maximum horizontal distance in units the Glaive moves when repositioning.
macros.remarks: Tuning constant for the Glaive vehicle in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsh.

macros.name: GLAIVE_NEAR_GOAL_DIST
macros.description: Distance in inches within which a glaive is considered to have reached its goal position.
macros.remarks: Used by the glaive behaviour in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsc.

macros.name: GLAIVE_RADIUS
macros.description: Collision and spacing radius in units used by the Glaive.
macros.remarks: Tuning constant for the Glaive vehicle in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsh.

macros.name: GLAIVE_REPATH_RANGE
macros.description: Distance in inches from its goal at which a glaive recalculates its path.
macros.remarks: Used by the glaive behaviour in scripts/shared/vehicles/_glaive.gsc.

macros.name: GLOBAL_POWER_ONLY
macros.description: Power source mode meaning an item only runs off the global power switch.
macros.remarks: One of the power source modes passed to zm_power::add_powered_item; also defined in scripts/zm/zm.gsh.

macros.name: GRAPPLE_DIRECTION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the direction of the AI's grapple.

macros.name: GRAPPLE_NAME
macros.description: Weapon name of the grapple (chaser) weapon.
macros.remarks: The grapple and the replay gun share the "chaser" weapon name; see REPLAY_GUN_NAME.

macros.name: GRAPPLE_TYPE_PULLENTIN
macros.description: Grapple type meaning the grappled entity is pulled in towards the player.
macros.remarks: Stored on the target entity as .grapple_type and tested by the grapple script.

macros.name: GRAPPLE_TYPE_REELPLAYER
macros.description: Grapple type meaning the player is reeled towards the grappled entity.
macros.remarks: Stored on the target entity as .grapple_type and tested by the grapple script.

macros.name: GRAPPLE_TYPE_TARGETONLY
macros.description: Grapple type meaning the entity can only be targeted by the grapple, with no reeling or pulling.
macros.remarks: Stored on the target entity as .grapple_type and tested by the grapple script.

macros.name: GRAPPLE_TYPE_UNGRAPPLABLE
macros.description: Grapple type meaning the entity cannot be grappled.
macros.remarks: Stored on the target entity as .grapple_type and tested by the grapple script.

macros.name: GRAVITY_SLAM_SPEED
macros.description: Speed in units per second at which the player descends during the Gravity Spikes slam.

macros.name: GRAVITYSPIKES_STATE_CHARGING
macros.description: Gravity Spikes state meaning the weapon is still charging and cannot be used.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAVITYSPIKES_STATE_* values stored on the player as self.gravityspikes_state and set through update_gravityspikes_state().

macros.name: GRAVITYSPIKES_STATE_DEPLETED
macros.description: Gravity Spikes state meaning the charge has been spent and the weapon must recharge.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAVITYSPIKES_STATE_* values stored on the player as self.gravityspikes_state and set through update_gravityspikes_state().

macros.name: GRAVITYSPIKES_STATE_INUSE
macros.description: Gravity Spikes state meaning the slam is currently being performed.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAVITYSPIKES_STATE_* values stored on the player as self.gravityspikes_state and set through update_gravityspikes_state().

macros.name: GRAVITYSPIKES_STATE_NOT_PICKED_UP
macros.description: Gravity Spikes state meaning the player has not yet picked the weapon up.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAVITYSPIKES_STATE_* values stored on the player as self.gravityspikes_state and set through update_gravityspikes_state().

macros.name: GRAVITYSPIKES_STATE_READY
macros.description: Gravity Spikes state meaning the weapon is fully charged and ready to fire.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAVITYSPIKES_STATE_* values stored on the player as self.gravityspikes_state and set through update_gravityspikes_state().

macros.name: GRAY1
macros.description: A near black grey as a normalised RGB vector, at ten percent brightness.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAY1 through GRAY9 ramp, each step being that tenth of full brightness.

macros.name: GRAY2
macros.description: A dark grey as a normalised RGB vector, at twenty percent brightness.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAY1 through GRAY9 ramp, each step being that tenth of full brightness.

macros.name: GRAY3
macros.description: A dark grey as a normalised RGB vector, at thirty percent brightness.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAY1 through GRAY9 ramp, each step being that tenth of full brightness.

macros.name: GRAY4
macros.description: A mid dark grey as a normalised RGB vector, at forty percent brightness.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAY1 through GRAY9 ramp, each step being that tenth of full brightness.

macros.name: GRAY5
macros.description: A mid grey as a normalised RGB vector, at fifty percent brightness.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAY1 through GRAY9 ramp, each step being that tenth of full brightness.

macros.name: GRAY6
macros.description: A mid light grey as a normalised RGB vector, at sixty percent brightness.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAY1 through GRAY9 ramp, each step being that tenth of full brightness.

macros.name: GRAY7
macros.description: A light grey as a normalised RGB vector, at seventy percent brightness.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAY1 through GRAY9 ramp, each step being that tenth of full brightness.

macros.name: GRAY8
macros.description: A light grey as a normalised RGB vector, at eighty percent brightness.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAY1 through GRAY9 ramp, each step being that tenth of full brightness.

macros.name: GRAY9
macros.description: A near white grey as a normalised RGB vector, at ninety percent brightness.
macros.remarks: One of the GRAY1 through GRAY9 ramp, each step being that tenth of full brightness.

macros.name: GREEN
macros.description: The colour green as a normalised RGB vector.

macros.name: GRENADE_OVERLAP_DIST_SQ
macros.description: Minimum squared distance a new grenade throw must land from any previous throw within the grenade throw time window.

macros.name: GREY
macros.description: A light grey as a normalised RGB vector, at seventy five percent brightness.
macros.remarks: Separate from the GRAY1 through GRAY9 ramp, which uses the American spelling.

macros.name: GROUNDPOS
macros.description: Returns the point on the ground directly below a position, found by tracing straight down.

parameters.name: __e
parameters.description: Entity to ignore in the trace, or undefined for none.

parameters.name: _origin
parameters.description: The position to trace down from.

macros.remarks: Performs a bullettrace each time it is used, so avoid it in tight loops.

macros.name: HACKER_TOOL_ACTIVE
macros.description: Hacker tool state meaning the tool is raised and ready to hack.
macros.remarks: One of the hacker_tool clientfield states (HACKER_TOOL_INACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_ACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_HACKING, HACKER_TOOL_FIREWALL) read by scripts/shared/weapons/_hacker_tool.gsc and its client counterpart. Distinct from the HACKER_TOOL_STATUS_* set.

macros.name: HACKER_TOOL_FIREWALL
macros.description: Hacker tool state meaning the target is protected by a firewall.
macros.remarks: One of the hacker_tool clientfield states (HACKER_TOOL_INACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_ACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_HACKING, HACKER_TOOL_FIREWALL) read by scripts/shared/weapons/_hacker_tool.gsc and its client counterpart. Distinct from the HACKER_TOOL_STATUS_* set.

macros.name: HACKER_TOOL_HACKING
macros.description: Hacker tool state meaning a hack is currently in progress.
macros.remarks: One of the hacker_tool clientfield states (HACKER_TOOL_INACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_ACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_HACKING, HACKER_TOOL_FIREWALL) read by scripts/shared/weapons/_hacker_tool.gsc and its client counterpart. Distinct from the HACKER_TOOL_STATUS_* set.

macros.name: HACKER_TOOL_INACTIVE
macros.description: Hacker tool state meaning the tool is stowed and not in use.
macros.remarks: One of the hacker_tool clientfield states (HACKER_TOOL_INACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_ACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_HACKING, HACKER_TOOL_FIREWALL) read by scripts/shared/weapons/_hacker_tool.gsc and its client counterpart. Distinct from the HACKER_TOOL_STATUS_* set.

macros.name: HACKER_TOOL_STATUS_BREACHING
macros.description: Hacker tool status meaning the tool is breaching a target's firewall.
macros.remarks: One of the hacker tool (Black Hat) status values pushed to the hudItems.blackhat.status UI model. See also HACKER_TOOL_INACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_ACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_HACKING and HACKER_TOOL_FIREWALL, which describe the tool's mode rather than its status.

macros.name: HACKER_TOOL_STATUS_EMPED
macros.description: Hacker tool status meaning the tool has been disabled by an EMP.
macros.remarks: One of the hacker tool (Black Hat) status values pushed to the hudItems.blackhat.status UI model. See also HACKER_TOOL_INACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_ACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_HACKING and HACKER_TOOL_FIREWALL, which describe the tool's mode rather than its status.

macros.name: HACKER_TOOL_STATUS_HACKING
macros.description: Hacker tool status meaning the tool is actively hacking a target.
macros.remarks: One of the hacker tool (Black Hat) status values pushed to the hudItems.blackhat.status UI model. See also HACKER_TOOL_INACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_ACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_HACKING and HACKER_TOOL_FIREWALL, which describe the tool's mode rather than its status.

macros.name: HACKER_TOOL_STATUS_SCANNING
macros.description: Hacker tool status meaning the tool is scanning for a hackable target.
macros.remarks: One of the hacker tool (Black Hat) status values pushed to the hudItems.blackhat.status UI model. See also HACKER_TOOL_INACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_ACTIVE, HACKER_TOOL_HACKING and HACKER_TOOL_FIREWALL, which describe the tool's mode rather than its status.

macros.name: HAS_DESTRUCT_DEF
macros.description: Returns true if an entity has a destructible character definition assigned.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to test.

macros.name: HAS_ENEMY
macros.description: Enemy value meaning the AI currently has an enemy.

macros.name: HAS_LEGS_NO
macros.description: Value of the HAS_LEGS_TYPE blackboard attribute meaning the AI has lost its legs and should crawl.

macros.name: HAS_LEGS_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name recording whether a zombie still has its legs, which gates crawler animations.

macros.name: HAS_LEGS_YES
macros.description: Value of the HAS_LEGS_TYPE blackboard attribute meaning the AI still has both legs.

macros.name: HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET
macros.description: Name of the visionset file used for the Heat Wave activation visionset.
macros.example: visionset_mgr::register_visionset_info( HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_ALIAS, VERSION_SHIP, HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_STEPS, undefined, HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET );

macros.name: HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_ALIAS
macros.description: Script side alias that the Heat Wave activation visionset is registered and looked up under.
macros.example: visionset_mgr::activate( "visionset", HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_ALIAS, self, HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_RAMP_IN, HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_RAMP_HOLD, HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_RAMP_OUT );

macros.name: HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_PRIORITY
macros.description: Priority of the Heat Wave activation visionset against other active visionsets.

macros.name: HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_RAMP_HOLD
macros.description: Time in seconds the Heat Wave activation visionset is held at full strength before ramping out.

macros.name: HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_RAMP_IN
macros.description: Time in seconds taken to ramp the Heat Wave activation visionset in on activation.

macros.name: HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_RAMP_OUT

macros.example: visionset_mgr::register_visionset_info( HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_ALIAS, VERSION_SHIP, HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET_STEPS, undefined, HEATWAVE_ACTIVATE_VISIONSET );

macros.name: HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET
macros.description: Name of the visionset file used for the Heat Wave charred visionset applied to burned victims.
macros.example: visionset_mgr::register_visionset_info( HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_ALIAS, VERSION_SHIP, HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_STEPS, undefined, HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET );

macros.name: HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_ALIAS
macros.description: Script side alias that the Heat Wave charred visionset applied to burned victims is registered and looked up under.
macros.example: visionset_mgr::activate( "visionset", HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_ALIAS, self, HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_RAMP_IN, HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_RAMP_HOLD, HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_RAMP_OUT );

macros.name: HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_PRIORITY
macros.description: Priority of the Heat Wave charred visionset applied to burned victims against other active visionsets.

macros.name: HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_RAMP_HOLD
macros.description: Time in seconds the Heat Wave charred visionset applied to burned victims is held at full strength before ramping out.

macros.name: HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_RAMP_IN
macros.description: Time in seconds taken to ramp the Heat Wave charred visionset applied to burned victims in on activation.

macros.name: HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_RAMP_OUT

macros.example: visionset_mgr::register_visionset_info( HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_ALIAS, VERSION_SHIP, HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET_STEPS, undefined, HEATWAVE_CHARRED_VISIONSET );

macros.name: HEAVY_CONSECUTIVE_ATTACK_INTERVAL
macros.description: Time window in milliseconds within which repeated hits are accumulated when deciding whether damage counts as heavy.
macros.remarks: Expands to the expression 1 * 1000, so parenthesise it if it is used inside a larger expression.

macros.name: HEAVY_DAMAGE_RATIO
macros.description: Fraction of an actor's maximum health a single hit must exceed to count as heavy damage.
macros.example: if ( damage > entity.maxhealth * HEAVY_DAMAGE_RATIO ) { damageWeight = DAMAGE_HEAVY; }
macros.remarks: Used together with HEAVY_CONSECUTIVE_ATTACK_INTERVAL to classify damage as DAMAGE_HEAVY or DAMAGE_LIGHT.

macros.name: HELI_COMLINK_LIGHTS_ON_DELAY
macros.description: Delay in seconds before the helicopter comlink's lights are turned on.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_CAMO_DAMAGE_DURATION
macros.description: How long, in seconds, the helicopter's active camo stays disrupted after taking enough damage.
macros.remarks: Paired with HELICOPTER_CAMO_DAMAGE_LIMIT.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_CAMO_DAMAGE_LIMIT
macros.description: Amount of damage the helicopter must take before its active camo is disrupted.
macros.remarks: Paired with HELICOPTER_CAMO_DAMAGE_DURATION.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_CAMO_FLICKER_DURATION
macros.description: How long, in seconds, the helicopter's active camo flickers before settling.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_CAMO_STATE_FLICKER
macros.description: Active camo state in which the helicopter's cloak flickers, usually after taking damage.
macros.remarks: One of the HELICOPTER_CAMO_STATE_* values.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_CAMO_STATE_OFF
macros.description: Active camo state in which the helicopter is fully visible.
macros.remarks: One of the HELICOPTER_CAMO_STATE_* values, alongside HELICOPTER_CAMO_STATE_ON and HELICOPTER_CAMO_STATE_FLICKER.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_CAMO_STATE_ON
macros.description: Active camo state in which the helicopter is cloaked.
macros.remarks: One of the HELICOPTER_CAMO_STATE_* values.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_ANGLE_OFFSET
macros.description: Angle offset applied to the helicopter gunner killstreak's approach.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_ASSISTANT_0_TARGET_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the first assistant gunner's weapon fires from.
macros.remarks: Paired with HELICOPTER_GUNNER_ASSISTANT_1_TARGET_TAG.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_ASSISTANT_1_TARGET_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the second assistant gunner's weapon fires from.
macros.remarks: Paired with HELICOPTER_GUNNER_ASSISTANT_0_TARGET_TAG.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_ASSISTANT_SEAT_COUNT
macros.description: Number of assistant gunner seats on the helicopter gunner's gunship.
macros.remarks: Used with HELICOPTER_GUNNER_ASSISTANT_SEAT_START_INDEX to walk the assistant seats.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_ASSISTANT_SEAT_START_INDEX
macros.description: Seat index of the first assistant gunner seat, the pilot occupying seat zero.
macros.remarks: Used with HELICOPTER_GUNNER_ASSISTANT_SEAT_COUNT to walk the assistant seats.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_CAMSHAKE_DELAY
macros.description: Delay before the camera shake played while the helicopter gunner fires begins.
macros.remarks: One of the HELICOPTER_GUNNER_CAMSHAKE_* tuning values.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_CAMSHAKE_SIZE
macros.description: Strength of the camera shake played while the helicopter gunner fires.
macros.remarks: One of the HELICOPTER_GUNNER_CAMSHAKE_* tuning values.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_CAMSHAKE_TIME
macros.description: Duration of the camera shake played while the helicopter gunner fires.
macros.remarks: One of the HELICOPTER_GUNNER_CAMSHAKE_* tuning values.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_DURATION
macros.description: How long, in milliseconds, the helicopter gunner killstreak lasts.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_ENHANCED_VISION

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_FORCED_WAIT
macros.description: Forced wait, in seconds, before the helicopter gunner killstreak starts.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_HACKER_TOOL_DURATION
macros.description: How long, in milliseconds, hacking the helicopter gunner's gunship takes.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_HACKER_TOOL_RADIUS
macros.description: Radius within which the hacker tool can target the helicopter gunner's gunship.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_HELICOPTER_HEALTH
macros.description: Starting health of the helicopter gunner's gunship.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_HELICOPTER_MISSILES_TO_DESTROY
macros.description: Number of missile hits needed to destroy the helicopter gunner's gunship.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_HIDE_COMPASS_ON_REMOTE_CONTROL
macros.description: Whether the compass (minimap) is hidden while the player mans the helicopter gunner killstreak.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_INFRARED_VISION
macros.description: Visionset applied when the helicopter gunner switches to infrared view.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_VEHICLE_NAME
macros.description: Vehicle archetype name of the gunship used by the helicopter gunner killstreak.

macros.name: HELICOPTER_GUNNER_Z_OFFSET
macros.description: Height above the map at which the helicopter gunner's gunship flies.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_DESTRUCTIBLE_ENTITY
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It forces the destructible system to apply the damage to the entity.
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_DISABLE_RAGDOLL_SKIP
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It stops the victim switching to ragdoll if damaged while playing a death animation.
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_HURT_TRIGGER_ALLOW_LASTSTAND
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It tells the hurt trigger that applied the damage to ignore last stand.
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_NO_ARMOR
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It means armor does not protect the victim from this damage.
macros.example: self DoDamage( 100, self.origin, attacker, undefined, IDFLAGS_NO_ARMOR );
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_NO_KNOCKBACK
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It stops the damage affecting the victim's velocity, changing only view angles.
macros.example: self DoDamage( 5, self.origin, attacker, undefined, IDFLAGS_NO_KNOCKBACK );
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_NO_PROTECTION
macros.description: Script defined damage flag bit, tested by the game mode damage callbacks rather than by code. It bypasses spawn and god mode style damage protection entirely.
macros.remarks: Script defined rather than code defined. Used by the globallogic damage callbacks to force damage through protection.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_NO_TEAM_PROTECTION
macros.description: Script defined damage flag bit, tested by the game mode damage callbacks rather than by code. It lets the damage through friendly fire protection.
macros.remarks: Script defined rather than code defined, unlike the flags above it in shared.gsh, and shares the value 1024 with IDFLAGS_POWER_ARMOR.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_NOFLAG
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. This is the empty flag set, meaning ordinary damage.
macros.example: self DoDamage( 100, self.origin, attacker, undefined, IDFLAGS_NOFLAG );
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_PASSTHRU
macros.description: Script defined damage flag bit, tested by the game mode damage callbacks rather than by code. It marks damage that should pass through to the entity behind, such as through a destructible.
macros.remarks: Script defined rather than code defined.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_PENETRATION
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It marks damage that occurred after the bullet penetrated one or more surfaces.
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_POWER_ARMOR
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It marks damage that hit the player's power armor.
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and. Shares the value 1024 with the script defined IDFLAGS_NO_TEAM_PROTECTION, so the two must not be used on the same damage path.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_RADIUS
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It marks damage that was indirect, such as a radius explosion.
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_SHIELD_EXPLOSIVE_IMPACT
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It marks a missile that impacted the front of the victim's riot shield.
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_SHIELD_EXPLOSIVE_IMPACT_HUGE
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It marks a shield impact from a projectile flagged as a big explosion.
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and. Set alongside IDFLAGS_SHIELD_EXPLOSIVE_IMPACT.

macros.name: IDFLAGS_SHIELD_EXPLOSIVE_SPLASH
macros.description: Damage flag bit, passed and tested in the iDFlags argument of the damage callbacks. It marks explosive splash damage that the victim's shield partly deflected.
macros.remarks: Code defined in g_local.h, so the value must stay in sync with the engine. Bit flag; combine with bitwise or and test with bitwise and.

macros.name: IS_BODY_UNDAMAGED
macros.description: Returns true if a gib state carries none of the torso or leg gib flags, meaning the body itself is still intact.

parameters.name: gib_state
parameters.description: Gib state bitfield to test.

macros.remarks: Implemented as a less-than comparison against GIB_TORSO_RIGHT_ARM_FLAG, so the head, hat, annihilate and toggle bits below it do not count as body damage. Pass a flags-only state, for example one from GIB_FLAG_STRIPPED.

macros.name: IS_EQUAL
macros.description: Compares two values with the strict equality operator, which does not throw when either side is undefined.

parameters.name: __a

parameters.name: __b

macros.remarks: The === operator compares type and value without the implicit conversions of ==, so it is safe on possibly undefined variables.

macros.name: IS_ROBOT
macros.description: Returns true if the given entity has an archetype and that archetype is the robot archetype.

parameters.name: __e
parameters.description: The entity or actor to test.

macros.name: IS_TANK
macros.description: Returns true if the entity is a vehicle whose vehicle class is "tank".

parameters.name: __e
parameters.description: The vehicle entity to test.

macros.remarks: Tests the entity's vehicleclass field, which comes from the vehicle asset, not the individual vehicle type.

macros.name: IS_TRUE
macros.description: Returns true when a value is both defined and truthy. It is the standard guard for optional flags that may never have been set.

parameters.name: __a
parameters.description: The value to test; may be undefined.

macros.remarks: The argument is evaluated twice, so avoid passing an expression with side effects.

macros.name: IS_UNDAMAGED
macros.description: Returns true if a gib state has no bits set at all, meaning nothing has been gibbed.

parameters.name: gib_state
parameters.description: Gib state bitfield to test.

macros.remarks: Stricter than IS_BODY_UNDAMAGED, which ignores the low flags such as the head and hat bits.

macros.name: IS_VALID_PIECE_NUMBER
macros.description: Returns true if a destructible piece number lies in the valid range of 1 to 20.

parameters.name: piece_number
parameters.description: 1-based destructible piece index to validate.

macros.remarks: The upper bound is written literally rather than as DESTRUCT_MAX_PIECES, but matches it.

macros.name: IS_ZOMBIETEAM
macros.description: Returns true when the given entity belongs to the zombie team.

parameters.name: __self
parameters.description: The entity whose team is tested.

parameters.name: __self
parameters.description: The entity whose team is tested.

macros.remarks: Both scripts/zm/_zm_utility.gsh and scripts/zm/zm.gsh define it identically. Reads level.zombie_team, so the level must be initialised.

macros.name: ISNODEDONTLEFT
macros.description: Returns true if a path node carries the spawn flag that forbids AI from moving left from it.

parameters.name: __node
parameters.description: Path node to test.

macros.remarks: Reads the node's spawnflags through the SPAWNFLAG macro; pairs with ISNODEDONTRIGHT.

macros.name: ISNODEDONTRIGHT
macros.description: Returns true if a path node carries the spawn flag that forbids AI from moving right from it.

parameters.name: __node
parameters.description: Path node to test.

macros.remarks: Reads the node's spawnflags through the SPAWNFLAG macro; pairs with ISNODEDONTLEFT.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_ARRIVAL_DISTANCE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the distance from the goal at which the AI should begin its arrival animation.
macros.remarks: DEFAULT_DESIRED_ARRIVAL_DISTANCE is used when no specific distance is wanted.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_ARRIVAL_YAW
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the yaw the AI should be facing when it arrives at its goal.
macros.remarks: DEFAULT_ARRIVAL_YAW is used when no specific arrival yaw is wanted.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_EXIT_YAW
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the yaw the AI should leave its current position at when it starts moving.
macros.remarks: INVALID_EXIT_YAW marks that no exit yaw has been predicted.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_FACE_ENEMY_BACK
macros.description: Enemy quadrant value meaning the AI's enemy is behind it while moving.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_FACE_ENEMY_FRONT
macros.description: Enemy quadrant value meaning the AI's enemy is ahead of it while moving.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_FACE_ENEMY_LEFT
macros.description: Enemy quadrant value meaning the AI's enemy is to its left while moving.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_FACE_ENEMY_NONE
macros.description: Enemy quadrant value meaning the AI has no enemy to face while moving.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_FACE_ENEMY_QUADRANT
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for which quadrant relative to the AI its enemy is in while moving.
macros.remarks: Values are LOCOMOTION_FACE_ENEMY_NONE, _FRONT, _LEFT, _RIGHT and _BACK. The previous value is kept in LOCOMOTION_FACE_ENEMY_QUADRANT_PREVIOUS.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_FACE_ENEMY_QUADRANT_PREVIOUS
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the enemy quadrant the AI was in before its current one.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_FACE_ENEMY_RIGHT
macros.description: Enemy quadrant value meaning the AI's enemy is to its right while moving.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_INPLACE_PAIN
macros.description: Animation state name for the pain reaction played without moving.
macros.remarks: Used instead of the LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_* states when the actor is stationary.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_MOTION_ANGLE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the angle between the AI's facing and the direction it is moving.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_DIST_LONG
macros.description: Distance in units covered by the long moving pain reaction.
macros.remarks: Paired with LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_LONG; see also the SHORT and MED variants.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_DIST_MED
macros.description: Distance in units covered by the medium moving pain reaction.
macros.remarks: Paired with LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_MED; see also the SHORT and LONG variants.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_DIST_SHORT
macros.description: Distance in units covered by the short moving pain reaction.
macros.remarks: Paired with LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_SHORT; see also the MED and LONG variants.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_LONG
macros.description: Animation state name for the long moving pain reaction.
macros.remarks: Covers roughly LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_DIST_LONG units of travel.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_MED
macros.description: Animation state name for the medium moving pain reaction.
macros.remarks: Covers roughly LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_DIST_MED units of travel.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_SHORT
macros.description: Animation state name for the short moving pain reaction.
macros.remarks: Covers roughly LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_DIST_SHORT units of travel.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_PAIN_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the kind of pain animation the AI should play while moving.
macros.remarks: Values are LOCOMOTION_MOVING_PAIN_SHORT, _MED and _LONG, picked by distance, plus LOCOMOTION_INPLACE_PAIN.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_SHOULD_TURN
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for whether the AI should play a turn animation before moving.
macros.remarks: Values are SHOULD_TURN and SHOULD_NOT_TURN.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_SPEED_1
macros.description: Numbered locomotion speed tier 1, used as a blackboard value to pick between graded movement animation sets.
macros.remarks: Distinct from the named LOCOMOTION_SPEED_WALK, LOCOMOTION_SPEED_RUN and LOCOMOTION_SPEED_SPRINT values.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_SPEED_2
macros.description: Numbered locomotion speed tier 2, used as a blackboard value to pick between graded movement animation sets.
macros.remarks: Distinct from the named LOCOMOTION_SPEED_WALK, LOCOMOTION_SPEED_RUN and LOCOMOTION_SPEED_SPRINT values.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_SPEED_3

macros.remarks: Distinct from the named LOCOMOTION_SPEED_WALK, LOCOMOTION_SPEED_RUN and LOCOMOTION_SPEED_SPRINT values.

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_SPEED_BURNED

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_SPEED_SUPER_SPRINT

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_SPEED_TYPE

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_SPEED_WALK

macros.name: LOCOMOTION_TURN_YAW

macros.name: LOOT_CONFIG_TABLE

macros.name: LOW_GRAVITY_VARIANT

macros.name: LUI_HUDELEM_TEXTSIZE_MEDIUM

macros.name: LUI_HUDELEM_TEXTSIZE_SMALL

macros.name: MAKE_ARRAY

macros.remarks: Expands to statements rather than an expression, so the argument must be an assignable variable. Used by ARRAY_ADD.

macros.name: MARGWA_ANIM_HEAD_RIGHT_SMASH
macros.description: Animation played when the right margwa head performs its smash attack.

macros.name: MARGWA_ANIM_TENTACLE_LEFT_BASE
macros.description: Base animation name for the left side margwa tentacles, with the tentacle index appended to it.
macros.remarks: The trailing 0 in the string is overwritten by concatenating the index, so the animation names run from ai_margwa_tentacle_l_0 upward.

macros.name: MARGWA_ANIM_TENTACLE_RIGHT_BASE
macros.description: Base animation name for the right side margwa tentacles, with the tentacle index appended to it.
macros.remarks: Used the same way as MARGWA_ANIM_TENTACLE_LEFT_BASE, by concatenating an index in the range of MARGWA_NUM_TENTACLES_PER_SIDE.

macros.name: MARGWA_FOOTSTEP_EARTHQUAKE_MAX_RADIUS
macros.description: Maximum radius in world units of the earthquake shake produced by a Margwa footstep.
macros.remarks: The expansion reads the dvar scr_margwa_footstep_eq_radius at every use, defaulting to 1000, so the value can change at runtime and is not a compile time constant.

macros.name: MARGWA_FX_CLIENTFIELD_BITS
macros.description: Bit width used when registering the Margwa teleport effect fields.
macros.remarks: One bit is enough for the on and off values MARGWA_TELEPORT_ON and MARGWA_TELEPORT_OFF.

macros.name: MARGWA_FX_CLIENTFIELD_TYPE
macros.description: Clientfield type used when registering the Margwa teleport effect fields.

macros.name: MARGWA_FX_IN_CLIENTFIELD

macros.name: MARGWA_FX_OUT_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Clientfield that triggers the Margwa teleport out effect.

macros.name: MARGWA_FX_SPAWN_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Clientfield that triggers the Margwa spawn effect on clients.

macros.name: MARGWA_FX_SPAWN_CLIENTFIELD_BITS
macros.description: Bit width used when registering the Margwa spawn effect field.

macros.name: MARGWA_FX_SPAWN_CLIENTFIELD_TYPE
macros.description: Clientfield type used when registering the Margwa spawn effect field.
macros.remarks: A counter field fires its callback each time the server increments it.

macros.name: MARGWA_FX_TRAVEL_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Clientfield that turns the Margwa teleport travel effect on the traveller entity on or off.

macros.name: MARGWA_FX_TRAVEL_TELL_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Clientfield that turns the Margwa travel tell effect on or off.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding which of the Margwa's three heads is currently relevant.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_CLEAR
macros.description: Margwa head state meaning the head has no open or closed pose applied.
macros.remarks: One of the margwa head state values (MARGWA_HEAD_CLEAR, MARGWA_HEAD_OPEN, MARGWA_HEAD_CLOSED, MARGWA_HEAD_SMASH_ATTACK) stored per head and switched on when picking head animations.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_CLIENTFIELD_BITS
macros.description: Bit width used when registering the three Margwa head state fields.
macros.remarks: Two bits are enough for the four head states, MARGWA_HEAD_CLEAR through MARGWA_HEAD_SMASH_ATTACK.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_CLIENTFIELD_TYPE
macros.description: Clientfield type used when registering the three Margwa head state fields.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_CLOSE_MAX
macros.description: Longest time in milliseconds that a margwa head stays closed.
macros.remarks: Part of the margwa mouth timing group; the open and close durations are random values picked between the matching MIN and MAX macros, in milliseconds.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_CLOSE_MIN
macros.description: Shortest time in milliseconds that a margwa head stays closed.
macros.remarks: Part of the margwa mouth timing group; the open and close durations are random values picked between the matching MIN and MAX macros, in milliseconds.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_CLOSED
macros.description: Margwa head state meaning the head is closed and armoured.
macros.remarks: One of the margwa head state values (MARGWA_HEAD_CLEAR, MARGWA_HEAD_OPEN, MARGWA_HEAD_CLOSED, MARGWA_HEAD_SMASH_ATTACK) stored per head and switched on when picking head animations.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_DAMAGE_RANGE
macros.description: Squared radius in world units used to decide whether a hit landed close enough to a Margwa head to count as head damage.
macros.remarks: Written as 24 * 24 because it is compared against squared distances.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_EXPLODE_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Clientfield that triggers the Margwa head explosion effect on clients.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_EXPLODE_CLIENTFIELD_BITS

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_EXPLODE_CLIENTFIELD_TYPE
macros.description: Clientfield type used when registering the Margwa head explosion field.
macros.remarks: A counter field fires its callback each time the server increments it.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_EXPLOSION_RANGE
macros.description: Squared radius in world units within which a destroyed Margwa head explosion affects players.
macros.remarks: Written as 128 * 128 because it is compared against squared distances.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_HEALTH_BASE
macros.description: Starting health of a single margwa head before any round based scaling.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_KILLED_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Clientfield carrying which Margwa head has just been destroyed.
macros.remarks: The value is one of MARGWA_HEAD_KILLED_LEFT, MARGWA_HEAD_KILLED_MID or MARGWA_HEAD_KILLED_RIGHT, with zero meaning no head.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_KILLED_LEFT

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_KILLED_MID

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_KILLED_RIGHT

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_LEFT

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_LEFT_CLIENTFIELD

macros.remarks: Registered with MARGWA_HEAD_CLIENTFIELD_TYPE and MARGWA_HEAD_CLIENTFIELD_BITS.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_LEFT_HIT_CLIENTFIELD

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_MID_CLIENTFIELD

macros.remarks: Registered with MARGWA_HEAD_CLIENTFIELD_TYPE and MARGWA_HEAD_CLIENTFIELD_BITS.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_MID_HIT_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Clientfield that plays the impact effect on the Margwa's middle head.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_MIDDLE
macros.description: Value of the MARGWA_HEAD blackboard attribute selecting the Margwa's middle head.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_OPEN
macros.description: Margwa head state meaning the head is open, exposing its weak point to damage.
macros.remarks: One of the margwa head state values (MARGWA_HEAD_CLEAR, MARGWA_HEAD_OPEN, MARGWA_HEAD_CLOSED, MARGWA_HEAD_SMASH_ATTACK) stored per head and switched on when picking head animations.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_OPEN_MAX
macros.description: Longest time in milliseconds that a margwa head stays open.
macros.remarks: Part of the margwa mouth timing group; the open and close durations are random values picked between the matching MIN and MAX macros, in milliseconds.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_OPEN_MIN
macros.description: Shortest time in milliseconds that a margwa head stays open.
macros.remarks: Part of the margwa mouth timing group; the open and close durations are random values picked between the matching MIN and MAX macros, in milliseconds.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_RIGHT
macros.description: Value of the MARGWA_HEAD blackboard attribute selecting the Margwa's right head.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_RIGHT_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Clientfield carrying the open or closed state of the Margwa's right head.
macros.remarks: Registered with MARGWA_HEAD_CLIENTFIELD_TYPE and MARGWA_HEAD_CLIENTFIELD_BITS.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_RIGHT_HIT_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Clientfield that plays the impact effect on the Margwa's right head.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_SMASH_ATTACK
macros.description: Margwa head state meaning the head is playing its smash attack.
macros.remarks: One of the margwa head state values (MARGWA_HEAD_CLEAR, MARGWA_HEAD_OPEN, MARGWA_HEAD_CLOSED, MARGWA_HEAD_SMASH_ATTACK) stored per head and switched on when picking head animations.

macros.name: MARGWA_HEAD_TAG

macros.name: MARGWA_IMPACT_FX

macros.name: MARGWA_LARGE_RADIUS

macros.name: MARGWA_NAVMESH_RADIUS

macros.name: MELEE_RANGE_MAX_SQ

macros.name: MELEE_TRACE_Z_OFFSET

macros.name: MELEE_VARIANT

macros.name: MELEE_YAW_THRESHOLD

macros.name: MELEE_YAW_THRESHOLDNEAR
macros.description: Maximum yaw difference, in degrees, to the enemy for a melee attack at near range.
macros.remarks: Tighter than MELEE_YAW_THRESHOLD.

macros.name: MIN_ARRIVAL_DIST_SQ
macros.description: Minimum squared distance from the goal at which an actor plays an arrival animation.

macros.name: MIN_DIFFICULTY_REPORT_INDEX
macros.description: Difficulty reporting slot holding the lowest difficulty reached.
macros.remarks: Mirrors the difficultySlot_t enum code side, so the value must stay in sync with it.

macros.name: MIN_EXITYAW_DISTANCE_SQ
macros.description: Minimum squared distance the actor must be able to travel before an exit yaw is worth computing.
macros.remarks: Expands to the expression 64 * 64, so parenthesise it if it is used inside a larger expression.

macros.name: MIN_EXPOSED_TIME
macros.description: Minimum time, in seconds, a robot stays stepped out of cover.
macros.remarks: Defined in archetype_robot.gsh alongside MAX_EXPOSED_TIME, so the name is unprefixed despite being robot specific.

macros.name: MIN_GRENADE_ANIMSCRIPTED_TIME
macros.description: Lower bound, in milliseconds, of the delay before an actor that just finished a scripted animation may throw a grenade.
macros.remarks: Randomised against MAX_GRENADE_ANIMSCRIPTED_TIME.

macros.name: MIN_GRENADE_TEAM_TIME
macros.description: Lower bound, in milliseconds, of the delay before another actor on the same team may throw a grenade.
macros.remarks: Randomised against MAX_GRENADE_TEAM_TIME.

macros.name: MIN_GRENADE_THROW_DIST_SQ
macros.description: Minimum squared distance to a target for an actor to consider throwing a grenade.
macros.remarks: Paired with MAX_GRENADE_THROW_DIST_SQ. Expands through the SQR macro.

macros.name: MIN_GRENADE_THROW_TIME
macros.description: Lower bound, in milliseconds, of the delay before an actor may throw another grenade.
macros.remarks: Randomised against MAX_GRENADE_THROW_TIME.

macros.name: MIN_PATH_DIST_FOR_ARRIVAL_PREDICTION_SQ
macros.description: Minimum squared path length required before arrival prediction is run.
macros.remarks: Expands to the expression 50 * 50, so parenthesise it if it is used inside a larger expression.

macros.name: MPH_TO_INCHES_PER_SEC

macros.name: MPINTRO_VISIONSET_RAMP_OUT

macros.name: PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_CLIP
macros.description: Physics trace mask bit for clip geometry.
macros.example: trace = PhysicsTrace( start, end, ( 0, 0, 0 ), ( 0, 0, 0 ), self, PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_CLIP );
macros.remarks: Passed as the mask argument to PhysicsTrace; bits may be combined with the other PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_ values.

macros.name: PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_PHYSICS
macros.description: Physics trace mask bit for general physics geometry.
macros.example: trace = PhysicsTrace( start, end, ( 0, 0, 0 ), ( 0, 0, 0 ), self, PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_PHYSICS );
macros.remarks: Passed as the mask argument to PhysicsTrace; bits may be combined with the other PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_ values.

macros.name: PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_PLAYER
macros.description: Physics trace mask bit that includes player collision in a physics trace.
macros.example: hit = PhysicsTrace( start, end, mins, maxs, self, PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_PHYSICS | PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_PLAYER );
macros.remarks: One of the PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK bit flags, which mirror the engine's physics trace masks and are combined with bitwise or.

macros.name: PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_VEHICLE
macros.description: Physics trace mask bit for vehicle bodies.
macros.example: trace = PhysicsTrace( start, end, ( 0, 0, 0 ), ( 0, 0, 0 ), self, PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_VEHICLE );
macros.remarks: Passed as the mask argument to PhysicsTrace; bits may be combined with the other PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_ values.

macros.name: PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_VEHICLE_CLIP
macros.description: Physics trace mask bit for vehicle clip geometry.
macros.example: trace = PhysicsTrace( start, end, ( 0, 0, 0 ), ( 0, 0, 0 ), self, PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_VEHICLE_CLIP );
macros.remarks: Passed as the mask argument to PhysicsTrace; bits may be combined with the other PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_ values.

macros.name: PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_WATER

macros.example: trace = PhysicsTrace( start, end, ( 0, 0, 0 ), ( 0, 0, 0 ), self, PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_WATER );
macros.remarks: Passed as the mask argument to PhysicsTrace; bits may be combined with the other PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_ values.
