macros.name: PROXIMITY_ALARM_ON
macros.description: Proximity alarm state meaning the alarm is triggered and warning its owner.
macros.remarks: Value of the "proximity_alarm" client field and of the "hudItems.proximityAlarm" UI model.

macros.name: PROXY_PLAYER_NOT_TAZERED
macros.description: Proxy (tazer spike) state meaning the player has not been shocked by the device.
macros.remarks: Paired with PROXY_PLAYER_TAZERED.

macros.name: PROXY_PLAYER_TAZERED
macros.description: Proxy (tazer spike) state meaning the player has been shocked by the device.
macros.remarks: Paired with PROXY_PLAYER_NOT_TAZERED.

macros.name: PURPLE
macros.description: The colour purple, in fact magenta, as a normalised RGB vector.

macros.name: PUSH_DIRECTION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding the direction an AI is being pushed in.

macros.name: QRDRONE_FX_BLINK
macros.description: QR drone effect state, selecting which effect set the drone plays. This is the warning blink played as the drone nears the end of its life.

macros.name: QRDRONE_FX_DEATH
macros.description: QR drone effect state, selecting which effect set the drone plays. This is the destruction effect.

macros.name: QRDRONE_FX_DEFAULT
macros.description: QR drone effect state, selecting which effect set the drone plays. This is the normal idle effect.

macros.name: QRDRONE_FX_FINAL_BLINK
macros.description: QR drone effect state, selecting which effect set the drone plays. This is the faster blink played just before the drone expires.

macros.name: QUAD_PHASE_DIRECTION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding the direction of a quad's phase move.

macros.name: QUAD_PHASE_DISTANCE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding how far a quad's phase move travels.

macros.name: QUAD_PHASE_FORWARD
macros.description: Value of the QUAD_PHASE_DIRECTION blackboard attribute meaning the quad phases forward.

macros.name: QUAD_PHASE_LEFT
macros.description: Value of the QUAD_PHASE_DIRECTION blackboard attribute meaning the quad phases left.

macros.name: QUAD_PHASE_LONG
macros.description: Value of the QUAD_PHASE_DISTANCE blackboard attribute selecting a long phase move.

macros.name: QUAD_PHASE_RIGHT
macros.description: Value of the QUAD_PHASE_DIRECTION blackboard attribute meaning the quad phases right.

macros.name: QUAD_PHASE_SHORT
macros.description: Value of the QUAD_PHASE_DISTANCE blackboard attribute selecting a short phase move.

macros.name: QUAD_WALL_CRAWL
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding which wall crawl set the quad should use.

macros.name: QUAD_WALL_CRAWL_START
macros.description: Value of the QUAD_WALL_CRAWL blackboard attribute selecting the starting wall crawl animations.

macros.name: QUAD_WALL_CRAWL_THEATER
macros.description: Value of the QUAD_WALL_CRAWL blackboard attribute selecting the theater specific wall crawl animations.

macros.name: QUICK_REVIVE_MACHINE_ACTIVE_MODEL
macros.description: The model used for the Quick Revive vending machine once it is powered and usable.

macros.name: QUICK_REVIVE_MACHINE_DISABLED_MODEL
macros.description: The model used for the Quick Revive vending machine while it is unpowered or disabled.

macros.name: QUICK_REVIVE_MACHINE_LIGHT_FX
macros.description: The name of the light effect played on the Quick Revive vending machine.

macros.name: QUICK_REVIVE_PERK_BOTTLE_WEAPON
macros.description: The weapon name of the Quick Revive perk bottle the player drinks when buying the perk.

macros.name: QUICK_REVIVE_RADIANT_MACHINE_NAME
macros.description: The Radiant targetname that identifies the Quick Revive vending machine in a level.

macros.name: QUICK_REVIVE_SHADER
macros.description: The HUD shader drawn on the perk icon while the player has Quick Revive.

macros.name: RANDOM
macros.description: Returns a randomly chosen element of an array, working for both indexed and keyed arrays.

parameters.name: __array
parameters.description: The array to pick an element from.

macros.remarks: The argument is evaluated several times and GetArrayKeys is called twice, so avoid passing an expensive expression. The array must be non empty.

macros.name: RANDOM_SPRINT_TIME
macros.description: Additional random delay, in milliseconds, added on top of the sprint gap time.
macros.remarks: Used with SPRINT_GAP_TIME.

macros.name: RANDOM_TIME_IN_RANGE
macros.description: Returns a random time within a window centred on the given time. It is used to jitter periodic updates so monitor loops spread out instead of spiking together.

parameters.name: __time
parameters.description: The centre time in seconds.

parameters.name: __delta
parameters.description: The maximum amount to vary the time by, in seconds.

macros.remarks: Calls randomfloatrange each time it is evaluated.

macros.name: RAPS_DRONE_NAME
macros.description: Name string identifying an individual RAPS drone, as opposed to the killstreak as a whole.
macros.remarks: Distinct from RAPS_NAME, which names the killstreak itself.

macros.name: RAPS_HEDEPS_AVOID_RADIUS
macros.description: Radius in world units that RAPS deploy points keep away from an avoid point.

macros.name: RAPS_HEDEPS_AVOID_RADIUS_SQR
macros.description: Squared RAPS deploy point avoid radius, for comparison against squared distances.
macros.example: function GetRandomHelicopterPosition( avoidPoint, otherAvoidPoint, avoidRadiusSqr = RAPS_HEDEPS_AVOID_RADIUS_SQR )
macros.remarks: Derived from RAPS_HEDEPS_AVOID_RADIUS.

macros.name: RAPS_HEDEPS_DEBUG
macros.description: Debug switch for the RAPS helicopter deploy point selection logic.
macros.remarks: The expansion reads a dvar every time the macro is used, so it is a live debug switch rather than a compile-time constant.

macros.name: RAPS_HEDEPS_FIRST_POINT_PERCENT_OF_TOTAL
macros.description: Percentage of the total travel used when placing the first RAPS deploy point.

macros.name: RAPS_HEDEPS_REDUCE_RADIUS_RETRIES
macros.description: Number of times RAPS deploy point selection shrinks its avoid radius and retries before giving up.

macros.name: RAPS_HEDEPS_UNSPECIFIED_AVOID_POINT
macros.description: Sentinel point used to mean that no avoid point was supplied to RAPS deploy point selection.
macros.remarks: The coordinates are far outside any playable space, so the selection code treats them as no constraint.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_ALWAYS_PICK_NEW_GOAL_POST_BACK_OFF
macros.description: Whether a RAPS helicopter always chooses a new goal after backing off from another helicopter.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_BACK_OFF_FACTOR_MAX
macros.description: Upper bound of the random factor scaling how far a RAPS helicopter backs off from another helicopter.
macros.remarks: Paired with RAPS_HELAV_BACK_OFF_FACTOR_MIN.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_BACK_OFF_FACTOR_MIN
macros.description: Lower bound of the random factor scaling how far a RAPS helicopter backs off from another helicopter.
macros.remarks: Paired with RAPS_HELAV_BACK_OFF_FACTOR_MAX.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_CAUTIOUS_MODE_ACCEL
macros.description: Acceleration used by a RAPS helicopter while in cautious drive mode.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_CAUTIOUS_MODE_DECEL
macros.description: Deceleration used by a RAPS helicopter while in cautious drive mode.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_DEBUG
macros.description: Debug switch for the RAPS helicopter avoidance logic.
macros.remarks: The expansion reads a dvar every time the macro is used, so it is a live debug switch rather than a compile-time constant.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_DRIVE_MODE_CAUTIOUS
macros.description: Drive mode in which a RAPS helicopter reduces its speed because another helicopter is nearby.
macros.remarks: One of the RAPS_HELAV_DRIVE_MODE_* values.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_DRIVE_MODE_EXPEDIENT
macros.description: Drive mode in which a RAPS helicopter moves at full speed with no avoidance slowdown.
macros.remarks: One of the RAPS_HELAV_DRIVE_MODE_* values, alongside RAPS_HELAV_DRIVE_MODE_CAUTIOUS and RAPS_HELAV_DRIVE_MODE_MORE_CAUTIOUS.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_DRIVE_MODE_MORE_CAUTIOUS
macros.description: Drive mode in which a RAPS helicopter reduces its speed further because another helicopter is directly in front of it.
macros.remarks: One of the RAPS_HELAV_DRIVE_MODE_* values.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_EXPEDIENT_MODE_ACCEL
macros.description: Acceleration used by a RAPS helicopter while in expedient drive mode.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_EXPEDIENT_MODE_DECEL
macros.description: Deceleration used by a RAPS helicopter while in expedient drive mode.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_FORWARD_OFFSET
macros.description: Distance ahead of a RAPS delivery helicopter used when projecting its own avoidance test point.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_FULL_STOP_DISTANCE
macros.description: Separation distance, in units, at which a RAPS helicopter comes to a full stop to avoid another helicopter.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_FULL_STOP_DISTANCE_SQR
macros.description: Squared form of the RAPS helicopter full stop distance.
macros.remarks: Avoids a square root at runtime by squaring RAPS_HELAV_FULL_STOP_DISTANCE at compile time.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_FULL_STOP_MODE_ACCEL
macros.description: Acceleration used by a RAPS helicopter while it is coming to a full stop.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_FULL_STOP_MODE_DECEL
macros.description: Deceleration used by a RAPS helicopter while it is coming to a full stop, high enough to stop it quickly.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_IN_FRONT_DOT
macros.description: Dot product threshold above which another helicopter counts as being in front of this one, about 45 degrees off the facing direction.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_MIN_PICK_NEW_GOAL_TIME_MS
macros.description: Minimum time in milliseconds before RAPS helicopter avoidance picks a new goal position.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_MIN_TIME_BETWEEN_FULL_STOPS_MS
macros.description: Minimum time in milliseconds between full stops made by the RAPS dropship's avoidance logic.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_NEED_NEW_GOAL_DISTANCE
macros.description: Separation distance at which a RAPS helicopter abandons its current goal and picks a new one.
macros.remarks: Defined relative to RAPS_HELAV_FULL_STOP_DISTANCE, so it is always 200 units larger.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_NEED_NEW_GOAL_DISTANCE_SQR
macros.description: Squared form of the distance at which a RAPS helicopter picks a new goal.
macros.remarks: Avoids a square root at runtime by squaring RAPS_HELAV_NEED_NEW_GOAL_DISTANCE at compile time.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_OTHER_FORWARD_OFFSET
macros.description: Distance ahead of another helicopter used when projecting that helicopter's position for avoidance tests.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_SLOW_DOWN_DISTANCE
macros.description: Separation distance at which a RAPS helicopter begins slowing down for another helicopter.
macros.remarks: Defined relative to RAPS_HELAV_NEED_NEW_GOAL_DISTANCE, so it is always 1000 units larger.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_SLOW_DOWN_DISTANCE_SQR
macros.description: Squared form of the RAPS helicopter slow down distance, for comparing against squared distances.
macros.remarks: Avoids a square root at runtime by squaring RAPS_HELAV_SLOW_DOWN_DISTANCE at compile time.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_SLOW_DOWN_MORE_SCALE_FACTOR
macros.description: Stronger speed multiplier applied when a RAPS helicopter has to slow down further than the normal case.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_SLOW_DOWN_SPEED_SCALE_FACTOR
macros.description: Speed multiplier applied while a RAPS helicopter is slowing down for another helicopter.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter avoidance tuning block in _killstreaks.gsh.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_STOP_WAIT_BEFORE_NEXT_DROP_POINT_MS
macros.description: Time in milliseconds a stopped RAPS dropship waits before heading to its next drop point.

macros.name: RAPS_HELAV_TIME_BETWEEN_UPDATES
macros.description: Time in seconds between RAPS helicopter avoidance updates.

macros.name: RAPS_HELI_DEATH_FX
macros.description: Large explosion effect played when a RAPS delivery helicopter is destroyed.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter damage and death effect set.

macros.name: RAPS_HELI_DEATH_FX_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the RAPS helicopter death explosion is played on.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter damage and death effect set.

macros.name: RAPS_HELI_DEATH_TRAIL_FX
macros.description: Smoke trail effect played on a dying RAPS delivery helicopter.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter damage and death effect set.

macros.name: RAPS_HELI_DEATH_TRAIL_FX_TAG_A
macros.description: First model tag the RAPS helicopter death trail effect is played on.
macros.remarks: One of three tags used together with RAPS_HELI_DEATH_TRAIL_FX_TAG_B and RAPS_HELI_DEATH_TRAIL_FX_TAG_C.

macros.name: RAPS_HELI_DEATH_TRAIL_FX_TAG_B
macros.description: Second model tag the RAPS helicopter death trail effect is played on.
macros.remarks: One of three tags used together with RAPS_HELI_DEATH_TRAIL_FX_TAG_A and RAPS_HELI_DEATH_TRAIL_FX_TAG_C.

macros.name: RAPS_HELI_DEATH_TRAIL_FX_TAG_C
macros.description: Third model tag the RAPS helicopter death trail effect is played on.
macros.remarks: One of three tags used together with RAPS_HELI_DEATH_TRAIL_FX_TAG_A and RAPS_HELI_DEATH_TRAIL_FX_TAG_B.

macros.name: RAPS_HELI_FIRST_EXPLO_FX
macros.description: Effect played on a RAPS delivery helicopter for its first, smaller explosion when it starts to die.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter damage and death effect set.

macros.name: RAPS_HELI_FIRST_EXPLO_FX_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the RAPS helicopter's first explosion effect is played on.
macros.remarks: Part of the RAPS helicopter damage and death effect set.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_DEBUG_AUTO_REACTIVATE
macros.description: Debug switch that automatically reactivates the RAPS killstreak after it finishes.
macros.remarks: The expansion reads a dvar every time the macro is used, so it is a live debug switch rather than a compile-time constant.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_DROP_DURATION
macros.description: Base time in seconds the RAPS dropship spends dropping drones at a location.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_DROP_DURATION_DELTA
macros.description: Random variation in seconds added to the RAPS dropship's drop duration.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_DROP_DURATION_LAST
macros.description: Base time in seconds the RAPS dropship spends on its final drop location.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_DROP_DURATION_LAST_DELTA
macros.description: Random variation in seconds added to the RAPS dropship's final drop duration.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_DROP_INTERVAL
macros.description: Time in seconds between individual drone drops from the RAPS dropship.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_DROP_LOCATION_COUNT
macros.description: Number of locations at which the RAPS dropship drops drones.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_DROP_LOCATION_TOLERANCE_SQR
macros.description: Squared distance within which the RAPS dropship counts as having reached a drop location.
macros.remarks: Stored squared so callers can compare against DistanceSquared without a square root.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_DROP_OFFSET
macros.description: Local offset from the RAPS dropship at which dropped drones are spawned.
macros.remarks: Expands to a vector literal, so it can be passed anywhere a ( x, y, z ) expression is expected.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_FLY_HEIGHT
macros.description: Flight altitude of the RAPS dropship, the map's minimum fly height plus RAPS_HELICOPTER_Z_OFFSET, truncated to an integer.
macros.remarks: The expansion calls airsupport::getMinimumFlyHeight(), so it is evaluated at every use and the airsupport namespace must be in scope.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_HACKS_TO_DESTROY
macros.description: Number of hacker tool applications needed to destroy the RAPS dropship.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_INFO
macros.description: Vehicle info name of the dropship that delivers the RAPS drones.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_LEAVE_LOCATION_REACHED_SQR
macros.description: Squared distance within which the RAPS dropship counts as having reached its exit location.
macros.remarks: Stored squared so callers can compare against DistanceSquared without a square root.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_MISSILE_DAMAGE
macros.description: Damage a single missile does to the RAPS dropship, sized so that RAPS_HELICOPTER_MISSILES_TO_DESTROY hits destroy it.
macros.remarks: Depends on RAPS_HELICOPTER_HEALTH, which is defined elsewhere in the same header.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_MISSILES_TO_DESTROY
macros.description: Number of missile hits needed to destroy the RAPS dropship.
macros.remarks: RAPS_HELICOPTER_MISSILE_DAMAGE is derived from this count and the dropship's health.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_MODEL
macros.description: Model used for the RAPS dropship helicopter.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_ADDITIONAL_TRACE_HEIGHT
macros.description: Extra height added to the clearance trace when validating a RAPS dropship navigation point.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_DEBUG_VISIT_ALL
macros.description: Debug switch that makes the RAPS dropship visit every generated navigation point.
macros.remarks: The expansion reads a dvar every time the macro is used, so it is a live debug switch rather than a compile-time constant.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_DEBUG_VISIT_ALL_FAKE_LEAVE
macros.description: Debug switch that makes the RAPS dropship fake its leave behaviour while visiting every navigation point.
macros.remarks: The expansion reads a dvar every time the macro is used, so it is a live debug switch rather than a compile-time constant.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_END_POINT_TRACE_OFFSET
macros.description: Offset applied to the end point of a RAPS dropship navigation clearance trace.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_MAP_CENTER_MAX_OFFSET
macros.description: Maximum offset from map center used when seeding RAPS dropship navigation point generation.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_MAX_POINT_COUNT
macros.description: Maximum number of navigation points generated for the RAPS dropship.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_POINT_SPACING
macros.description: Minimum spacing in world units between generated RAPS dropship navigation points.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_POINT_TRACE_DEBUG
macros.description: Debug switch that draws the RAPS dropship navigation point clearance traces.
macros.remarks: The expansion reads a dvar every time the macro is used, so it is a live debug switch rather than a compile-time constant.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_RADIUS_MAX
macros.description: Maximum radius from map center considered when generating RAPS dropship navigation points.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_RADIUS_MIN
macros.description: Minimum radius from map center considered when generating RAPS dropship navigation points.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_SPACIOUS_POINT_BOUNDARY
macros.description: Clearance in world units a navigation point needs around it to count as a spacious point for the RAPS dropship.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_NAV_TRACE_BOX_WIDTH
macros.description: Width of the trace box used to test whether a RAPS dropship navigation point is clear.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_REMOTE_MISSILE_DAMAGE
macros.description: Damage a remote-guided missile does to the RAPS dropship, sized so that RAPS_HELICOPTER_REMOTE_MISSILES_TO_DESTROY hits destroy it.
macros.remarks: Depends on RAPS_HELICOPTER_HEALTH, which is defined elsewhere in the same header.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_REMOTE_MISSILES_TO_DESTROY
macros.description: Number of remote-guided missile hits needed to destroy the RAPS dropship.
macros.remarks: Remote missiles are treated as a one hit kill on the dropship, unlike ordinary missiles.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_Z_OFFSET
macros.description: Height added to the map's minimum fly height to get the RAPS dropship's flight altitude.
macros.remarks: Used by RAPS_HELICOPTER_FLY_HEIGHT.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOPTER_Z_OFFSET_PER_HELI
macros.description: Additional height separation applied per RAPS dropship so multiple dropships do not share an altitude.

macros.name: RAPS_HELICOTPER_HACKER_TOOL_DAMAGE
macros.description: Damage one hacker tool application does to the RAPS dropship, sized so that RAPS_HELICOPTER_HACKS_TO_DESTROY uses destroy it.
macros.remarks: The stock name is misspelled "HELICOTPER"; it must be written that way to match the define.

macros.name: RAPS_MODEL
macros.description: Model used for a RAPS drone.

macros.name: RAPS_NAME
macros.description: Killstreak name string used to register and look up the RAPS killstreak.

macros.name: RAPS_SLEEP_DURATION
macros.description: Time in seconds a RAPS drone stays dormant before activating.

macros.name: RAPS_VEHICLE
macros.description: Vehicle spawner name used to spawn a RAPS drone.

macros.name: RAYGUN2_BACKPORT_ENABLED
macros.description: Content switch that enables the Ray Gun Mark II backport in older Zombies maps.
macros.remarks: Evaluated at preprocess time by the shared Zombies content headers alongside BANKING_UPDATE_ENABLED.

macros.name: RAYGUN2_BACKPORT_FREQUENCY
macros.description: Mystery Box weapon frequency given to the backported Ray Gun Mark II.
macros.remarks: A frequency of 0 means the weapon never appears in the box and 100 is the normal weapon frequency.

macros.name: RAZ_ARMOR_DAMAGE_MODIFIER
macros.description: Fraction of incoming damage that carries through to RAZ itself while the struck armor piece is still attached.

macros.name: RAZ_ARMOR_DETACH_FX
macros.description: Short name of the generic effect played when a piece of RAZ armor pops off.

macros.name: RAZ_ARMOR_DETACH_FX_CANNON_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the armor detach effect is played on when the RAZ arm cannon comes off.

macros.name: RAZ_ARMOR_DETACH_FX_CHEST_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the armor detach effect is played on when the RAZ chest plate comes off.

macros.name: RAZ_ARMOR_DETACH_FX_FILE
macros.description: Full effect path of the generic effect played when a piece of RAZ armor pops off.

macros.name: RAZ_ARMOR_DETACH_FX_HELMET_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the armor detach effect is played on when the RAZ helmet comes off.

macros.name: RAZ_ARMOR_DETACH_FX_LEFT_LEG_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the armor detach effect is played on when the RAZ left thigh pad comes off.

macros.name: RAZ_ARMOR_DETACH_FX_LEFT_SHOULDER_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the armor detach effect is played on when the RAZ left shoulder pad comes off.

macros.name: RAZ_ARMOR_DETACH_FX_RIGHT_LEG_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the armor detach effect is played on when the RAZ right thigh pad comes off.

macros.name: RAZ_ARMOR_PAIN_NONE
macros.description: Default gib location blackboard value for the Raz boss, used when no armor piece was hit.
macros.remarks: Registered as the default of the GIB_LOCATION blackboard attribute and restored once an armor pain reaction ends. The value is the string "legs" even though the name reads as "none".

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_DYNENT_LAUNCH_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the detached RAZ chest plate dynamic entity is launched from.

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIDE_TAG_1
macros.description: First model tag hidden on the RAZ body when the chest plate is detached.
macros.remarks: One of six hide tags, RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIDE_TAG_1 through RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIDE_TAG_6.

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIDE_TAG_2
macros.description: Second model tag hidden on the RAZ body when the chest plate is detached.

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIDE_TAG_3
macros.description: Third model tag hidden on the RAZ body when the chest plate is detached.

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIDE_TAG_4
macros.description: Fourth model tag hidden on the RAZ body when the chest plate is detached.

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIDE_TAG_5
macros.description: Fifth model tag hidden on the RAZ body when the chest plate is detached.

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIDE_TAG_6
macros.description: Sixth model tag hidden on the RAZ body when the chest plate is detached.

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIT_RADIUS
macros.description: Radius, in units, around the chest tag within which a hit counts as striking the RAZ chest plate.

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIT_RADIUS_SQ
macros.description: Squared form of the RAZ chest plate hit radius, for distance comparisons without a square root.

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_HIT_TAG
macros.description: Model tag used as the centre of the RAZ chest plate hit test.

macros.name: RAZ_CHEST_ARMOR_MODEL
macros.description: Model name of the detachable RAZ chest plate.

macros.name: RAZ_DEFAULT_CHEST_ARMOR_HEALTH
macros.description: Default amount of damage the RAZ chest plate absorbs before it is knocked off.

macros.name: RAZ_DEFAULT_HELMET_HEALTH
macros.description: Default amount of damage the RAZ helmet absorbs before it is knocked off.

macros.name: RAZ_DEFAULT_L_SHOULDER_ARMOR_HEALTH
macros.description: Default amount of damage the RAZ left shoulder pad absorbs before it is knocked off.

macros.name: REGISTER_SYSTEM
macros.description: Declares a script as a named system with a preload initialiser and a list of systems it depends on. It expands to an autoexec function that calls system::register at load time.

parameters.name: __sys
parameters.description: The system's unique name, as a string.

parameters.name: __func_init_preload
parameters.description: Function pointer run during preload, or undefined.

parameters.name: __reqs
parameters.description: The systems this one requires, as a string or an array of strings.

macros.remarks: Defines a function, so it must be written at file scope and only once per file. Use REGISTER_SYSTEM_EX when a postload initialiser is also needed.

macros.name: REGISTER_SYSTEM_EX
macros.description: Declares a script as a named system with both a preload and a postload initialiser plus its dependencies. It expands to an autoexec function that calls system::register at load time.

parameters.name: __sys
parameters.description: The system's unique name, as a string.

parameters.name: __func_init_preload
parameters.description: Function pointer run during preload, or undefined.

parameters.name: __func_init_postload
parameters.description: Function pointer run after load, or undefined.

parameters.name: __reqs
parameters.description: The systems this one requires, as a string or an array of strings.

macros.remarks: Defines a function, so it must be written at file scope and only once per file. REGISTER_SYSTEM is the shorter form with no postload initialiser.

macros.name: RELATIVE_DIR_NONE
macros.description: Relative direction index meaning no direction, used by tactical walk logic.
macros.remarks: One of the RELATIVE_DIR_* indices (none, front, left, right, back).

macros.name: RELATIVE_DIR_RIGHT
macros.description: Relative direction index for the right, used by tactical walk logic.
macros.remarks: One of the RELATIVE_DIR_* indices (none, front, left, right, back).

macros.name: REMOTE_MISSILE_BOMBLET_FIRED
macros.description: Clientfield state meaning a Hellfire missile bomblet has been fired.

macros.name: REMOTE_MISSILE_FIRED
macros.description: Remote (Hellfire) missile clientfield state meaning the missile has been fired.

macros.name: REMOTE_MISSILE_PLAYER_DETONATED
macros.description: Remote (Hellfire) missile clientfield state meaning the player detonated the missile.

macros.name: REMOTE_MISSILE_VISIONSET_ALIAS
macros.description: Visionset alias applied while the player steers the remote missile.

macros.name: REMOTE_USE_HOLD_TIME_SECONDS
macros.description: Time in seconds the use button must be held to take remote control of a weapon.

macros.name: REPLAY_GUN_NAME
macros.description: Weapon name of the replay gun (chaser) weapon.
macros.remarks: Shares the "chaser" weapon name with GRAPPLE_NAME.

macros.name: REPLAY_GUN_SETTINGS
macros.description: Name of the settings asset that drives the replay gun's behaviour.

macros.name: REPLAYGUN_TARGET_LOCKED
macros.description: Replay gun lock on state passed with a lockon_changed notify meaning the target is locked.
macros.remarks: Mirrors the AP_TARGET_* values used by the anti-personnel guidance weapons.

macros.name: REPLAYGUN_TARGET_LOCKING
macros.description: Replay gun lock on state passed with a lockon_changed notify meaning a lock is being acquired.
macros.remarks: Mirrors the AP_TARGET_* values used by the anti-personnel guidance weapons.

macros.name: REPLAYGUN_TARGET_LOST
macros.description: Replay gun lock on state passed with a lockon_changed notify meaning the target was lost.
macros.remarks: Mirrors the AP_TARGET_* values used by the anti-personnel guidance weapons.

macros.name: REPLAYGUN_TARGET_REGAIN
macros.description: Replay gun lock on state passed with a lockon_changed notify meaning a previously lost target was regained.
macros.remarks: Mirrors the AP_TARGET_* values used by the anti-personnel guidance weapons.

macros.name: REPLAYGUN_TARGET_SUSPEND
macros.description: Replay gun lock on state passed with a lockon_changed notify meaning locking is suspended.
macros.remarks: Mirrors the AP_TARGET_* values used by the anti-personnel guidance weapons.

macros.name: RESPOND_APPEND
macros.description: Alias fragment appended when building a generic response line.

macros.name: RESPONSE_LINE_MAX_DIST
macros.description: Maximum squared distance between two players for one to answer the other's vox line.
macros.remarks: Already squared, so compare it against distancesquared rather than distance.

macros.name: RESPONSE_PERCENTAGE
macros.description: Percentage chance that a player answers another player's vox line.

macros.name: RESURRECT_BODY_DISSAPPEAR_FX
macros.description: Effect played when the downed body of a Rejack user dematerializes.
macros.remarks: The stock spelling of the name has a doubled 's' in DISSAPPEAR.

macros.name: RESURRECT_HELD_DURATION
macros.description: Time in milliseconds the gadget button must be held for the resurrect gadget to trigger.

macros.name: RESURRECT_POSTFX_BUNDLE_CLOSE
macros.description: Post effect bundle played as the resurrecting player's view closes.
macros.remarks: Companion bundles are RESURRECT_POSTFX_BUNDLE_PUS and RESURRECT_POSTFX_BUNDLE_OPEN.

macros.name: RESURRECT_POSTFX_BUNDLE_CLOSE_DURATION
macros.description: Duration in seconds of the eyes-closing post effect played when the resurrect gadget goes down.

macros.name: RESURRECT_POSTFX_BUNDLE_OPEN
macros.description: Post effect bundle played as the resurrecting player's view opens again.

macros.name: RESURRECT_POSTFX_BUNDLE_PUS
macros.description: Post effect bundle played while the resurrecting player is down and waiting.

macros.name: RESURRECT_SHELLSHOCK
macros.description: Shellshock asset name applied to a player while the resurrect gadget plays out.

macros.name: RESURRECT_SMOKE_FX
macros.description: Smoke effect played around a player using the Rejack gadget, which also blocks enemy sight.
macros.remarks: Paired with REJACK_SMOKE_SIGHT_BLOCK_RADIUS and REJACK_SMOKE_SIGHT_BLOCK_TIME.

macros.name: RESURRECT_SMOKE_WEAPON_NAME
macros.description: Weapon name of the smoke grenade thrown by the resurrect gadget.

macros.name: RESURRECT_SPAWN_FX
macros.description: Light effect played when a player respawns in place through the Rejack (resurrect) gadget.

macros.name: RESURRECT_SPAWN_SOUND
macros.description: Sound alias played when a player resurrects with the Rejack gadget.

macros.name: RESURRECT_STATE_BITS
macros.description: Number of bits used to transmit the resurrect gadget state to the client.
macros.remarks: Two bits are enough for the three RESURRECT_STATE_* values.

macros.name: RESURRECT_STATE_DOWN
macros.description: Resurrect gadget state meaning the player is down and may still trigger Rejack.
macros.remarks: One of three states packed into RESURRECT_STATE_BITS bits, with RESURRECT_STATE_NONE and RESURRECT_STATE_UP.

macros.name: RESURRECT_STATE_NONE
macros.description: Resurrect gadget state meaning the player is not using the gadget.
macros.remarks: One of three states packed into RESURRECT_STATE_BITS bits, with RESURRECT_STATE_DOWN and RESURRECT_STATE_UP.

macros.name: RESURRECT_STATE_UP
macros.description: Resurrect gadget state meaning the player is getting back up after resurrecting.
macros.remarks: One of three states packed into RESURRECT_STATE_BITS bits, with RESURRECT_STATE_NONE and RESURRECT_STATE_DOWN.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET
macros.description: Name of the visionset file applied while a player is down with the resurrect gadget.
macros.remarks: Visionset macros for the same effect share the RESURRECT_VISIONSET prefix, and the ramp values are given in seconds.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_ALIAS
macros.description: Script alias used to refer to the resurrect visionset.
macros.remarks: Visionset macros for the same effect share the RESURRECT_VISIONSET prefix, and the ramp values are given in seconds.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_PRIORITY
macros.description: Priority of the resurrect visionset relative to other visionsets.
macros.remarks: Higher values win. The wake-up visionset uses the higher RESURRECT_VISIONSET_UP_PRIORITY of 63.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_RAMP_HOLD
macros.description: Time in seconds the resurrect visionset holds at full strength before ramping out.
macros.remarks: Expands to REJACK_ACTIVATION_WINDOW_SECONDS, so the hold covers the whole activation window.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_RAMP_IN
macros.description: Time in seconds for the resurrect visionset to ramp in on activation.
macros.remarks: Expands to REJACK_ACTIVATION_DELAY_SECONDS, so the ramp tracks the activation delay.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_RAMP_OUT
macros.description: Time in seconds for the resurrect visionset to ramp out on deactivation.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_STEPS
macros.description: Number of interpolation steps used when the resurrect visionset ramps in and out.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_UP
macros.description: Name of the visionset file applied as the player gets back up after resurrecting.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_UP_ALIAS
macros.description: Script alias used to refer to the resurrect wake-up visionset.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_UP_PRIORITY
macros.description: Priority of the resurrect wake-up visionset relative to other visionsets.
macros.remarks: One higher than RESURRECT_VISIONSET_PRIORITY, so the wake-up look overrides the downed look.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_UP_RAMP_HOLD
macros.description: Time in seconds the resurrect wake-up visionset holds at full strength before ramping out.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_UP_RAMP_IN
macros.description: Time in seconds for the resurrect wake-up visionset to ramp in.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_UP_RAMP_OUT
macros.description: Time in seconds for the resurrect wake-up visionset to ramp out.

macros.name: RESURRECT_VISIONSET_UP_STEPS
macros.description: Number of interpolation steps used when the resurrect wake-up visionset ramps in and out.

macros.name: RESURRECT_WEAPON_NAME
macros.description: Weapon name of the resurrect (Rejack) gadget.

macros.name: RESURRECT_WORLD_HINT_FX
macros.description: Effect played in the world to hint that a downed Rejack user can still be revived.

macros.name: REVEAL_MATERIAL_ENEMY
macros.description: Outline material used to draw enemies revealed by the vision pulse gadget.
macros.remarks: The comment notes this variant has no alpha so the shader can tell it apart from the view model material, REVEAL_MATERIAL_SELF.

macros.name: REVEAL_MATERIAL_SELF
macros.description: Outline material used to draw the local player's own view model during a vision pulse.

macros.name: RGB
macros.description: Builds a colour vector from 0 to 255 channel values by dividing each channel down into the engine's 0 to 1 range.

parameters.name: __r
parameters.description: The red channel, from 0 to 255.

parameters.name: __g
parameters.description: The green channel, from 0 to 255.

parameters.name: __b
parameters.description: The blue channel, from 0 to 255.

macros.remarks: The named colours SLATE, PINK, OLIVE and BROWN are defined through this macro.

macros.name: RICHTOFEN_CHAR_INDEX
macros.description: Character index used for Richtofen when selecting vox aliases.
macros.remarks: The *_CHAR_INDEX_R variants order Takeo and Richtofen differently for response lines.

macros.name: RICHTOFEN_CHAR_INDEX_R
macros.description: Character index used for Richtofen when selecting response vox aliases.
macros.remarks: Takeo and Richtofen are swapped relative to the plain *_CHAR_INDEX values, so the response tables are indexed with these instead.

macros.name: RIGHT_TYPE
macros.description: Synchronized melee type for an assassination from the victim's right side.
macros.remarks: One of the melee type indices FRONT_WRESTLE_TYPE, FRONT_FLIP_TYPE, BACK_TYPE, RIGHT_TYPE and LEFT_TYPE.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_AT_NODE_DIST_SQ
macros.description: Squared distance, in units, within which a riot shield AI counts as having arrived at its target node.
macros.remarks: Written as 16 * 16 so the value can be compared against a squared distance without a square root.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_FLINCH_COUNT_TO_STAGGER
macros.description: Number of bullets that must hit a riot shield before the AI carrying it staggers.
macros.remarks: The count is cleared again after RIOTSHIELD_FLINCH_RESET_TIME milliseconds without a hit.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_FLINCH_RESET_TIME
macros.description: Time, in milliseconds, that must pass without a shield hit before the flinch count is reset to zero.
macros.remarks: Counterpart to RIOTSHIELD_FLINCH_COUNT_TO_STAGGER.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_MODEL
macros.description: World model attached to an AI carrying a riot shield.
macros.remarks: Attached at RIOTSHIELD_TAG for the RIOTSHIELD_WEAPON weapon.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_MOVE_DELAY_MAX
macros.description: Maximum delay, in milliseconds, before a riot shield AI picks a new position to move to.
macros.remarks: Paired with RIOTSHIELD_MOVE_DELAY_MIN to randomise the repositioning interval.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_MOVE_DELAY_MIN
macros.description: Minimum delay, in milliseconds, before a riot shield AI picks a new position to move to.
macros.remarks: Paired with RIOTSHIELD_MOVE_DELAY_MAX to randomise the repositioning interval.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_MOVE_DIST_HEIGHT
macros.description: Vertical extent, in units, of the position query a riot shield AI uses when choosing where to move.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_MOVE_DIST_MAX
macros.description: Maximum distance a riot shield AI will pick when choosing a new position to shuffle to.
macros.remarks: Paired with RIOTSHIELD_MOVE_DIST_MIN to bound the position query used for riot shield movement.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_MOVE_DIST_MIN
macros.description: Minimum distance a riot shield AI will pick when choosing a new position to shuffle to.
macros.remarks: Paired with RIOTSHIELD_MOVE_DIST_MAX to bound the position query used for riot shield movement.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_MOVE_DIST_SPACING
macros.description: Spacing, in units, between candidate points in the riot shield AI's move position query.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_RUN_DIST_SQ
macros.description: Squared distance, in units, beyond which a riot shield AI runs rather than walks to its goal.
macros.remarks: Written as 700 * 700 for comparison against squared distances.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_STATE_DEPLOYED
macros.description: Riot shield state value meaning the shield has been planted and is standing deployed.
macros.remarks: One of the riot shield state values sent over a client field, alongside RIOTSHIELD_STATE_DESTROYED. The header notes these were moved out of clientflags.gsh and are plain constants, not client flags.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_STATE_DESTROYED
macros.description: Riot shield state value meaning the deployed shield has been destroyed.
macros.remarks: One of the riot shield state values sent over a client field, alongside RIOTSHIELD_STATE_DEPLOYED. The header notes these were moved out of clientflags.gsh and are plain constants, not client flags.

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the riot shield is attached to on a riot shield AI, the left weapon tag.
macros.example: aiutility::attachRiotshield( entity, GetWeapon( RIOTSHIELD_WEAPON ), RIOTSHIELD_MODEL, RIOTSHIELD_TAG );

macros.name: RIOTSHIELD_WEAPON
macros.description: Weapon name of the riot shield carried by riot shield AI.
macros.remarks: Paired with RIOTSHIELD_MODEL and RIOTSHIELD_TAG in the riot shield archetype header.

macros.name: RIVAL_APPEND
macros.description: Alias suffix appended when building a rival character's response line.
macros.remarks: Used alongside HERO_APPEND and RESPOND_APPEND when composing response aliases.

macros.name: ROBOT_BACKSHOT_MULTIPLIER
macros.description: Damage multiplier applied when a robot is shot in the back.

macros.name: ROBOT_CHOOSE_COVER_CHANCE
macros.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a robot picks a cover position instead of an exposed position.

macros.name: ROBOT_CRAWL_MAX_DISTANCE
macros.description: Squared distance to its attacker within which a robot can become a crawler.
macros.remarks: Written as (600 * 600) for comparison against squared distances.

macros.name: ROBOT_DESTRUCT_DEATH_CHANCE
macros.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that any given destructible piece gibs off when a robot is killed, regardless of hit location.

macros.name: ROBOT_DESTRUCT_MAX_DEATH_PIECES
macros.description: Maximum number of destructible pieces that randomly gib off when a robot is killed.

macros.name: ROBOT_DETONATION_DAMAGE_TYPE
macros.description: Means of death string used for the damage from a robot's self destruct explosion.
macros.remarks: Mirrors the engine MOD_ enum, passed to RadiusDamage.

macros.name: ROBOT_DETONATION_INNER_DAMAGE
macros.description: Damage dealt at the centre of a robot's self destruct explosion.

macros.name: ROBOT_DETONATION_OUTER_DAMAGE
macros.description: Damage dealt at the outer edge of a robot's self destruct explosion.

macros.name: ROBOT_DETONATION_RANGE
macros.description: Radius, in units, of the explosion a robot produces when it self destructs.
macros.remarks: Damage falls off from ROBOT_DETONATION_INNER_DAMAGE to ROBOT_DETONATION_OUTER_DAMAGE across this radius.

macros.name: ROBOT_DIAMETER
macros.description: Diameter, in units, of a robot grunt's collision.

macros.name: ROBOT_EMP_BITS
macros.description: Bit width registered for the robot EMP clientfield.
macros.remarks: One bit, an on/off toggle.

macros.name: ROBOT_EMP_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the clientfield that tells the client a robot is EMP shut down.
macros.remarks: Part of the robot clientfield set declared in archetype_robot.gsh and registered in archetype_robot.gsc/.csc. Takes ROBOT_EMP_OFF or ROBOT_EMP_ON.

macros.name: ROBOT_EMP_FX
macros.description: Registered effect name for the electric surge played when a robot is hit by an EMP.

macros.name: ROBOT_EMP_FX_FILE
macros.description: Path of the effect file for the robot EMP electric surge.

macros.name: ROBOT_EMP_FX_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the robot EMP surge effect plays on, the fourth spine joint.

macros.name: ROBOT_EMP_OFF
macros.description: Robot EMP clientfield value for a robot that is not EMP affected.

macros.name: ROBOT_EMP_ON
macros.description: Robot EMP clientfield value for a robot that is EMP shut down.

macros.name: ROBOT_EMP_SHUTDOWN_TIME
macros.description: Time, in milliseconds, a robot stays inactive after being damaged by an EMP.

macros.name: ROBOT_EMP_TYPE
macros.description: Clientfield value type registered for the robot EMP clientfield.
macros.remarks: Part of the robot clientfield set declared in archetype_robot.gsh and registered in archetype_robot.gsc/.csc.

macros.name: ROBOT_ESCORT_MAX_RADIUS
macros.description: Maximum radius, in units, at which an escorting robot stays from the entity it escorts.
macros.remarks: Paired with ROBOT_ESCORT_MIN_RADIUS.

macros.name: ROBOT_ESCORT_MIN_RADIUS
macros.description: Minimum radius, in units, at which an escorting robot stays from the entity it escorts.
macros.remarks: Paired with ROBOT_ESCORT_MAX_RADIUS.

macros.name: ROBOT_FX_BASE
macros.description: Expands to the robot entity's base FX bundle field, the effect played while the robot is in its normal state.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The robot entity whose FX bundle field is read.

macros.remarks: One of a set of aliases that map named robot FX states onto the entity's generic fxdef and altfxdef fields.

macros.name: ROBOT_FX_BASE_FLICKER
macros.description: Expands to the robot entity's flickering base FX bundle field, used when the robot's lights flicker in its normal state.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The robot entity whose FX bundle field is read.

macros.name: ROBOT_FX_DEATH
macros.description: Expands to the robot entity's death FX bundle field, the effect played when the robot dies.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The robot entity whose FX bundle field is read.

macros.name: ROBOT_FX_ROGUE_LEVEL_1
macros.description: Expands to the robot entity's FX bundle field for the first rogue (mind controlled) stage.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The robot entity whose FX bundle field is read.

macros.remarks: Rogue level 1 and level 2 both map to altfxdef1, so the two stages share one effect bundle.

macros.name: ROBOT_FX_ROGUE_LEVEL_1_FLICKER
macros.description: Expands to the robot entity's flickering FX bundle field for the first rogue stage.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The robot entity whose FX bundle field is read.

macros.remarks: Rogue level 1 and level 2 flicker both map to altfxdef4.

macros.name: ROBOT_FX_ROGUE_LEVEL_2
macros.description: Expands to the robot entity's FX bundle field for the second rogue (mind controlled) stage.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The robot entity whose FX bundle field is read.

macros.remarks: Expands to the same field as ROBOT_FX_ROGUE_LEVEL_1.

macros.name: ROBOT_FX_ROGUE_LEVEL_2_FLICKER
macros.description: Expands to the robot entity's flickering FX bundle field for the second rogue stage.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The robot entity whose FX bundle field is read.

macros.remarks: Expands to the same field as ROBOT_FX_ROGUE_LEVEL_1_FLICKER.

macros.name: ROBOT_FX_ROGUE_LEVEL_3
macros.description: Expands to the robot entity's FX bundle field for the third and final rogue stage.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The robot entity whose FX bundle field is read.

macros.name: ROBOT_FX_ROGUE_LEVEL_3_FLICKER
macros.description: Expands to the robot entity's flickering FX bundle field for the third rogue stage.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The robot entity whose FX bundle field is read.

macros.name: ROBOT_GIB_HEAD_DEATH_CHANCE
macros.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a robot's head gibs off when it is dealt a fatal blow.

macros.name: ROBOT_GIB_HEAD_EXPLOSION_CHANCE
macros.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a robot's head gibs off when it is damaged by an explosion.

macros.name: ROBOT_GIB_HEAD_HEADSHOT_CHANCE
macros.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a robot's head gibs off when it is killed with a headshot.

macros.name: ROBOT_GIB_HEALTH_THRESHOLD
macros.description: Fraction of maximum health a robot must be below before its arms and head can be gibbed off.

macros.name: ROBOT_GIB_LEG_HEALTH_THRESHOLD
macros.description: Fraction of maximum health a robot must be below before a leg can be gibbed off.

macros.name: ROBOT_GIB_LEGS_CHANCE
macros.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a robot's legs gib off when it is killed with a shot to the legs.

macros.name: ROBOT_GIB_LEGS_DEATH_CHANCE
macros.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a robot's legs gib off randomly when it is killed.

macros.name: ROBOT_GIB_LEGS_EXPLOSION_CHANCE
macros.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a robot's legs gib off when it is killed by an explosion.

macros.name: ROBOT_GIB_LIMB_DEATH_CHANCE
macros.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a robot's limb gibs off when it is killed with a shot to that limb.

macros.name: ROBOT_GIB_LIMB_EXPLOSION_CHANCE
macros.description: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a robot's limb gibs off when it is killed by an explosion.

macros.name: ROBOT_HEAD_GIB_FX
macros.description: Effect name for the sparks played when a robot's head gibs off.
macros.remarks: Loaded from the file named by ROBOT_HEAD_GIB_FX_FILE and played at the tag named by ROBOT_HEAD_GIB_FX_TAG.

macros.name: ROBOT_HEAD_GIB_FX_FILE
macros.description: Path of the effect file for the spark burst played when a robot's head is gibbed.
macros.remarks: Pairs with ROBOT_HEAD_GIB_FX (the effect's registered name) and ROBOT_HEAD_GIB_FX_TAG (the tag it plays on).

macros.name: ROBOT_HEAD_GIB_FX_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the robot head gib effect is played on, the neck joint.

macros.name: ROBOT_HEADSHOT_MULTIPLIER
macros.description: Damage multiplier applied when a robot is shot in the head.
macros.remarks: Values below 1 reduce damage, so robot headshots are worth less than body shots.

macros.name: ROBOT_HEIGHT
macros.description: Height, in units, of a robot grunt's collision.

macros.name: ROBOT_INVALID_COVER_DISTANCE
macros.description: Distance, in units, within which a cover position is rejected as too close to be useful to a robot.

macros.name: ROBOT_JUKE_DISTANCE
macros.description: Distance, in units, a robot travels sideways when it jukes.

macros.name: ROBOT_JUKE_MAX_DISTANCE
macros.description: Maximum distance to its enemy at which a robot will juke.

macros.name: ROBOT_JUKE_PREEMPTIVE_MAX_DISTANCE
macros.description: Maximum distance to its enemy at which a robot will perform a preemptive juke.

macros.name: ROBOT_JUMP_DIRECTION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding the direction a robot AI is jumping in.

macros.name: ROBOT_LIGHTS_BITS
macros.description: Bit width registered for the robot lights clientfield.
macros.remarks: Three bits, enough for the five robot light states.

macros.name: ROBOT_LIGHTS_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the clientfield that drives the state of a robot's lights on the client.
macros.remarks: Part of the robot clientfield set declared in archetype_robot.gsh and registered in archetype_robot.gsc/.csc. Its values are ROBOT_LIGHTS_ON, ROBOT_LIGHTS_FLICKER, ROBOT_LIGHTS_OFF, ROBOT_LIGHTS_HACKED and ROBOT_LIGHTS_DEATH.

macros.name: ROBOT_LIGHTS_DEATH
macros.description: Robot lights clientfield value applied when the robot dies.

macros.name: ROBOT_LIGHTS_FLICKER
macros.description: Robot lights clientfield value for flickering lights, used while the robot is damaged or EMP affected.

macros.name: ROBOT_LIGHTS_HACKED
macros.description: Robot lights clientfield value for the look a robot takes on once it has been hacked.

macros.name: ROBOT_LIGHTS_OFF
macros.description: Robot lights clientfield value for lights turned off.

macros.name: ROBOT_LIGHTS_ON
macros.description: Robot lights clientfield value for lights lit normally.
macros.remarks: Note that the on state is 0, not 1.

macros.name: ROBOT_LIGHTS_TYPE
macros.description: Clientfield value type registered for the robot lights clientfield.
macros.remarks: Part of the robot clientfield set declared in archetype_robot.gsh and registered in archetype_robot.gsc/.csc.

macros.name: ROBOT_LOCOMOTION_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding the locomotion type a robot AI is currently moving with.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_BITS
macros.description: Bit width registered for the robot mind control clientfield.
macros.remarks: Two bits, enough for the four ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_ values.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the clientfield that carries a robot's mind control (rogue) level to the client.
macros.remarks: Part of the robot clientfield set declared in archetype_robot.gsh and registered in archetype_robot.gsc/.csc. Its width is ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_BITS and its values are the ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_ macros.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_BITS
macros.description: Bit width registered for the robot mind control explosion clientfield.
macros.remarks: One bit, an on/off toggle.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the clientfield that triggers the explosion effect on a mind controlled robot.
macros.remarks: Part of the robot clientfield set declared in archetype_robot.gsh and registered in archetype_robot.gsc/.csc. Takes ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_OFF or ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_ON.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_FX
macros.description: Registered effect name for the explosion played when a mind controlled robot is destroyed.
macros.remarks: Pairs with ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_FX_FILE and ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_FX_TAG.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_FX_FILE
macros.description: Path of the effect file for the mind control robot explosion.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_FX_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the mind control robot explosion plays on, the upper spine joint.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_OFF
macros.description: Robot mind control explosion clientfield value that leaves the explosion effect off.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_ON
macros.description: Robot mind control explosion clientfield value that plays the explosion effect.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_EXPLOSION_TYPE
macros.description: Clientfield value type registered for the robot mind control explosion clientfield.
macros.remarks: Part of the robot clientfield set declared in archetype_robot.gsh and registered in archetype_robot.gsc/.csc.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_0
macros.description: Robot mind control clientfield value for a robot that is not mind controlled.
macros.remarks: One of ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_0 through ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_3.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_1
macros.description: Robot mind control clientfield value for the first stage of mind control.
macros.remarks: One of ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_0 through ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_3.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_2
macros.description: Robot mind control clientfield value for the second stage of mind control.
macros.remarks: One of ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_0 through ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_3.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_3
macros.description: Robot mind control clientfield value for the third and final stage of mind control, at which the robot detonates.
macros.remarks: One of ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_0 through ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_LEVEL_3.

macros.name: ROBOT_MIND_CONTROL_TYPE
macros.description: Clientfield value type registered for the robot mind control clientfield.
macros.remarks: Part of the robot clientfield set declared in archetype_robot.gsh and registered in archetype_robot.gsc/.csc.

macros.name: ROBOT_MINI_RAPS_AUTO_DETONATE_MAX_TIME
macros.description: Maximum time, in seconds, before a deployed mini RAPS drone detonates on its own.
macros.remarks: Paired with ROBOT_MINI_RAPS_AUTO_DETONATE_MIN_TIME to randomise the fuse.

macros.name: ROBOT_MINI_RAPS_AUTO_DETONATE_MIN_TIME
macros.description: Minimum time, in seconds, before a deployed mini RAPS drone detonates on its own.
macros.remarks: Paired with ROBOT_MINI_RAPS_AUTO_DETONATE_MAX_TIME to randomise the fuse.

macros.name: ROBOT_MINI_RAPS_LINK_TO_BONE
macros.description: Bone that carried mini RAPS drones are linked to on the robot.

macros.name: ROBOT_MINI_RAPS_MODEL
macros.description: Model name used for the mini RAPS drones a robot carries.

macros.name: ROBOT_MINI_RAPS_OFFSET_POSITION
macros.description: Offset from the link bone at which a carried mini RAPS drone is placed.
macros.remarks: Expands to a vector literal, so it can be used directly as a position argument.

macros.name: ROBOT_MINI_RAPS_SPAWNER
macros.description: Spawner target name used to spawn the mini RAPS drones a robot deploys.

macros.name: ROBOT_MODE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding a robot AI's overall behaviour mode.

macros.name: ROBOT_NAVMESH_MAX_TOLERANCE_LEVELS
macros.description: Number of widening search steps taken when looking for a navmesh point near a robot.
macros.remarks: Each level widens the search by ROBOT_NAVMESH_TOLERANCE.

macros.name: ROBOT_NAVMESH_TOLERANCE
macros.description: Distance, in units, a robot may be from the navmesh and still be snapped onto it.
macros.remarks: Used together with ROBOT_NAVMESH_MAX_TOLERANCE_LEVELS when searching outward for a valid navmesh point.

macros.name: ROBOT_OFF_COVER_NODE_MAX_DISTANCE
macros.description: Maximum distance, in units, from its cover node at which a robot may take an off cover position.
macros.remarks: Paired with ROBOT_OFF_COVER_NODE_MIN_DISTANCE.

macros.name: ROBOT_OFF_COVER_NODE_MIN_DISTANCE
macros.description: Minimum distance, in units, from its cover node at which a robot may take an off cover position.
macros.remarks: Paired with ROBOT_OFF_COVER_NODE_MAX_DISTANCE.

macros.name: ROBOT_PAUSE_TACTICAL_WALK
macros.description: Time, in milliseconds, a robot pauses during a tactical walk.

macros.name: ROBOT_POSITION_QUERY_MOVE_DIST_MAX
macros.description: Maximum distance, in units, a robot's position query will consider moving.

macros.name: ROBOT_POSITION_QUERY_RADIUS
macros.description: Radius, in units, of the position query a robot uses when picking a nearby spot to move to.

macros.name: ROBOT_RESUME_COVER_TIME
macros.description: Time, in milliseconds, a robot stays exposed after being shot while popping out of cover.

macros.name: ROBOT_RUSHER_DISTANCE_SQ
macros.description: Squared distance a robot must be from its enemy before it can become a rusher.
macros.remarks: Written as (600 * 600) for comparison against squared distances.

macros.name: ROBOT_RUSHER_MAX_ENEMY_DISTANCE_SQ
macros.description: Squared distance to the enemy beyond which a robot is not considered for rushing.
macros.remarks: Written as (1200 * 1200) for comparison against squared distances.

macros.name: ROBOT_RUSHER_MAX_RADIUS
macros.description: Maximum radius, in units, of the goal ring a rushing robot moves to around its enemy.
macros.remarks: Paired with ROBOT_RUSHER_MIN_RADIUS.

macros.name: ROBOT_RUSHER_MIN_RADIUS
macros.description: Minimum radius, in units, of the goal ring a rushing robot moves to around its enemy.
macros.remarks: Paired with ROBOT_RUSHER_MAX_RADIUS.

macros.name: ROBOT_RUSHER_NEIGHBOR_DISTANCE_SQ
macros.description: Squared distance within which nearby robots may turn into rushers when a fellow robot dies.
macros.remarks: Written as (400 * 400) for comparison against squared distances.

macros.name: ROBOT_STEP_IN
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name describing the step-in a robot AI should play when arriving at its goal.

macros.name: ROBOT_SUPER_SPRINT_DISTANCE
macros.description: Distance to the target beyond which a robot begins to super sprint.

macros.name: ROBOT_TACTICAL_JUKE_RADIUS
macros.description: Radius, in units, of the position query used to find a tactical juke spot for a robot.

macros.name: ROBOT_TRAVERSAL_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding the traversal type a robot AI is performing.

macros.name: ROBOT_WALK_MIN_DISTANCE
macros.description: Path length, in units, below which a robot walks instead of sprinting even when the target is in sprint range.

macros.name: ROBOT_WALLRUN_DIRECTION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name holding the direction a robot AI is wallrunning in.

macros.name: ROLL
macros.description: Index of the roll component within an angles vector.
macros.remarks: Paired with PITCH and YAW for the other two components.

macros.name: RUN_N_GUN_FORWARD
macros.description: Value of the RUN_N_GUN_VARIATION blackboard attribute selecting the forward run and gun variation.

macros.name: RUN_N_GUN_STRAFE_1
macros.description: Value of the RUN_N_GUN_VARIATION blackboard attribute selecting the first strafing run and gun variation.

macros.name: RUN_N_GUN_STRAFE_2
macros.description: Value of the RUN_N_GUN_VARIATION blackboard attribute selecting the second strafing run and gun variation.

macros.name: RUN_N_GUN_VARIATION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name selecting which run and gun movement variation an AI plays.

macros.name: SAFEHOUSE_CAIRO
macros.description: Identifier for the Cairo safehouse.
macros.remarks: One of the SAFEHOUSE_* campaign safehouse identifiers (1 to 3).

macros.name: SAFEHOUSE_MOBILE
macros.description: Identifier for the the mobile command safehouse.
macros.remarks: One of the SAFEHOUSE_* campaign safehouse identifiers (1 to 3).

macros.name: SAFEHOUSE_SINGAPORE
macros.description: Identifier for the Singapore safehouse.
macros.remarks: One of the SAFEHOUSE_* campaign safehouse identifiers (1 to 3).

macros.name: SATELLITE_DURATION_MS
macros.description: Lifetime of the satellite killstreak in milliseconds.

macros.name: SATELLITE_HEALTH
macros.description: Starting and maximum health of the satellite killstreak.

macros.name: SATELLITE_LOW_HEALTH
macros.description: Health threshold at which the satellite killstreak is treated as damaged, half of its full health.

macros.name: SATELLITE_MISSILES_TO_DESTROY
macros.description: Number of lock-on missile hits needed to destroy the satellite killstreak.
macros.remarks: Missile damage for the satellite is derived from its health divided by this count, the same pattern the RAPS helicopter uses.

macros.name: SATELLITE_MODEL
macros.description: Model used for the satellite killstreak vehicle.

macros.name: SATELLITE_MODEL_SCALE
macros.description: Model scale applied to the satellite killstreak model.

macros.name: SATELLITE_ROTATION_DURATION
macros.description: Time in seconds the satellite killstreak takes to turn to a new heading.

macros.name: SATELLITE_SPAWN_FROM_ANGLE_MAX
macros.description: Maximum angle, relative to map center, at which the satellite killstreak enters the map.
macros.remarks: Paired with SATELLITE_SPAWN_FROM_ANGLE_MIN to pick a random approach angle.

macros.name: SATELLITE_SPAWN_FROM_ANGLE_MIN
macros.description: Minimum angle, relative to map center, at which the satellite killstreak enters the map.
macros.remarks: Paired with SATELLITE_SPAWN_FROM_ANGLE_MAX to pick a random approach angle.

macros.name: SATELLITE_TRAVEL_DISTANCE_SCALE
macros.description: Scale applied to the distance the satellite killstreak travels over its lifetime.

macros.name: SATELLITE_Z_OFFSET
macros.description: Height added to the map's minimum fly height to place the satellite killstreak.

macros.name: SCORE_EVENT_DEATH_STREAK_COUNT_REQUIRED
macros.description: Number of consecutive deaths required before death streak score events fire.

macros.name: SCORE_EVENT_GAMETYPE_COLUMN_COUNT
macros.description: Number of columns each gametype occupies in the score info table.

macros.name: SCORE_EVENT_GAMETYPE_COLUMN_SCORE
macros.description: Offset of the score value within a per gametype pair of score info table columns.

macros.name: SCORE_EVENT_GAMETYPE_COLUMN_XP
macros.description: Offset of the XP value within a per gametype pair of score info table columns.

macros.name: SCORE_EVENT_MAX_COUNT
macros.description: Maximum number of score events that can be registered from the score info table.

macros.name: SCORE_EVENT_MEDAL_WAIT_TIME
macros.description: Time in seconds to wait between showing queued medals.

macros.name: SCORE_EVENT_OBITUARY_CENTERTIME
macros.description: Time in seconds that score event obituary text stays on screen.

macros.name: SCORE_EVENT_TABLE_NAME_CP
macros.description: Path of the score event table that defines score and medal info for campaign.

macros.name: SCORE_EVENT_TABLE_NAME_MP
macros.description: Path of the score event table that defines score and medal info for multiplayer.

macros.name: SCORE_EVENT_TABLE_NAME_ZM
macros.description: Path of the score event table that defines score and medal info for zombies.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_DEMO_BOOKMARK_PRIORITY
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding the demo bookmark priority of the event.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_DOUBLE_XP
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding whether double XP applies to the event.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_GAMETYPE_SCORE
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding the first per gametype score column.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_GAMETYPE_XP
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding the first per gametype XP column.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_GIVE_GUN_XP
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding whether the event awards weapon XP.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_INCLUDE_COMBAT_EFFICIENCY_EVENT
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding whether the event feeds combat efficiency.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_INCLUDE_HERO
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding whether the event counts toward hero ability charge.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_INCLUDE_KILLSTREAKS
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding whether killstreak progress counts for the event.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_MEDAL_BACKING_MATERIAL
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding the backing material drawn behind the medal.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_MEDAL_CATEGORY
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding the medal category.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_MEDAL_REFERENCE
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding the medal reference awarded by the event.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_MEDAL_SORT_KEY
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding the sort key used to order medals.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_SAVE_MEDAL_STATS
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding whether the medal is recorded in player stats.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_SCORE_STRING
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding the localized string shown for the event.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_SCRIPT_REFERENCE
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding the script reference name of the score event.

macros.name: SCOREINFOTABLE_TEAM_SCORE_MATERIAL
macros.description: Column index in the score info table holding the material used for the team score display.

macros.name: SCR_BUNDLE
macros.description: Looks up a loaded script bundle by name within the bundle type named by the file's SCRIPTBUNDLE define.

parameters.name: __name
parameters.description: The name of the script bundle to look up.

macros.remarks: Requires the including file to define SCRIPTBUNDLE to its bundle type before use.

macros.name: SCREEN_HEIGHT
macros.description: The height in pixels of the native UI resolution that hud coordinates are authored against.
macros.remarks: The stock header notes the native UI resolution is 720p; see also SCREEN_WIDTH.

macros.name: SCREEN_WIDTH
macros.description: The width in pixels of the native UI resolution that hud coordinates are authored against.
macros.remarks: The stock header notes the native UI resolution is 720p; see also SCREEN_HEIGHT.

macros.name: SCRIPT_FORCESPAWN_ALWAYS
macros.description: Value of script_forcespawn that makes a buildable piece always spawn at this point when it is available.
macros.remarks: One of the SCRIPT_FORCESPAWN_* values set on managed buildable piece spawn points in Radiant.

macros.name: SCRIPT_FORCESPAWN_NEVER
macros.description: Value of script_forcespawn that stops a buildable piece spawn point from ever being used.
macros.remarks: One of the SCRIPT_FORCESPAWN_* values set on managed buildable piece spawn points in Radiant.

macros.name: SCRIPT_FORCESPAWN_NONE
macros.description: Value of a buildable piece spawn point's script_forcespawn that leaves it as an ordinary managed spawn point.
macros.remarks: One of the SCRIPT_FORCESPAWN_* values read from the script_forcespawn key on managed buildable piece spawn points in Radiant.

macros.name: SCRIPT_FORCESPAWN_ONCE
macros.description: Value of script_forcespawn that forces a buildable piece to spawn at this point once, after which it is used as a normal spawn point.
macros.remarks: One of the SCRIPT_FORCESPAWN_* values set on managed buildable piece spawn points in Radiant.

macros.name: SCRIPT_FORCESPAWN_ONCE_ONLY
macros.description: Value of script_forcespawn that forces a buildable piece to spawn at this point once and then never use the point again.
macros.remarks: One of the SCRIPT_FORCESPAWN_* values set on managed buildable piece spawn points in Radiant.

macros.name: SEEK_OUT_ENEMY_FAILURE_MAX_ATTEMPTS
macros.description: Number of failed seek out attempts after which the actor stops trying.

macros.name: SEEK_OUT_ENEMY_INTERVAL_FAILURE

macros.name: SEEK_OUT_ENEMY_INTERVAL_SUCCESS
macros.description: Time, in milliseconds, before an actor tries to seek out its enemy again after a successful attempt.

macros.name: SEEK_OUT_ENEMY_RADIUS_BIG

macros.name: SEEK_OUT_ENEMY_RADIUS_SMALL

macros.name: SEEN_ENEMY_RECENTLY_INTERVAL

macros.name: SET_CLEARANCE_CEILING_WRAPPER
macros.description: Sets the pathing clearance ceiling, raising it to at least 34 when the level is running in campaign zombies mode. Outside that mode the requested value is used unchanged.

parameters.name: __value
parameters.description: Clearance ceiling height, in inches, to apply outside of campaign zombies mode.

macros.remarks: Evaluates IS_BONUSZM and calls the SetClearanceCeiling builtin, so it has a side effect and expands to a full if/else statement.

macros.name: SET_DESTRUCTED
macros.description: Returns a destruction state with the given destruction flag set.

parameters.name: destruct_state
parameters.description: Destruction state bitfield to modify.

parameters.name: destruct_flag
parameters.description: Flag bit to set, usually from GET_DESTRUCT_FLAG.

macros.name: SET_GIBBED
macros.description: Returns a gib state with the given gib flag set, masking the flag down to the gib flag bits first.

parameters.name: gib_state
parameters.description: Gib state bitfield to modify.

parameters.name: gib_flag
parameters.description: Gib flag bit to set, such as GIB_TORSO_LEFT_ARM_FLAG.

macros.example: self clientfield::set( GIB_CLIENTFIELD, SET_GIBBED( gib_state, GIB_TORSO_LEFT_ARM_FLAG ) );
macros.remarks: For players, use SET_GIBBED_PLAYER so the direction bits are packed in as well.

macros.name: SET_GIBBED_PLAYER
macros.description: Returns a player gib state with the given gib flag set and the gib direction packed in above the flag bits.

parameters.name: gib_state
parameters.description: Current gib state bitfield.

parameters.name: gib_flag
parameters.description: Gib flag bit to set.

parameters.name: yawbits
parameters.description: Packed gib direction, fitting in GIB_DIR_BITS bits.

macros.example: self clientfield::set( GIB_CLIENTFIELD, SET_GIBBED_PLAYER( gib_state, gib_flag, yawbits ) );
macros.remarks: Replaces any direction bits already in gib_state, since the old state is stripped down to its flags first. The player form of SET_GIBBED.

macros.name: SET_IF_DEFINED
macros.description: Assigns a value to a target variable only when the source value is defined, leaving the target untouched otherwise.

parameters.name: __target
parameters.description: The variable or field to assign to.

parameters.name: __src
parameters.description: The value to assign if it is defined.

macros.remarks: Expands to a statement, not an expression, and the source expression is evaluated twice.

macros.name: SPRINT_GAP_TIME

macros.name: SPRINT_PROBABILITY

macros.name: SQR
macros.description: Returns the square of a value. It is commonly used to compare squared distances without taking a square root.

parameters.name: __var
parameters.description: The value to square.

macros.name: STAIR_SKIP_3
macros.description: Stair skip value for a staircase animation that covers three stairs per cycle.
macros.remarks: Stored in the STAIRCASE_STEP_SKIP_NUM attribute, alongside STAIR_SKIP_6 and STAIR_SKIP_8.

macros.name: STAIR_SKIP_4
macros.description: Stair skip value for a staircase animation that covers four stairs per cycle.
macros.remarks: A comment on the definition notes that the four stair skip is not implemented yet.

macros.name: STAIR_SKIP_6
macros.description: Stair skip value for a staircase animation that covers six stairs per cycle.
macros.remarks: Stored in the STAIRCASE_STEP_SKIP_NUM attribute, alongside STAIR_SKIP_3 and STAIR_SKIP_8.

macros.name: STAIR_SKIP_8
macros.description: Stair skip value for a staircase animation that covers eight stairs per cycle.
macros.remarks: Stored in the STAIRCASE_STEP_SKIP_NUM attribute, alongside STAIR_SKIP_3 and STAIR_SKIP_6.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_DIRECTION
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name for whether an actor is going up or down a staircase.
macros.remarks: Takes either STAIRCASE_UP or STAIRCASE_DOWN.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_DOWN
macros.description: Staircase direction value meaning the actor is descending the staircase.
macros.remarks: Stored in the STAIRCASE_DIRECTION attribute, paired with STAIRCASE_UP.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_DOWN_EXIT_L_2_STAIRS

macros.name: STAIRCASE_DOWN_EXIT_R_2_STAIRS
macros.description: Staircase exit type for leaving a downward staircase on the right foot over two stairs.
macros.remarks: One of the staircase exit types stored in STAIRCASE_EXIT_TYPE.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_END
macros.description: Staircase state value for leaving a staircase.
macros.remarks: Stored in the STAIRCASE_STATE attribute, alongside STAIRCASE_START and STAIRCASE_LOOP.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_END_THRESHOLD_DISTSQ
macros.description: Squared distance within which the actor is treated as having reached the end of a staircase.
macros.remarks: Expands to the expression 16*16, so parenthesise it if it is used inside a larger expression.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_EXIT_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name for which staircase exit animation an actor should use.
macros.remarks: Takes one of the STAIRCASE_UP_EXIT_* or STAIRCASE_DOWN_EXIT_* values.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_LOOP
macros.description: Staircase state value for the repeating middle of a staircase traversal.
macros.remarks: Stored in the STAIRCASE_STATE attribute, alongside STAIRCASE_START and STAIRCASE_END.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_NUM_STEPS
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name for the number of steps the actor still has to traverse.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_NUM_TOTAL_STEPS
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name for the total number of steps in the staircase being traversed.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_START
macros.description: Staircase state value for entering a staircase.
macros.remarks: Stored in the STAIRCASE_STATE attribute, alongside STAIRCASE_LOOP and STAIRCASE_END.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_STATE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name for the stage of a staircase traversal the actor is in.
macros.remarks: Takes one of STAIRCASE_START, STAIRCASE_LOOP or STAIRCASE_END.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_STEP_SKIP_NUM
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name for how many stairs an actor's staircase animation covers per cycle.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_TYPE

macros.name: STAIRCASE_UP

macros.name: STAIRCASE_UP_EXIT_L_3_STAIRS

macros.name: STAIRCASE_UP_EXIT_L_4_STAIRS
macros.description: Staircase exit type for leaving an upward staircase on the left foot over four stairs.
macros.remarks: One of the staircase exit types stored in STAIRCASE_EXIT_TYPE.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_UP_EXIT_R_3_STAIRS
macros.description: Staircase exit type for leaving an upward staircase on the right foot over three stairs.
macros.remarks: One of the staircase exit types stored in STAIRCASE_EXIT_TYPE.

macros.name: STAIRCASE_UP_EXIT_R_4_STAIRS
macros.description: Staircase exit type for leaving an upward staircase on the right foot over four stairs.
macros.remarks: One of the staircase exit types stored in STAIRCASE_EXIT_TYPE.

macros.name: STATS_ALLOCATION_COLUMN

macros.name: STATS_COST_COLUMN
macros.description: Column index of an item's cost in the campaign stats table.
macros.remarks: Column index into the cp stats table (statstable). Related columns are STATS_COST_COLUMN, STATS_REFERENCE_COLUMN, STATS_GROUP_COLUMN, STATS_LOADOUT_SLOT and STATS_ALLOCATION_COLUMN.

macros.name: STATS_GROUP_COLUMN

macros.remarks: Column index into the cp stats table (statstable). Related columns are STATS_COST_COLUMN, STATS_REFERENCE_COLUMN, STATS_GROUP_COLUMN, STATS_LOADOUT_SLOT and STATS_ALLOCATION_COLUMN.

macros.name: STATS_LOADOUT_SLOT

macros.name: STATS_REFERENCE_COLUMN
