macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_ALLOCATION
macros.description: Stats table column holding the item's allocation cost in a create-a-class loadout.
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_ATTACHMENTS
macros.description: Stats table column reserved for extra string data about the item, such as its attachments.
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_COUNT
macros.description: Stats table column holding the item's count, where -1 means the item has no count.
macros.example: itemCount = int( TableLookup( level.statsTableID, STATS_TABLE_COL_REFERENCE, itemReference, STATS_TABLE_COL_COUNT ) );
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_DEFAULT_CLASS
macros.description: Stats table column holding extra numeric data about the item, used for primary weapon camo skin numbers.
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_DESC
macros.description: Stats table column holding the item's description text.
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_DLC_INDEX
macros.description: Column index of the DLC required by an item in the stats table.
macros.remarks: The column holds a string. One of the STATS_TABLE_COL_* column indices for the stats table.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_GROUP
macros.description: Stats table column holding the item's group name, such as primary, secondary, inventory or attachment.
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_IMAGE
macros.description: Stats table column holding the file name of the item's image.
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_MOMENTUM
macros.description: Stats table column holding the item's momentum cost.
macros.example: level.killstreaks[killstreakType].momentumCost = int( TableLookup( statsTableName, STATS_TABLE_COL_REFERENCE, killstreakMenuName, STATS_TABLE_COL_MOMENTUM ) );
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_NAME
macros.description: Stats table column holding the item's display name.
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_NUMBERING
macros.description: Stats table column holding the item's unique index, the general numbering of all items.
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_REFERENCE
macros.description: Stats table column holding the item's reference string, the name scripts look the item up by.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_SLOT
macros.description: Stats table column holding the loadout slot the item belongs to.
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_SORT_KEY
macros.description: Stats table column holding extra numeric data about the item, used for attachment numbering.
macros.remarks: Column index into the stats table (level.statsTableID), used with TableLookup and TableLookupColumnForRow. The mp, zm and shared headers define the same indices.

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_COL_UNLOCK_LEVEL

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_MAX_ITEMS

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_MP

macros.name: STATS_TABLE_ZM
macros.description: Path to the zombies stats table, the CSV that maps stat names to their indices and defaults.
macros.remarks: Companion to STATS_TABLE_CP and STATS_TABLE_MP.

macros.name: STOP_FX_IMMEDIATELY
macros.description: Readability constant passed where an effect should be stopped at once instead of being allowed to finish.

macros.name: STR
macros.description: Converts a value to a string, yielding the empty string when the value is undefined.

parameters.name: __var
parameters.description: The value to convert; may be undefined.

macros.remarks: The argument is evaluated twice. Use STR_DEFAULT to substitute something other than the empty string.

macros.name: STR_DEFAULT
macros.description: Converts a value to a string, falling back to a given replacement when the value is undefined.

parameters.name: __var
parameters.description: The value to convert; may be undefined.

parameters.name: __def
parameters.description: The value used instead when the first is undefined.

macros.remarks: The fallback is itself passed through STR, so an undefined fallback yields the empty string.

macros.name: TEAM_ALLIES

macros.name: TEAM_AXIS
macros.description: Team index for the axis team.

macros.name: TEAM_FREE
macros.description: Team index for the free, or teamless, team.
macros.remarks: Mirrors the engine's team enum, alongside TEAM_ALLIES and TEAM_AXIS. These are numeric indices, distinct from the team name strings used by most script functions.

macros.name: THRASHER_BERSERK_CF

macros.name: THRASHER_BERSERK_CF_TYPE

macros.name: THRASHER_BERSERK_EYE_FX

macros.description: Asset path of the thrasher right leg rage gas effect, used when precaching it.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUME_COOLDOWN
macros.description: Time in milliseconds a thrasher must wait between consuming zombies.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUME_DIST
macros.description: Maximum distance at which a thrasher can start consuming its target.
macros.remarks: THRASHER_CONSUME_DIST_SQ holds the squared form.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUME_DIST_SQ
macros.description: Square of the thrasher consume distance, for use with DistanceSquared.
macros.remarks: Expands to a multiplication of THRASHER_CONSUME_DIST, so parenthesise it when embedding in a larger expression.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUME_MAX
macros.description: Maximum number of times a thrasher can consume a zombie.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUME_PLAYER_DISTANCE
macros.description: Maximum distance at which a thrasher will consider a downed player for consumption.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUME_ZOMBIE_HEIGHT
macros.description: Maximum height difference allowed between a thrasher and a zombie it wants to consume.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUME_ZOMBIE_MAX_DIST
macros.description: Maximum distance at which a thrasher will select a zombie to consume.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUME_ZOMBIE_MIN_DIST
macros.description: Minimum distance a zombie must be from a thrasher to be selected for consumption.

macros.description: Effect name shown to a player who has been consumed by the thrasher.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUMED_PLAYER_FX_FILE
macros.description: Asset path of the consumed player drool effect, used when precaching it.
macros.remarks: The asset is the first person (1p) variant, so the path does not match the effect name exactly.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUMED_PLAYER_POSTFX
macros.description: Post effect bundle applied to a player while inside the thrasher stomach.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUMED_PLAYER_VISIONSET_ALIAS

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUMED_PLAYER_VISIONSET_FILE
macros.description: Vision set asset applied to a player while inside the thrasher stomach.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUMED_PLAYER_VISIONSET_LERP_STEP_COUNT

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUMED_PLAYER_VISIONSET_PRIORITY
macros.description: Priority the thrasher stomach vision set is applied at, deciding which vision set wins when several are active.

macros.name: THRASHER_CONSUMED_PLAYER_VISIONSET_RAMP_IN_DURATION
macros.description: Time in seconds over which the thrasher stomach vision set ramps in.

macros.name: THRASHER_EARLY_ROUND_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER
macros.description: Multiplier applied to level.zombie_health to give a thrasher its health during early rounds.

macros.name: THRASHER_EYE_FX
macros.description: Effect name for the thrasher eye glow in its normal state.

macros.name: THRASHER_EYE_FX_FILE
macros.description: Asset path of the normal thrasher eye glow effect, used when precaching it.

macros.name: THRASHER_EYE_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the thrasher eye glow effect is attached to.

macros.name: THRASHER_FOOTSTEP_EARTHQUAKE_MAX_RADIUS
macros.description: Maximum radius over which a thrasher's footstep earthquake is felt.

macros.name: THRASHER_FOOTSTEP_FX
macros.description: Effect name registered for the thrasher footstep impact effect.

macros.name: THRASHER_FOOTSTEP_FX_FILE
macros.description: Asset path of the thrasher footstep effect, used when precaching it.

macros.name: THRASHER_FREED_SAFETY
macros.description: Time in milliseconds that must pass before a new thrasher can consume a player just freed from another thrasher.

macros.name: THRASHER_HEAD_HEALTH

macros.name: THRASHER_HEAD_HITLOC
macros.description: Hit location name reported when the thrasher head takes damage.

macros.name: THRASHER_HEAD_TAG
macros.description: Model tag treated as the thrasher head for precision damage.

macros.name: THRASHER_LASTSTAND_SAFETY
macros.description: Time in milliseconds a player must have been in last stand before a thrasher can eat them.

macros.name: THRASHER_LATE_ROUND_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER
macros.description: Multiplier applied to level.zombie_health to give a thrasher its health during late rounds.
macros.remarks: Lower than THRASHER_EARLY_ROUND_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER because zombie health has already grown by then.

macros.name: THRASHER_MELEE_DIST
macros.description: Maximum distance at which a thrasher can melee its target.
macros.remarks: THRASHER_MELEE_DIST_SQ holds the squared form for distance comparisons without a square root.

macros.name: THRASHER_MELEE_DIST_SQ
macros.description: Square of the thrasher melee distance, for use with DistanceSquared.
macros.remarks: Expands to a multiplication of THRASHER_MELEE_DIST, so parenthesise it when embedding in a larger expression.

macros.name: THRASHER_MELEE_ENRAGED
macros.description: Name of the thrasher's enraged melee attack.

macros.name: THRASHER_MELEE_YAW
macros.description: Maximum yaw in degrees between a thrasher's facing and its target for a melee attack to be valid.

macros.name: THRASHER_MOUTH_CF
macros.description: Name of the client field that drives the first person thrasher stomach mouth seen by a consumed player.
macros.remarks: Part of the thrasher client field set declared in scripts/shared/ai/archetype_thrasher.gsh; the name, type and bit width macros must stay in sync with the clientfield::register call.

macros.name: THRASHER_MOUTH_CF_BITS
macros.description: Bit width used when registering the thrasher first person mouth client field.
macros.remarks: The stock comment notes this is 2 bits per player, so the 8 bits cover the four player slots.

macros.name: THRASHER_MOUTH_CF_CLOSE
macros.description: Thrasher first person mouth state that plays the mouth closing animation.

macros.name: THRASHER_MOUTH_CF_DELETE
macros.description: Thrasher first person mouth state that tears down the mouth effect.

macros.name: THRASHER_MOUTH_CF_IDLE
macros.description: Thrasher first person mouth state that plays the idle stomach animation.

macros.name: THRASHER_MOUTH_CF_OPEN
macros.description: Thrasher first person mouth state that plays the mouth opening animation.

macros.name: THRASHER_MOUTH_CF_TYPE
macros.description: Client field type used when registering the thrasher first person mouth field.
macros.remarks: Part of the thrasher client field set declared in scripts/shared/ai/archetype_thrasher.gsh; the name, type and bit width macros must stay in sync with the clientfield::register call.

macros.name: THRASHER_MOUTH_CLOSE_ANIM
macros.description: Fxanim asset played when the thrasher stomach mouth closes around the player.

macros.name: THRASHER_MOUTH_IDLE_ANIM
macros.description: Fxanim asset played for the idle state of the thrasher stomach mouth.

macros.name: THRASHER_MOUTH_OPEN_ANIM
macros.description: Fxanim asset played when the thrasher stomach mouth opens to release the player.

macros.name: THRASHER_NAVMESH_BOUNDARY_DIST
macros.description: Minimum distance a thrasher position must keep from the navmesh boundary.

macros.name: THRASHER_NAVMESH_RADIUS
macros.description: Navmesh query radius used when finding a valid position for a thrasher.

macros.name: THRASHER_PUSTULE_HEALTH
macros.description: Starting health of a single thrasher pustule.
macros.remarks: The header notes this is not used in Zombies, where pustule health is derived from level.zombie_health via THRASHER_PUSTULE_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER.

macros.name: THRASHER_PUSTULE_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER
macros.description: Multiplier applied to level.zombie_health to give a thrasher pustule its health.

macros.name: THRASHER_RAGE_AUTO
macros.description: Rage a thrasher gains passively each second.
macros.remarks: Combined with THRASHER_RAGE_AUTO_MULTIPLIER, which scales additional passive rage by the current level.

macros.name: THRASHER_RAGE_AUTO_MULTIPLIER
macros.description: Multiplier for the extra passive rage a thrasher gains per second, scaled by its current level.

macros.name: THRASHER_RAGE_HEALTH_BONUS
macros.description: Extra health granted to a thrasher when it becomes enraged.

macros.name: THRASHER_RAGE_INC_HEADSHOT
macros.description: Rage added when a thrasher is hit in the head.

macros.name: THRASHER_RAGE_INC_INGEST_PLAYER
macros.description: Rage added when a thrasher consumes a player.

macros.name: THRASHER_RAGE_INC_INGEST_ZOMBIE
macros.description: Rage added when a thrasher consumes a zombie.

macros.name: THRASHER_RAGE_INC_NONVITAL
macros.description: Rage added when a thrasher is hit in a non-vital location.
macros.remarks: One of the rage gain amounts alongside THRASHER_RAGE_INC_HEADSHOT and THRASHER_RAGE_INC_PUSTULE.

macros.name: THRASHER_RAGE_INC_PUSTULE
macros.description: Rage added when a thrasher is hit in a pustule.

macros.name: THRASHER_RAGE_INVULNERABLE_TIME
macros.description: Time in seconds a thrasher stays invulnerable after becoming enraged.
macros.remarks: Unlike most thrasher timing values, this one is in seconds rather than milliseconds.

macros.name: THRASHER_RAGE_THRESHOLD
macros.description: Amount of rage a thrasher must reach before entering berserk mode.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPIKE_COUNT
macros.description: Number of spikes on the thrasher model that script iterates over.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_BACK
macros.description: Model tag of the thrasher's back pustule.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CF
macros.description: Name of the actor clientfield holding the bitmask of destroyed thrasher pustules.
macros.example: destroyedSpores = entity clientfield::get( THRASHER_SPORE_CF ); entity clientfield::set( THRASHER_SPORE_CF, destroyedSpores );
macros.remarks: Three bits wide, one per pustule in THRASHER_SPORES. Stock code notes it must stay registered at VERSION_TU5.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CF_BITS
macros.description: Bit width of the thrasher pustule state clientfield, one bit per pustule.
macros.remarks: Matches the three entries of THRASHER_SPORES.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CF_SPORE1
macros.description: Bit value in the thrasher spore state client field that represents the first spore sac.
macros.remarks: One of three bits packed into the 3 bit THRASHER_SPORE_CF field, alongside THRASHER_SPORE_CF_SPORE2 and THRASHER_SPORE_CF_SPORE3.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CF_SPORE2
macros.description: Bit value in the thrasher spore state client field that represents the second spore sac.
macros.remarks: One of three bits packed into the 3 bit THRASHER_SPORE_CF field.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CF_SPORE3
macros.description: Bit value in the thrasher spore state client field that represents the third spore sac.
macros.remarks: One of three bits packed into the 3 bit THRASHER_SPORE_CF field.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CF_SPORES
macros.description: The three thrasher spore bit values collected into an array, for iterating every spore sac in order.
macros.remarks: Expands to a call to array(), so it allocates a new array at each use rather than being a compile time constant. It is index aligned with THRASHER_SPORES.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CF_TYPE
macros.description: Clientfield type of the thrasher pustule state field, a plain integer.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CHEST
macros.description: Model tag of the thrasher's chest pustule.
macros.remarks: Listed with THRASHER_SPORE_BACK and THRASHER_SPORE_LEG in the THRASHER_SPORES array.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_CONVERT_CHANCE

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_EVALUATE
macros.description: Interval in seconds between tests of the zombies inside a spore cloud for conversion.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_LRG_FX
macros.description: Registered effect name for the large ambient spore cloud.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_LRG_FX_FILE
macros.description: Path of the effect file for the large ambient spore cloud.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_MAX_CONVERT

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_ROUND_MAX_CONVERT
macros.description: Maximum number of zombies that can be converted into thrashers in a single round.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_SM_FX
macros.description: Registered effect name for the small ambient spore cloud.
macros.remarks: One of three cloud sizes, with THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_MD_FX and THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_LRG_FX.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_SM_FX_FILE
macros.description: Path of the effect file for the small ambient spore cloud.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_CLOUD_TIME

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_DAMAGE_DISTS
macros.description: Array of damage radii for each thrasher pustule, matching the order of THRASHER_SPORES.
macros.remarks: Expands to an array() call, so each use builds a new array.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_DESTROY_FX1

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_DESTROY_FX1_FILE
macros.description: Path of the effect file for the thrasher pustule burst.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_DESTROY_FX2

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_DESTROY_FX2_FILE
macros.description: Path of the effect file for the thrasher pustule spore explosion.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_IMPACT_CF

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_IMPACT_CF_BITS
macros.description: Bit width of the thrasher pustule impact clientfield.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_IMPACT_CF_TYPE
macros.description: Clientfield type of the thrasher pustule impact field, a counter.
macros.remarks: A counter clientfield fires its callback on every increment, so repeated impacts each reach the client.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_IMPACT_FX
macros.description: Registered effect name for the impact played when a thrasher pustule is hit.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_IMPACT_FX_FILE
macros.description: Path of the effect file for the thrasher pustule impact.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_INFLATE_FX
macros.description: Registered effect name for the pustule reinflate effect played as a thrasher spore regrows.
macros.remarks: Plays for THRASHER_SPORE_INFLATE_TIME milliseconds.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_INFLATE_FX_FILE
macros.description: Path of the effect file for the thrasher pustule reinflate effect.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_INFLATE_TIME
macros.description: Duration in milliseconds of a thrasher's spore inflate effect.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_LEG
macros.description: Model tag of the thrasher's leg pustule.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_STATE_DESTROYED
macros.description: State name recorded on a thrasher pustule once it has been destroyed.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORE_STATE_HEALTHY
macros.description: State name recorded on an intact thrasher pustule.
macros.remarks: The stock expansion contains the typo "state_healthly", so comparisons must use the macro rather than a literal.

macros.name: THRASHER_SPORES
macros.description: Array of the thrasher's pustule tags, in chest, back, leg order.
macros.remarks: Expands to an array() call, so each use builds a new array. Indices line up with THRASHER_SPORE_DAMAGE_DISTS and THRASHER_SPORE_CF_SPORES.

macros.name: THRASHER_STUN_HEALTH
macros.description: Amount of normal damage a thrasher must take before it is stunned.

macros.name: THRASHER_STUN_TIME
macros.description: Duration in milliseconds of a thrasher stun.

macros.name: THRASHER_TELEPORT_COOLDOWN
macros.description: Time in milliseconds a thrasher must wait between teleports used to close distance.

macros.name: THRASHER_TELEPORT_DESTINATION_MAX_RADIUS
macros.description: Maximum radius searched around a candidate point when looking for a thrasher teleport destination.

macros.name: THRASHER_TELEPORT_DESTINATION_SAFE_RADIUS
macros.description: Radius around a candidate thrasher teleport destination that must be clear before the destination is accepted.

macros.name: THRASHER_TELEPORT_MIN_DISTANCE
macros.description: Distance from its enemy at which a thrasher will consider teleporting to close the gap.

macros.name: THRASHER_TELEPORT_OVERLAP
macros.description: Minimum distance a thrasher's teleport destination must keep from another thrasher's position.
macros.example: if ( DistanceSquared( origin, other.origin ) > THRASHER_TELEPORT_OVERLAP * THRASHER_TELEPORT_OVERLAP )

macros.name: THRASHER_TELERPOT_MIN_DISTANCE_SQ
macros.description: The squared minimum teleport distance for the thrasher, for comparing against squared distances without a square root.
macros.remarks: The stock name misspells TELEPORT as TELERPOT; the spelling must be used as written. The expansion is an unparenthesised product of THRASHER_TELEPORT_MIN_DISTANCE (1200), so wrap it in parentheses if it is used inside a larger expression.

macros.name: THRASHER_TOTAL_HEALTH
macros.description: Starting health of a thrasher.
macros.remarks: The header notes this is not used in Zombies, where health comes from level.zombie_health scaled by THRASHER_EARLY_ROUND_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER or THRASHER_LATE_ROUND_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER.

macros.name: THREAD_IF_DEFINED
macros.description: Threads a function pointer on self if it is defined, and does nothing otherwise.

parameters.name: __func
parameters.description: The function pointer to thread.

macros.remarks: Expands to a statement, not an expression, and requires a valid self. See DO_IF_DEFINED for the non-threaded form.

macros.name: THROW_DISTANCE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the distance the AI is throwing a grenade or other thrown item.

macros.name: THUMBSTICK_DEFAULT
macros.description: Analog stick layout stat value, matching the controller thumbstick layout the player has chosen. This is the default layout.
macros.remarks: One of the four thumbstick layout values stored in the player's stats.

macros.name: THUMBSTICK_LEGACY
macros.description: Analog stick layout stat value, matching the controller thumbstick layout the player has chosen. This is the legacy layout.
macros.remarks: One of the four thumbstick layout values stored in the player's stats.

macros.name: THUMBSTICK_LEGACYSOUTHPAW
macros.description: Analog stick layout stat value, matching the controller thumbstick layout the player has chosen. This is the legacy southpaw layout.
macros.remarks: One of the four thumbstick layout values stored in the player's stats.

macros.name: THUMBSTICK_SOUTHPAW
macros.description: Analog stick layout stat value, matching the controller thumbstick layout the player has chosen. This is the southpaw layout, which swaps the two sticks.
macros.remarks: One of the four thumbstick layout values stored in the player's stats.

macros.name: TIMEOUT
macros.description: Arms an optional timeout on the current thread, so the thread ends once the given number of seconds has passed. Nothing happens when the argument is undefined.

parameters.name: __t
parameters.description: The timeout in seconds, or undefined for no timeout.

macros.remarks: Spawns a struct and threads util::delay_notify on it, and declares the local __s, so that name must be free. The endon it installs applies to the whole enclosing thread.

macros.name: TRACKING_TURN_YAW
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the yaw the AI must turn through while tracking its target.

macros.name: TRAVERSAL_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the type of traversal the AI is performing, such as a vault or a climb.

macros.name: TROPHY_SYSTEM_INIT
macros.description: Trophy system state value for a freshly placed trophy system that has not started up yet.
macros.remarks: The first of the trophy system state values, followed by TROPHY_SYSTEM_ROLLING, TROPHY_SYSTEM_STATIONARY and TROPHY_SYSTEM_STUNNED. The header notes these were moved out of clientflags.gsh and are plain constants, not client flags.

macros.name: TROPHY_SYSTEM_ROLLING
macros.description: Trophy system state value, stored on the deployed trophy system entity. This state means the device is still rolling after being thrown.
macros.remarks: Part of the trophy system state set with TROPHY_SYSTEM_INIT, TROPHY_SYSTEM_STATIONARY and TROPHY_SYSTEM_STUNNED.

macros.name: TROPHY_SYSTEM_STATIONARY
macros.description: Trophy system state value, stored on the deployed trophy system entity. This state means the device has come to rest and is active.
macros.remarks: Part of the trophy system state set with TROPHY_SYSTEM_INIT, TROPHY_SYSTEM_ROLLING and TROPHY_SYSTEM_STUNNED.

macros.name: TROPHY_SYSTEM_STUNNED
macros.description: Trophy system state value, stored on the deployed trophy system entity. This state means the device has been disabled, such as by an EMP.
macros.remarks: Part of the trophy system state set with TROPHY_SYSTEM_INIT, TROPHY_SYSTEM_ROLLING and TROPHY_SYSTEM_STATIONARY.

macros.name: TURRET_DURATION
macros.description: Lifetime of a placed sentry turret in milliseconds.

macros.name: TURRET_EMP_DAMAGE_PERCENTAGE
macros.description: Fraction of the sentry turret's health removed by EMP damage.

macros.name: TURRET_HEADICON_OFFSET
macros.description: Offset from the sentry turret's origin at which its head icon is drawn.
macros.remarks: Expands to a vector literal.

macros.name: TURRET_HEALTH
macros.description: Health a placed sentry turret starts with.

macros.name: TURRET_HIDE_COMPASS_ON_REMOTE_CONTROL
macros.description: Whether the compass (minimap) is hidden while the player remote controls the turret.
macros.remarks: One of a group of HIDE_COMPASS_ON_REMOTE_CONTROL switches, one per remote controlled killstreak.

macros.name: TURRET_INVALID_PLACEMENT_MODEL
macros.description: Preview model shown while the sentry turret is being placed at an invalid location.

macros.name: TURRET_INVALID_PLACEMENT_TEXT
macros.description: Localised hint string shown while the sentry turret placement is invalid.
macros.remarks: Expands to a localised string reference.

macros.name: TURRET_MAX_TARGET_DISTANCE
macros.description: Maximum distance in units at which a sentry turret will acquire a target.

macros.name: TURRET_MODEL
macros.description: Model used by a placed sentry turret.

macros.name: TURRET_PICKUP_TEXT
macros.description: Localised hint string shown for picking a placed sentry turret back up.
macros.remarks: Expands to a localised string reference.

macros.name: TURRET_REMOTE_TEXT
macros.description: Localised hint string shown for taking remote control of a sentry turret.
macros.remarks: Expands to a localised string reference, so it can only be used where the engine expects one.

macros.name: TURRET_TARGET_AI
macros.description: Turret targeting bit flag, combined into the set of entity types a turret is allowed to acquire. This bit allows AI actors to be targeted.
macros.remarks: Bit flag; combine with TURRET_TARGET_PLAYERS, TURRET_TARGET_DRONES and TURRET_TARGET_VEHICLES using bitwise or.

macros.name: TURRET_TARGET_ANGLE
macros.description: Half angle in degrees of the sentry turret's targeting cone.

macros.name: TURRET_TARGET_DRONES
macros.description: Turret targeting bit flag, combined into the set of entity types a turret is allowed to acquire. This bit allows drones to be targeted.
macros.remarks: Bit flag; combine with TURRET_TARGET_AI, TURRET_TARGET_PLAYERS and TURRET_TARGET_VEHICLES using bitwise or.

macros.name: TURRET_TARGET_PLAYERS
macros.description: Turret targeting bit flag, combined into the set of entity types a turret is allowed to acquire. This bit allows players to be targeted.
macros.remarks: Bit flag; combine with TURRET_TARGET_AI, TURRET_TARGET_DRONES and TURRET_TARGET_VEHICLES using bitwise or.

macros.name: TURRET_TARGET_VEHICLES
macros.description: Turret targeting bit flag, combined into the set of entity types a turret is allowed to acquire. This bit allows vehicles to be targeted.
macros.remarks: Bit flag; combine with TURRET_TARGET_AI, TURRET_TARGET_PLAYERS and TURRET_TARGET_DRONES using bitwise or.

macros.name: TURRET_VALID_PLACEMENT_MODEL
macros.description: Preview model shown while the sentry turret is being placed at a valid location.

macros.name: TURRET_VALID_PLACEMENT_TEXT
macros.description: Localised hint string shown while the sentry turret placement is valid.
macros.remarks: Expands to a localised string reference.

macros.name: TURRET_VEHICLE_NAME
macros.description: Vehicle archetype name spawned for the sentry turret killstreak.

macros.name: TURRET_VISIONSET_ALIAS
macros.description: Visionset alias applied while the player controls a turret.

macros.name: TURRET_VISIONSET_FILE
macros.description: Name of the visionset file loaded for the turret killstreak.

macros.name: TURRET_VISIONSET_LERP_STEP_COUNT
macros.description: Number of steps used to blend the turret visionset in and out.

macros.name: TURRET_WATCH_DEATH_DURATION
macros.description: Time in seconds the sentry turret's remote weapon death is watched for after it is destroyed.

macros.name: UAV_DURATION
macros.description: Lifetime of the UAV killstreak in milliseconds before it flies off.

macros.name: UAV_DURATION_CHECK
macros.description: Half of the UAV killstreak lifetime, used as the midpoint check for its flight logic.

macros.name: UAV_EXIT_TIME
macros.description: Time in seconds the UAV killstreak takes to fly out of the map once its duration ends.

macros.name: UAV_HEALTH
macros.description: Starting and maximum health of the UAV killstreak drone.

macros.name: UAV_LOW_HEALTH
macros.description: Health threshold at which the UAV killstreak drone is treated as damaged, half of its full health.
macros.example: uav thread killstreaks::MonitorDamage( UAV_NAME, UAV_HEALTH, &DestroyUAV, UAV_LOW_HEALTH, &OnLowHealth );

macros.name: UAV_MODEL
macros.description: Model used by the UAV killstreak drone.

macros.name: UAV_ROTATION_RADIUS
macros.description: Radius in world units of the circle the UAV killstreak flies around the map.

macros.name: UAV_ROTATION_RANDOM_OFFSET
macros.description: Maximum random variation applied to the UAV killstreak's orbit radius so successive UAVs do not fly identical paths.

macros.name: UAV_Z_OFFSET
macros.description: Height above the map's minimum fly height at which the UAV killstreak circles.

macros.name: UNBUILD
macros.description: Buildable persistence mode that lets a built buildable be taken apart again.
macros.remarks: Part of the buildable persistence group with CUSTOM_BUILD_THINK, ONE_USE_AND_FLY, PERSISTENT and ONE_TIME_BUILD.

macros.name: UNCRAFT
macros.description: Craftable persistence mode where the crafted item can be taken apart and the pieces returned.
macros.remarks: One of the craftable persistence modes alongside ONE_USE_AND_FLY, PERSISTENT and ONE_TIME_CRAFT.

macros.name: UPGRADED_VORTEX_EXPLOSION_FX
macros.description: Effect path for the explosion played when an upgraded Apothicon Servant vortex collapses.
macros.remarks: Upgraded counterpart of VORTEX_EXPLOSION_FX.

macros.name: UPGRADED_VORTEX_FX
macros.description: Effect path for the upgraded Apothicon Servant vortex itself.
macros.remarks: Upgraded counterpart of VORTEX_FX.

macros.name: UPGRADED_VORTEX_TIME_CLIENT
macros.description: Lifetime in seconds of an upgraded Apothicon Servant vortex effect on the client.
macros.remarks: Upgraded counterpart of VORTEX_TIME_CLIENT, and longer than UPGRADED_VORTEX_TIME_SERVER for the same reason.

macros.name: UPGRADED_VORTEX_TIME_SERVER
macros.description: Lifetime in seconds of an upgraded Apothicon Servant vortex on the server.
macros.remarks: Upgraded counterpart of VORTEX_TIME_SERVER.

macros.name: VAL
macros.description: Returns a value when it is defined and a fallback otherwise. It is the expression form of DEFAULT.

parameters.name: __var
parameters.description: The value to use when it is defined.

parameters.name: __default
parameters.description: The fallback used when the first value is undefined.

macros.remarks: The first argument is evaluated twice, so avoid passing an expression with side effects.

macros.name: VARIANT_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute key for the animation variant set the AI should select from.

macros.name: VEC_SET_X
macros.description: Replaces the x component of a vector variable, leaving the other two components as they were.

parameters.name: _v
parameters.description: The vector variable to modify; it is assigned in place.

parameters.name: _x
parameters.description: The new x component.

macros.remarks: Vectors are immutable in script, so this rebuilds and reassigns the whole vector; the first argument must be an assignable variable.

macros.name: VEC_SET_Y
macros.description: Replaces the y component of a vector variable, leaving the other two components as they were.

parameters.name: _v
parameters.description: The vector variable to modify; it is assigned in place.

parameters.name: _y
parameters.description: The new y component.

macros.remarks: Vectors are immutable in script, so this rebuilds and reassigns the whole vector; the first argument must be an assignable variable.

macros.name: VEC_SET_Z
macros.description: Replaces the z component of a vector variable, leaving the other two components as they were.

parameters.name: _v
parameters.description: The vector variable to modify; it is assigned in place.

parameters.name: _z
parameters.description: The new z component.

macros.remarks: Vectors are immutable in script, so this rebuilds and reassigns the whole vector; the first argument must be an assignable variable.

macros.name: VEHICLE_DELETE
macros.description: Kills and removes a vehicle entity, marking it to delete on death, notifying "death" so its threads shut down, and deleting it outright if it is not alive.

parameters.name: __e
parameters.description: The vehicle entity to remove.

macros.remarks: Expands to several statements with side effects, so do not use it where a single expression is expected.

macros.name: VERSION_DLC1
macros.description: Clientfield version for fields added by DLC1 content. It is an alias for the title update version that the DLC shipped with, VERSION_TU5.
macros.remarks: Clientfield versions are compared against the version the client connected with, so a field registered at a later version is ignored by older clients. If a version number here changes, clientfieldmodels.lua must be updated to match.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_EDGE_WIDTH
macros.description: Script vector constant index holding the vision pulse edge width.
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector0.z.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_HIGHLIGHT_ENEMIES
macros.description: Script vector constant index toggling enemy highlighting during a vision pulse (0 for no, 1 for yes).
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector1.x.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_IRIS_FADE
macros.description: Script vector constant index controlling the iris appearance and character glow fade of the vision pulse.
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector0.w.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_MAX_RADIUS
macros.description: Script vector constant index holding the maximum distance the vision pulse reaches.
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector2.w, the max distance to pulse.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_PULSE_WIDTH
macros.description: Script vector constant index holding the vision pulse width, as a percentage of the value in the material.
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector0.y.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_RADIUS
macros.description: Script vector constant index holding the vision pulse position in the world (1.0 near, 0.0 far).
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector0.x. Part of the VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_* index set documented by the comment block in the header.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_VIEWMODEL_EDGE_WIDTH
macros.description: Script vector constant index holding the view model pulse edge width for the vision pulse gadget.
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector1.z.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_VIEWMODEL_IS_PULSED
macros.description: Script vector constant index flagging whether the view model is currently being pulsed.
macros.remarks: The header comment block lists scriptVector1.w as the view model pulse max radius, so the exact slot for this index is not stated.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_VIEWMODEL_ORIGIN_X
macros.description: Script vector constant index holding the X component of the view model pulse origin.
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector2.x, paired with VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_VIEWMODEL_ORIGIN_Y.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_VIEWMODEL_ORIGIN_Y
macros.description: Script vector constant index holding the Y component of the view model pulse origin.
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector2.y, paired with VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_VIEWMODEL_ORIGIN_X.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_VIEWMODEL_PULSE_POSITION
macros.description: Script vector constant index holding the view model pulse position.
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector2.z.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_CONSTID_VIEWMODEL_PULSE_WIDTH
macros.description: Script vector constant index holding the view model pulse width for the vision pulse gadget.
macros.remarks: Maps to scriptVector1.y.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_DURATION
macros.description: Duration in milliseconds of the vision pulse sweep itself.
macros.remarks: The header notes that ramp in plus hold plus ramp out equals VISION_PULSE_DURATION plus VISION_PULSE_REVEAL_TIME.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_ENT_SCRIPT_VECTOR
macros.description: Name of the entity script vector the vision pulse gadget writes its per-entity reveal data into.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_FADE_RAMP_IN
macros.description: Normalized point in the vision pulse fade curve, between 0 at the start and 1 at the end, by which the fade has fully ramped in.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_FADE_RAMP_OUT
macros.description: Normalized point in the vision pulse fade curve, measured from VISION_PULSE_FADE_RAMP_IN to 1, by which the fade has fully ramped out.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_RAMP_OUT_TIME
macros.description: Time in milliseconds over which the vision pulse reveal fades out.
macros.remarks: Must stay smaller than VISION_PULSE_REVEAL_TIME.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_REVEAL_TIME
macros.description: Time in milliseconds that targets stay revealed after the vision pulse passes over them.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_VISIONSET
macros.description: Name of the black and white visionset file applied while the vision pulse gadget is active.
macros.remarks: The stock asset name is spelled 'vision_puls_bw'.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_VISIONSET_ALIAS
macros.description: Script alias used to refer to the vision pulse visionset.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_VISIONSET_PRIORITY
macros.description: Priority of the vision pulse visionset relative to other visionsets.
macros.remarks: Sits between the speed burst visionset (60) and the resurrect visionsets (62 and 63).

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_VISIONSET_RAMP_HOLD
macros.description: Time in seconds the vision pulse visionset holds at full strength before ramping out.
macros.remarks: Derived from VISION_PULSE_REVEAL_TIME, converted from milliseconds and given one extra second.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_VISIONSET_RAMP_IN
macros.description: Time in seconds for the vision pulse visionset to ramp in on activation.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_VISIONSET_RAMP_OUT
macros.description: Time in seconds for the vision pulse visionset to ramp out on deactivation.

macros.name: VISION_PULSE_VISIONSET_STEPS
macros.description: Number of interpolation steps used when the vision pulse visionset ramps in and out.

macros.name: VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_1
macros.description: Vortex clientfield value selecting the first vortex effect version, used by the non upgraded weapon.
macros.remarks: One of the values written to VORTEX_START_CLIENTFIELD, alongside VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_NONE and VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_2.

macros.name: VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_2
macros.description: Vortex clientfield value selecting the second vortex effect version, used by the upgraded weapon.
macros.remarks: One of the values written to VORTEX_START_CLIENTFIELD, alongside VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_NONE and VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_1.

macros.name: VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_NONE
macros.description: Vortex clientfield value meaning no vortex effect is playing.
macros.remarks: One of the values written to VORTEX_START_CLIENTFIELD, alongside VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_1 and VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_2.

macros.name: VORTEX_ENTER_DURATION
macros.description: Time in seconds the vortex screen effect takes to ramp in.
macros.example: e_player visionset_mgr::activate( "visionset", str_name, self, 1, VORTEX_ENTER_DURATION, VORTEX_LOOP_DURATION, VORTEX_EXIT_DURATION );
macros.remarks: Part of the ramp in, hold, ramp out triple with VORTEX_LOOP_DURATION and VORTEX_EXIT_DURATION.

macros.name: VORTEX_EXIT_DURATION
macros.description: Time in seconds the vortex screen effect takes to ramp out.
macros.example: e_player visionset_mgr::activate( "visionset", str_name, self, 1, VORTEX_ENTER_DURATION, VORTEX_LOOP_DURATION, VORTEX_EXIT_DURATION );
macros.remarks: Part of the ramp in, hold, ramp out triple with VORTEX_ENTER_DURATION and VORTEX_LOOP_DURATION.

macros.name: VORTEX_EXPLOSION_FX
macros.description: Effect path for the explosion played when an Apothicon Servant vortex collapses.
macros.remarks: UPGRADED_VORTEX_EXPLOSION_FX is the upgraded weapon's version.

macros.name: VORTEX_FX
macros.description: Effect path for the Apothicon Servant vortex itself.
macros.remarks: UPGRADED_VORTEX_FX is the upgraded weapon's version.

macros.name: VORTEX_LOOP_DURATION
macros.description: Time in seconds the vortex screen effect holds at full strength before ramping out.
macros.example: e_player visionset_mgr::activate( "visionset", str_name, self, 1, VORTEX_ENTER_DURATION, VORTEX_LOOP_DURATION, VORTEX_EXIT_DURATION );
macros.remarks: Part of the ramp in, hold, ramp out triple with VORTEX_ENTER_DURATION and VORTEX_EXIT_DURATION.

macros.name: VORTEX_OVERLAY_BLUR_AMOUNT
macros.description: Strength of the screen blur applied by the vortex overlay.
macros.remarks: Used with VORTEX_OVERLAY_INNER_RADIUS and VORTEX_OVERLAY_OUTER_RADIUS, which shape where the blur applies on screen.

macros.name: VORTEX_OVERLAY_INNER_RADIUS
macros.description: Inner screen radius of the vortex blur overlay, inside which the blur does not apply.
macros.remarks: Used with VORTEX_OVERLAY_OUTER_RADIUS to define the band the blur ramps across.

macros.name: VORTEX_OVERLAY_LERP_COUNT
macros.description: Number of simultaneous lerps the vortex screen blur overlay registers with the visionset manager.
macros.example: visionset_mgr::register_info( "overlay", VORTEX_SCREEN_EFFECT_NAME + "_blur", VERSION_SHIP, level.vsmgr_prio_overlay_zombie_vortex, VORTEX_OVERLAY_LERP_COUNT, true, &visionset_mgr::ramp_in_out_thread_per_player, true );

macros.name: VORTEX_OVERLAY_OUTER_RADIUS
macros.description: Outer screen radius of the vortex blur overlay, beyond which the blur is at full strength.
macros.remarks: Used with VORTEX_OVERLAY_INNER_RADIUS to define the band the blur ramps across.

macros.name: VORTEX_OVERLAY_PRIORITY
macros.description: Priority of the vortex screen blur overlay in the visionset manager.
macros.remarks: Matches VORTEX_VISIONSET_PRIORITY so the blur and the visionset sit at the same level in their respective stacks.

macros.name: VORTEX_RUMBLE_INTERIOR
macros.description: Rumble name played for a player standing inside an Apothicon Servant vortex.
macros.remarks: Paired with VORTEX_RUMBLE_SHOCKWAVE, played for the outward blast instead.

macros.name: VORTEX_RUMBLE_SHOCKWAVE
macros.description: Rumble name played for the shockwave of an Apothicon Servant vortex.
macros.remarks: Paired with VORTEX_RUMBLE_INTERIOR, played for players inside the vortex instead.

macros.name: VORTEX_SCREEN_EFFECT_NAME
macros.description: Base name used to register and look up the vortex visionset and screen blur overlay.
macros.example: visionset_mgr::register_info( "visionset", VORTEX_SCREEN_EFFECT_NAME + "_visionset", VERSION_SHIP, level.vsmgr_prio_visionset_zombie_vortex, VORTEX_VISIONSET_LERP_COUNT, true, &visionset_mgr::ramp_in_out_thread_per_player, false );
macros.remarks: Suffixed with "_visionset" and "_blur" to form the two registered effect names.

macros.name: VORTEX_START_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the clientfield that tells the client a vortex has started and which effect version to play.
macros.remarks: The value written is one of VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_NONE, VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_1 or VORTEX_EFFECT_VERSION_2.

macros.name: VORTEX_TIME_CLIENT
macros.description: Lifetime in seconds of an Apothicon Servant vortex effect on the client.
macros.remarks: Longer than VORTEX_TIME_SERVER so the effect keeps playing after the server side vortex has ended.

macros.name: VORTEX_TIME_SERVER
macros.description: Lifetime in seconds of an Apothicon Servant vortex on the server.
macros.remarks: Deliberately shorter than VORTEX_TIME_CLIENT so the vortex effect outlives the vortex functionality.

macros.name: VORTEX_VISIONSET_LERP_COUNT
macros.description: Number of simultaneous lerps the vortex visionset registers with the visionset manager.
macros.example: visionset_mgr::register_info( "visionset", VORTEX_SCREEN_EFFECT_NAME + "_visionset", VERSION_SHIP, level.vsmgr_prio_visionset_zombie_vortex, VORTEX_VISIONSET_LERP_COUNT, true, &visionset_mgr::ramp_in_out_thread_per_player, false );

macros.name: VORTEX_VISIONSET_PRIORITY
macros.description: Priority of the vortex visionset in the visionset manager, deliberately below the Beast mode and parasite round overlays.
macros.remarks: Higher priority visionsets take over the screen, so the vortex look loses to Beast mode and the parasite or elemental round overlays.

macros.name: VOX_TABLE_COL_CATEGORY
macros.description: Column index in the zombie vox CSV holding the line's category.
macros.remarks: One of the VOX_TABLE_COL_* column indices; they must match the column order of the vox table.

macros.name: VOX_TABLE_COL_DELAYBEFOREPLAY
macros.description: Column index in the zombie vox CSV holding the delay before the line plays.
macros.remarks: One of the VOX_TABLE_COL_* column indices; they must match the column order of the vox table.

macros.name: VOX_TABLE_COL_PERCENTAGE
macros.description: Column index in the zombie vox CSV holding the chance the line plays.
macros.remarks: One of the VOX_TABLE_COL_* column indices; they must match the column order of the vox table.

macros.name: VOX_TABLE_COL_RESPONSE
macros.description: Column index in the zombie vox CSV holding whether the line supports a response.
macros.remarks: One of the VOX_TABLE_COL_* column indices; they must match the column order of the vox table.

macros.name: VOX_TABLE_COL_SUBCATEGORY
macros.description: Column index in the zombie vox CSV holding the line's subcategory.
macros.remarks: One of the VOX_TABLE_COL_* column indices; they must match the column order of the vox table.

macros.name: VOX_TABLE_COL_SUFFIX
macros.description: Column index in the zombie vox CSV holding the alias suffix.
macros.remarks: One of the VOX_TABLE_COL_* column indices; they must match the column order of the vox table.

macros.name: WAIT_ABOUT
macros.description: Waits roughly the given number of seconds, varying the actual wait by up to a third either way. It smooths out periodic loops that do not need a fixed interval.

parameters.name: __time
parameters.description: The approximate time to wait, in seconds.

macros.remarks: Expands to a wait statement, so it can only be used inside a thread that is allowed to wait. Built on RANDOM_TIME_IN_RANGE.

macros.name: WAIT_CLIENT_FRAME
macros.description: Waits for the length of a single client frame.
macros.remarks: Expands to a braced statement, so no trailing semicolon is needed and it may only be used in a threaded context. See CLIENT_FRAME for the raw duration.

macros.name: WAIT_SERVER_FRAME
macros.description: Waits for the length of a single server frame.
macros.remarks: Expands to a braced statement, so no trailing semicolon is needed and it may only be used in a threaded context. See SERVER_FRAME for the raw duration.

macros.name: WAITTILL_LOAD
macros.description: Blocks until the level has finished its main load, returning at once if the load has already completed.
macros.remarks: Reads level.flag directly rather than going through the flag system, so it is safe to use before the flag system exists. May only be used in a threaded context.

macros.name: WARLORD_ANGRY_ACCUMILATED_DAMAGE_MAX_DUR
macros.description: Window in milliseconds over which damage is accumulated towards the warlord's angry reaction.
macros.remarks: The stock spelling of the name is a typo for accumulated.

macros.name: WARLORD_ANGRY_MAX_ACCUMILATED_DAMAGE
macros.description: Damage the warlord must take within the angry window to trigger its angry attack.
macros.remarks: The stock spelling of the name is a typo for accumulated.

macros.name: WARLORD_BODY_LIGHT_FX
macros.description: Short effect name for the warlord's body light glow, used to look the effect up once it has been registered.
macros.example: self PlayFXOnTag( level._effect[ WARLORD_BODY_LIGHT_FX ], self, WARLORD_BODY_LIGHT_TAG );
macros.remarks: WARLORD_BODY_LIGHT_FX_FILE holds the full path to the same effect.

macros.name: WARLORD_BODY_LIGHT_FX_FILE
macros.description: Full effect file path for the warlord's body light glow, as used when precaching or registering the effect.
macros.remarks: WARLORD_BODY_LIGHT_FX is the short registration name for the same effect, and WARLORD_BODY_LIGHT_TAG is the tag it plays on.

macros.name: WARLORD_BODY_LIGHT_TAG
macros.description: Model joint the warlord's body light effect is attached to.
macros.example: self PlayFXOnTag( level._effect[ WARLORD_BODY_LIGHT_FX ], self, WARLORD_BODY_LIGHT_TAG );

macros.name: WARLORD_CHARGE_DISTANCE
macros.description: Maximum distance from a player at which the warlord will attempt a charge melee.
macros.remarks: Warlord tuning value from scripts/shared/ai/warlord.gsh.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_ACTORS_REDUCTION_MULTIPLIER
macros.description: Multiplier applied to damage the warlord takes from other AI actors.
macros.remarks: Warlord tuning value from scripts/shared/ai/warlord.gsh.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_EXPLOSIVE_REDUCTION_MULTIPLIER
macros.description: Multiplier applied to explosive damage the warlord takes.
macros.remarks: Warlord tuning value from scripts/shared/ai/warlord.gsh.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_HEAVY_STATE_FX
macros.description: FX name of the warlord's heavy upper body damage effect.
macros.remarks: Paired with WARLORD_DAMAGE_HEAVY_STATE_FX_FILE.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_HEAVY_STATE_FX_FILE
macros.description: Asset path of the warlord's heavy upper body damage effect.
macros.remarks: Registered under the name WARLORD_DAMAGE_HEAVY_STATE_FX.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_HEAVY_STATE_LOWER_FX
macros.description: FX name of the warlord's heavy lower body damage effect.
macros.remarks: Paired with WARLORD_DAMAGE_HEAVY_STATE_LOWER_FX_FILE.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_HEAVY_STATE_LOWER_FX_FILE
macros.description: Asset path of the warlord's heavy lower body damage effect.
macros.remarks: Registered under the name WARLORD_DAMAGE_HEAVY_STATE_LOWER_FX.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the clientfield carrying the warlord's damage state.
macros.remarks: Carries one of WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_UNDAMAGED, WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_DAMAGE, WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_HEAVY_DAMAGE, or WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_DEAD.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_DAMAGE
macros.description: Warlord damage state meaning the warlord has taken medium damage.
macros.remarks: Clientfield value used by the warlord archetype to drive client side visuals.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_DEAD
macros.description: Warlord damage state meaning the warlord is dead.
macros.remarks: Clientfield value used by the warlord archetype to drive client side visuals.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_FX
macros.description: FX name of the warlord's medium upper body damage effect.
macros.remarks: Paired with WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_FX_FILE, which gives the path used to register the effect.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_FX_FILE
macros.description: Asset path of the warlord's medium upper body damage effect.
macros.remarks: Registered under the name WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_FX.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_HEAVY_DAMAGE
macros.description: Warlord damage state meaning the warlord has taken heavy damage.
macros.remarks: Clientfield value used by the warlord archetype to drive client side visuals.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_LOWER_FX
macros.description: FX name of the warlord's medium lower body damage effect.
macros.remarks: Paired with WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_LOWER_FX_FILE.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_LOWER_FX_FILE
macros.description: Asset path of the warlord's medium lower body damage effect.
macros.remarks: Registered under the name WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_LOWER_FX.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_LOWER_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the warlord's lower damage FX is attached to.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_PERCENTAGE
macros.description: Health fraction at or below which the warlord plays its medium damage FX.
macros.remarks: Warlord tuning value from scripts/shared/ai/warlord.gsh.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the warlord's upper damage FX is attached to.

macros.name: WARLORD_DAMAGE_STATE_UNDAMAGED
macros.description: Warlord damage state meaning the warlord is undamaged.
macros.remarks: Clientfield value used by the warlord archetype to drive client side visuals.

macros.name: WARLORD_DEATH_FX
macros.description: FX name of the warlord's death explosion.
macros.remarks: Paired with WARLORD_DEATH_FX_FILE and played at WARLORD_DEATH_TAG.

macros.name: WARLORD_DEATH_FX_FILE
macros.description: Asset path of the warlord's death explosion effect.
macros.remarks: Registered under the name WARLORD_DEATH_FX.

macros.name: WARLORD_DEATH_TAG
macros.description: Model tag the warlord's death explosion is played on.

macros.name: WARLORD_DIAMETER
macros.description: Diameter of the warlord in world units.
macros.remarks: Warlord tuning value from scripts/shared/ai/warlord.gsh.

macros.name: WARLORD_EYE_FX

macros.name: ZM_ELEMENTAL_VISION_LERP_COUNT

macros.remarks: One of the ZM_MAP_EVENT_* match record event ids defined in scripts/zm/_zm_utility.gsh; the values are a contiguous enum shared with the engine's match recording.

macros.name: ZM_MAP_EVENT_ROUND_END
macros.description: Match record event id for the end of a round.
macros.example: self RecordMapEvent( ZM_MAP_EVENT_ROUND_END, GetTime(), self.origin, level.round_number );
macros.remarks: One of the ZM_MAP_EVENT_* match record event ids defined in scripts/zm/_zm_utility.gsh; the values are a contiguous enum shared with the engine's match recording.

macros.name: ZM_MAP_EVENT_ROUND_START
macros.description: Match record event id for the start of a round.
macros.example: self RecordMapEvent( ZM_MAP_EVENT_ROUND_START, GetTime(), self.origin, level.round_number );
macros.remarks: One of the ZM_MAP_EVENT_* match record event ids defined in scripts/zm/_zm_utility.gsh; the values are a contiguous enum shared with the engine's match recording.

macros.name: ZM_MELEE_DIST
macros.description: Maximum distance in inches at which an undead archetype can melee its enemy.

macros.name: ZM_MELEE_DIST_SQ
macros.description: Squared melee range for undead archetypes, for comparison against DistanceSquared.
macros.remarks: Squared form of ZM_MELEE_DIST.

macros.name: ZM_MELEE_YAW
macros.description: Maximum yaw difference in degrees between an undead archetype and its enemy for a melee attack to be allowed.
macros.remarks: Skeletons use a tighter 45 degree cone, ordinary zombies 60 degrees.

macros.name: ZM_MOVE_DIST_SQ
macros.description: Squared distance a zombie must cover within the movement check window to count as still moving.
macros.remarks: Used with ZM_MOVE_TIME. Stored squared so it can be compared against DistanceSquared.

macros.name: ZM_MOVE_TIME
macros.description: Time window in milliseconds over which a zombie's movement progress is checked.
macros.remarks: Used with ZM_MOVE_DIST_SQ to detect a zombie that has stopped making progress.

macros.name: ZM_PAIN_DIST_SQ_MAX
macros.description: Maximum squared distance from the attacker at which a zombie will play a pain reaction.
macros.remarks: Stored squared so it can be compared against DistanceSquared without a square root.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_BALL_ON_OFF_PIECE_INDEX
macros.description: Index of the ball on/off piece in the random perk machine's piece array.
macros.remarks: One of the ZM_PERK_RANDOM_*_PIECE_INDEX group, which numbers the machine's animated sub-models 0 through 5.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_BALL_SPIN_PIECE_INDEX
macros.description: Index of the ball spin piece in the random perk machine's piece array.
macros.remarks: One of the ZM_PERK_RANDOM_*_PIECE_INDEX group, which numbers the machine's animated sub-models 0 through 5.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_BODY_AVAILABLE_PIECE_INDEX
macros.description: Index of the body available piece in the random perk machine's piece array.
macros.remarks: One of the ZM_PERK_RANDOM_*_PIECE_INDEX group, which numbers the machine's animated sub-models 0 through 5.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_BODY_IDLE_PIECE_INDEX
macros.description: Index of the body idle piece in the random perk machine's piece array.
macros.remarks: One of the ZM_PERK_RANDOM_*_PIECE_INDEX group, which numbers the machine's animated sub-models 0 through 5.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_BODY_ON_OFF_PIECE_INDEX
macros.description: Index of the body on/off piece in the random perk machine's piece array.
macros.remarks: One of the ZM_PERK_RANDOM_*_PIECE_INDEX group, which numbers the machine's animated sub-models 0 through 5.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_BOTTLE_TAG_PIECE_INDEX
macros.description: Index of the bottle tag piece in the random perk machine's piece array.
macros.remarks: One of the ZM_PERK_RANDOM_*_PIECE_INDEX group, which numbers the machine's animated sub-models 0 through 5.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_COST
macros.description: Point cost of using the random perk machine.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_GREEN_LIGHT_BIT
macros.description: Light state value that shows the green light on the random perk machine.
macros.remarks: Sent through the set_client_light_state clientfield. Despite the BIT suffix these are consecutive state values, not bit masks.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_NO_LIGHT_BIT
macros.description: Light state value that shows no light on the random perk machine.
macros.remarks: Sent through the set_client_light_state clientfield. Despite the BIT suffix these are consecutive state values, not bit masks.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_RED_LIGHT_BIT
macros.description: Light state value that shows the red light on the random perk machine.
macros.remarks: Sent through the set_client_light_state clientfield. Despite the BIT suffix these are consecutive state values, not bit masks.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_STATUS_FX_TAG
macros.description: Model tag on the random perk machine that its status effects are attached to.

macros.name: ZM_PERK_RANDOM_YELLOW_LIGHT_BIT
macros.description: Light state value that shows the yellow light on the random perk machine.
macros.remarks: Sent through the set_client_light_state clientfield. Despite the BIT suffix these are consecutive state values, not bit masks.

macros.name: ZM_PLAYER_POSITION_HEIGHT
macros.description: Height in units used when querying navigation positions for a zombies player.

macros.name: ZM_PLAYER_POSITION_MAX
macros.description: Maximum offset used when querying navigation positions for a zombies player.
macros.remarks: Part of the navigation query bounds in scripts/zm/_zm_player.gsh alongside ZM_PLAYER_POSITION_MIN, ZM_PLAYER_POSITION_HEIGHT and ZM_PLAYER_SPACING_INNER.

macros.name: ZM_PLAYER_POSITION_MIN
macros.description: Minimum offset used when querying navigation positions for a zombies player.
macros.remarks: Part of the navigation query bounds in scripts/zm/_zm_player.gsh alongside ZM_PLAYER_POSITION_MAX, ZM_PLAYER_POSITION_HEIGHT and ZM_PLAYER_SPACING_INNER.

macros.name: ZM_PLAYER_SPACING_INNER
macros.description: Inner spacing in units kept between queried navigation positions for a zombies player.

macros.name: ZM_POSITION_QUERY_LAST_STAND_MOVE_DIST_MAX
macros.description: Maximum radius in inches for the position query that moves zombies away from a downed player.
macros.remarks: Written as 12*80 (80 feet). Pairs with ZM_POSITION_QUERY_LAST_STAND_MOVE_DIST_MIN.

macros.name: ZM_POSITION_QUERY_LAST_STAND_MOVE_DIST_MIN
macros.description: Minimum radius in inches for the position query that moves zombies away from a downed player.
macros.remarks: Written as 12*40 (40 feet). Pairs with ZM_POSITION_QUERY_LAST_STAND_MOVE_DIST_MAX.

macros.name: ZM_POSITION_QUERY_MOVE_DIST_MAX
macros.description: Maximum path distance in inches a position query result may be from the querying undead archetype.

macros.name: ZM_POSITION_QUERY_RADIUS
macros.description: Spacing radius in inches passed to position queries run for undead archetypes.

macros.name: ZM_RAPS_SWORD_KILL_POWER
macros.description: Number of sword hits a RAPS drone takes before it is killed.

macros.name: ZM_SEARCH_RADIUS
macros.description: Search radius in inches used when looking for a valid navmesh point near an undead archetype.

macros.name: ZM_SIGHT_DIST_SQ
macros.description: Squared vision range for undead archetypes, for comparison against DistanceSquared.

macros.name: ZM_STUMBLE_CHANCE
macros.description: Percentage chance that a zombie stumbles when the stumble check runs.
macros.remarks: Rolled against RandomInt( 100 ), so the value is a percentage. ZM_CAN_STUMBLE gates the check separately.

macros.name: ZM_STUMBLE_MIN_DISTANCE_SQ
macros.description: Minimum squared distance a zombie must be from its enemy before it is allowed to stumble.
macros.remarks: Stored squared so it can be compared against DistanceSquared without a square root.

macros.name: ZM_STUMBLE_TIME_MAX
macros.description: Maximum time in milliseconds between zombie stumbles.
macros.remarks: Used with ZM_STUMBLE_TIME_MIN to pick a random cooldown.

macros.name: ZM_STUMBLE_TIME_MIN
macros.description: Minimum time in milliseconds between zombie stumbles.
macros.remarks: Used with ZM_STUMBLE_TIME_MAX to pick a random cooldown.

macros.name: ZM_TRAP_BURN_MAX
macros.description: Maximum duration in seconds of the burning overlay and damage applied by a fire trap.

macros.name: ZM_TRAP_ELECTRIC_MAX
macros.description: Maximum duration in seconds of the electrocution overlay applied by an electric trap.

macros.name: ZM_TURN_OFF_PUSH_TIME
macros.description: Time in milliseconds after which zombie-versus-zombie pushing is turned off.

macros.name: ZM_WASP_RING_ENTER_DURATION
macros.description: Time in seconds the wasp round ring effect takes to fade in.

macros.name: ZM_WASP_RING_EXIT_DURATION
macros.description: Time in seconds the wasp round ring effect takes to fade out.

macros.name: ZM_WASP_RING_LOOP_DURATION
macros.description: Length in seconds of the looping phase of the wasp round ring effect.

macros.name: ZM_WASP_ROUND_VISION_FILE
macros.description: Name of the vision file loaded for the wasp round visionset.
macros.remarks: Expands to the same string as ZM_WASP_ROUND_VISIONSET.

macros.name: ZM_WASP_ROUND_VISIONSET
macros.description: Name of the visionset applied for the duration of a wasp round.

macros.name: ZM_WASP_SWORD_KILL_POWER
macros.description: Amount of sword charge or kill power credited for killing a wasp.

macros.name: ZM_WASP_VISION_LERP_COUNT
macros.description: Number of frames used to blend into and out of the wasp round visionset.

macros.name: ZM_WASP_VISION_OVERLAY_PRIORITY
macros.description: Priority slot used when applying the wasp (parasite) round vision overlay, so it sorts against other overlays.

macros.name: ZM_ZOMBIE_HEIGHT
macros.description: Height in units of a standard zombie, used for traces and positioning.

macros.name: ZM_ZOMBIE_HERO_WEAPON_KILL_POWER
macros.description: Number of hero weapon or sword hits a standard zombie takes before it is killed.
macros.remarks: Assigned to both self.heroweapon_kill_power and self.sword_kill_power in scripts/zm/_zm_spawner.gsc.

macros.name: ZM_ZOMBIE_SWORD_KILL_POWER
macros.description: Number of sword hits a standard zombie takes before it is killed.
macros.remarks: No stock script references this macro; _zm_spawner.gsc sets self.sword_kill_power from ZM_ZOMBIE_HERO_WEAPON_KILL_POWER instead.

macros.name: ZOMBIE_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the clientfield that marks an entity as a zombie on the client.

macros.name: ZOMBIE_DAMAGEWEAPON_PACKED
macros.description: Value of the ZOMBIE_DAMAGEWEAPON_TYPE blackboard attribute meaning the damaging weapon was pack-a-punched.

macros.name: ZOMBIE_DAMAGEWEAPON_REGULAR
macros.description: Value of the ZOMBIE_DAMAGEWEAPON_TYPE blackboard attribute meaning the damaging weapon was an ordinary one.

macros.name: ZOMBIE_DAMAGEWEAPON_TYPE
macros.description: Blackboard attribute name recording whether the weapon that damaged a zombie was pack-a-punched.

macros.name: ZOMBIE_SPECIAL_DAY_EFFECTS_CLIENTFIELD
macros.description: Name of the clientfield that drives the special day zombie effects on the client.

macros.name: ZOMBIE_SUICIDE_RANGE
macros.description: Range in inches at which a suicide zombie detonates on its target.
macros.remarks: ZOMBIE_SUICIDE_RANGE_SQ is the squared form of the same value.

macros.name: ZOMBIE_SUICIDE_RANGE_SQ
macros.description: Squared detonation range of a suicide zombie, for comparison against DistanceSquared.
macros.remarks: The squared form of ZOMBIE_SUICIDE_RANGE.
